Remote  I Administrative Assistant I Full Time



We’re seeking a dependable, proactive, and detail-focused Administrative Assistant to join our growing team and provide valuable support across the daily operations of a fast-paced service business.

- Process warranty registrations for HVAC and related equipment

- Maintain organized digital records and internal tracking systems

- Create and schedule social media content

- Prepare and send invoices after completed services or installations

- Provide general administrative support and assist customers when needed



Qualifications:

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills - MUST

- Direct experience supporting an HVAC, field-service, or trade-based business - MUST

- Previous experience as a Virtual Assistant, Administrative Assistant, or Operations Support 

- Experience handling permits, compliance documentation, warranties, rebates, or other service-related paperwork 

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy

- Excellent organizational and time management skills

- Tech-savvy with the ability to quickly learn new systems and software



Work Arrangement:

- Full-time, remote position

- 8 hours per day

- 5 days per week

- Use ""ADMIN"" as the subject line of your
.

title: AI Email Copywriter
description:
Hello there!



We are a growing
 Marketing Agency with 60+ active e-commerce clients looking for an enthusiastic and skilled AI
 Copywriter.



This is a part-time role where you will be working alongside our current team of 50+.



PLEASE ONLY APPLY IF YOU CAN WRITE SMOOTH, CLEAR, HIGH-CONVERTING COPY USING CLAUDE AI AND KNOW HOW TO PROMPT IT CORRECTLY



We are looking for a top-tier
 copywriter first and foremost. Your main job is to write copy that reads smoothly, makes complete sense, and moves the reader toward a purchase without ever confusing them. This is not about generating words that sound nice. Every line needs to flow naturally, build logically on the line before it, and land with real clarity and persuasion.



We need someone who can use Claude AI to draft strong copy quickly, but who also knows how to take that output and polish it until it reads clean, human, and effortless. If a sentence feels clunky, repetitive, or like it was stitched together from random AI phrasing, you catch it and fix it before it ever reaches us.



This copy will be written for individual
 campaigns and flows across our client roster, primarily in health, supplements, beauty, and other higher-end DTC categories, including brands that speak to older, more discerning demographics. Brand references and context will be provided for every brief.



The final output for every
 must be clean, formatted copy — headline, subheader, body, and CTA — delivered in a structured format ready for the design team to build from.



As a secondary part of the role, you should know how to use Claude (and similar AI writing tools) to accelerate output, but strong prompting is only half the job. The other half is editorial: knowing how to rewrite, tighten, and smooth out AI output so it sounds like it was written by a skilled human copywriter, not generated.





Requirements:



- Minimum 1 year of
 copywriting experience, ideally in direct-response

- Highly proficient in Claude AI and skilled at prompting it to produce strong first drafts (this is the most important requirement)

- Strong editorial instinct: able to identify clunky, confusing, or "AI-sounding" copy and rewrite it until it flows naturally

- Experience writing direct-response copy for supplements, health, or other higher-end categories is a strong plus

- Comfortable writing for older or more sophisticated demographics who respond to clarity and trust over hype

- Proficient in English — copy must read naturally and never feel robotic or disjointed

- Proficient with Slack for team communication

- Able to work weekdays and weekends





Bonus Points:



- Direct experience writing for supplement or wellness brands

- Strong grasp of direct-response principles (hook writing, CTA hierarchy, urgency framing, social proof)

- Experience writing across multiple brands simultaneously without voice bleed

- A natural ear for rhythm and pacing in copy, knowing when a sentence needs to be cut, combined, or rewritten entirely





Your tasks as an AI
 Copywriter will include:



1. Use Claude AI to draft strong, on-brief
 copy based on the brand references and briefs we provide

2. Edit and refine every draft so the final copy reads smoothly, makes complete sense, and never confuses the reader

3. Match each brand's voice perfectly, with particular care for brands speaking to older or higher-end audiences

4. Write up to 30
s per day (the majority will typically be for one or two clients so the workflow stays efficient)

5. Deliver all final copy in a clean structured format: headline, subheader, body, CTA, and ender line

6. Communicate progress and revisions with the team in Slack

7. Complete all tasks daily before 3 PM PH time





We ask that you answer the questions below to help us get to know you.



Questions:



1. Have you written direct-response
 copy before, especially for supplements, health, or other higher-end categories? If yes, for how long, and do you have examples we can review?



2. Walk us through how you use Claude AI to draft copy. What does your prompting process look like, and how do you push it to get a strong first draft rather than something generic?



3. Once Claude gives you a draft, what do you look for when editing it? How do you know when a line "doesn't sound right" and needs to be rewritten?



4. Can you share a quick before-and-after example, AI's raw output versus your final edited version, so we can see how you improve it?



5. How do you write for an older or more sophisticated audience differently than you would for a younger, trend-driven one?



6. How do you keep your copy feeling fresh across multiple campaigns for the same brand without falling into repetitive angles or phrasing?





We are looking to grow very quickly over the next few months and this position will allow for opportunities to move into incentive-based pay and a salary increase. After 3 months, there will be a salary increase.



We ask that if you do provide examples, they be relevant to what the job describes.



Biweekly Pay: $150 CAD

Hours: 4 hours per day



Currently, you must be able to work at least 20hrs/week (including weekends)





*** HOW TO APPLY ***



*You must include your favorite color + AI tool in the subject line of your application for it to be considered (this shows you actually read it and is very important; if you do not have it in there, your application will be skipped).



1.) Send us a message answering all 6 questions

2.) Include examples of your
 copy work (formatted copy preferred, not screenshots)

3.) Include a before-and-after example showing raw AI output versus your final edited copy, if you have one



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: E-commerce Marketing Specialist
description:
E-commerce Marketing Specialist



Remote, Minimum 3-Month Contract



SmilePro is a leading Australian oral-care e-commerce brand selling teeth whitening kits, electric toothbrushes, whitening strips, and other oral-care products across Australia, the UK, Europe, and other international markets.



We are looking for an experienced E-commerce Marketing Specialist to join our remote team while our current Marketing Specialist is on parental leave.



This is a minimum three-month contract, with the possibility of ongoing work depending on performance and business requirements.



POSITION DETAILS



- Hours: 40 paid hours per week

- Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM PHT, including a one-hour unpaid lunch break

- Hourly Rate: PHP 437.50

- Weekly Pay: PHP 17,500

- Start Date: ASAP

- Location: Remote

- Reports To: Director, Australia



ABOUT THE ROLE



You will work closely with the Director and collaborate with our paid media, design, video, content,
 marketing, and e-commerce tea
mbers.



Your role will be to plan and coordinate marketing campaigns, develop creative concepts, prepare detailed briefs, review completed work, and ensure campaigns are delivered correctly and on time.



This is not a general virtual assistant or purely administrative marketing position. We need someone with strong marketing judgement who can take ownership, identify problems, and keep projects moving.



A strong eye for design and direct-response creative is essential. You do not need to be a graphic designer, but you must be able to recognise high-quality creative, identify what needs improvement, and provide clear feedback to designers, video editors, and content creators.



You should understand the difference between creative that simply looks attractive and creative that captures attention, communicates an offer clearly, builds trust, and converts.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Campaign Planning and Coordination



- Help plan campaigns across SmilePro’s international markets.

- Maintain the marketing calendar, deliverables, responsibilities, and deadlines.

- Develop campaign ideas based on business priorities, customer insights, seasonal opportunities, competitor research, and performance data.

- Coordinate work across paid media, design, video, content,
 marketing, and e-commerce.

- Ensure campaign assets, offers,
s, landing pages, and website updates are completed correctly and on time.

- Provide the Director with clear updates on progress, risks, and required decisions.



Creative Strategy and Quality Control



- Develop campaign concepts, messaging angles, hooks, offers, and content ideas.

- Prepare clear and detailed briefs for designers, video editors, content creators, and other tea
mbers.

- Review advertisements,
s, landing pages, product pages, website graphics, and social content.

- Assess creative from both a visual and commercial perspective.

- Identify issues with messaging, layout, typography, spacing, visual hierarchy, imagery, branding, and calls to action.



Content Creator and UGC Management



- Identify and contact suitable content creators for partnerships.

- Prepare creator briefs covering concepts, hooks, talking points, required scenes, deliverables, and deadlines.

- Track creator projects, review submitted content, and request revisions where required.

- Help maintain a consistent pipeline of UGC for paid advertising,
, social media, and website use.



Performance and E-commerce Support



- Work with the paid media team to understand campaign and creative performance.

- Identify successful hooks, messages, creators, formats, offers, and products.

- Apply performance insights to future campaigns and creative briefs.

- Review product pages, landing pages,
s, offers, and customer journeys from a conversion perspective.

- Support the planning and review of Klaviyo campaigns.

- Use ClickUp to track projects, feedback, deadlines, and approvals.



REQUIREMENTS



- At least two years of hands-on e-commerce marketing experience.

- Experience planning campaigns and preparing briefs for designers, video editors, or content creators.

- A strong eye for design, branding, and direct-response creative.

- Understanding of customer pain points, hooks, offers, and what makes e-commerce creative convert.

- Familiarity with Shopify, Klaviyo, Meta Ads, Google Ads, and key marketing metrics.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Highly organised, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple deadlines.

- Able to work independently, solve problems, and take ownership.

- Reliable internet and availability during the required working hours.



Experience with international e-commerce brands, UGC, ClickUp, Shopify apps, or AI-assisted marketing workflows would be an advantage.



WHY JOIN SMILEPRO



- Join an established Australian e-commerce brand operating internationally.

- Take ownership of meaningful campaigns and creative projects.

- Work directly with the Director and an experienced remote team.

- Receive hands-on training in international e-commerce marketing, campaign strategy, and direct-response creative.

- Receive a structured handover from our current Marketing Specialist.

- Opportunity for ongoing work after the initial contract.



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit your application via the link below.

title: Product Photo Retoucher — Add Brand Logo to Activewear Photos
description:
We are Isla Active, a new premium women's activewear brand based in Koh Samui, Thailand. We're anchored to a reformer pilates studio and launching on TikTok Shop Thailand, Shopee and Lazada.



We have just received our first production run — 1,800 pieces of leggings, sports bras, shorts and t-shirts. We have professional product photography from our manufacturer, but the garments in those photos are unbranded. We need our logo added to them so the images match what we actually ship.



This is real, ongoing work for a growing brand, not a one-off gig.



The job



You will take our existing professional product photos and:



Composite our logo onto the garments so it looks genuinely printed or heat-pressed into the fabric — following the fabric's stretch, folds, curve and lighting. Not pasted flat on top.

Clean up backgrounds — replace with pure white or neutral studio grey, consistent across the whole catalogue.

Colour-match and standardise — our 4 colourways (Black, Cacao Brown, Light Blue, Pink) must look accurate and consistent across every image and every product.

Export to marketplace specs — 1:1 square, 1000×1000px minimum, JPEG under 5MB, correctly named per our convention.



Expected volume: roughly 150–250 images in the first month, then ongoing as we add products.



Skills you must have

Adobe Photoshop (required — no alternatives)

Displacement mapping — you must know how to make a logo conform to fabric texture and stretch. If you don't know what a displacement map is, this role is not for you.

Blend modes (Multiply, Soft Light, Overlay) and how to match a logo's lighting and shadow to the underlying photo

Clean pen-tool / precision masking around hair, fingers and fabric edges

Colour correction and matching across a batch

Batch processing with Actions to keep output consistent

Working English — enough to understand written feedback and ask questions when a brief is unclear



Nice to have: experience with apparel or activewear e-commerce; familiarity with TikTok Shop, Shopee or Lazada listing requirements; basic short-form video editing (we may add this later at a higher rate).



Important: what this job is NOT



Please read this carefully — it's the most common misunderstanding.



We do NOT want AI-generated images. No AI-generated models. No AI-generated lifestyle scenes, beaches, gyms or fabricated environments. No generative re-rendering of the garment itself.



Marketplace policies now require visible "AI-generated" disclosure labels on synthetic product imagery, and we will not risk our listings.



You may use AI-assisted tools for cutout, masking, background removal and cleanup — that is normal post-production and it's fine. But the product must remain pixel-for-pixel the real product. We retouch. We do not generate.



Applications built around Midjourney, Sora or similar generative portfolios will not be considered.



Accuracy matters more than beauty



Our physical garments have the logo in one specific location at one specific size. Your job is to replicate exactly that — not to make the nicest-looking composition.



If a customer receives a product that doesn't match the photo, we get returns and our seller rating drops. We will give you reference photos of the actual physical garment. Match them precisely. If something in the brief looks wrong or inconsistent, tell us before you edit 50 images.



Pay, hours and how we'll work

$5.00 – $7.00 USD/hour, depending on demonstrated skill

Tracked through OnlineJobs.ph TimeProof

Paid weekly

First week capped at 10 hours so we can both assess fit, then we'll increase



On throughput: we understand the first few images are slow while you build the logo template, displacement map and Photoshop Action. After that we'd expect roughly 6–12 finished images per hour. We're not going to micromanage you — but please flag it early if the work is running significantly slower than that so we can adjust the brief instead of burning hours.



We will provide: logo in vector (.AI, .SVG, .EPS) and transparent PNG, a written placement spec in centimetres, reference photos of the real garment, and the full source image library in Google Drive.



How to apply



Applications that don't follow this format will be ignored. Please send:



The word "CACAO" at the top of your message, so we know you read the full post.

2–3 before/after examples of logo or graphic compositing onto fabric or clothing. This is the single most important part of your application — portfolios without apparel compositing work will not be shortlisted.

A short answer to this question: How would you make a logo follow the curve and stretch of the waistband on a pair of leggings? Two or three sentences is enough — we just want to know you understand the technique.

Your hourly rate and how many hours per week you can commit.

Your Photoshop version and confirmation you have a stable internet connection for transferring large files.



Paid test task: shortlisted applicants will be given 2 images to edit for a fixed $5 USD, paid whether or not we hire you. Expect roughly 30–60 minutes of work. We'll hire from that test.



We reply to every shortlisted applicant within 3 days.

title: Multimedia Editor (Football / Soccer Niche)
description:
Job Title: Multimedia Editor (Football / Soccer Niche)

Salary Range: ?27,000 – ?30,000 / month



Location: Remote



Type: Full-Time (40 hours/week, Monday–Friday) — Fully focused; strict no second jobs policy



Shift: 1:00 PM – 9:00 PM PHT — Aligned with European working hours



Positions Available: 2 Openings



Position 1: Immediate Start (Urgent)



Position 2: Start within 1 week



About the Role

We are a fast-growing sports media brand living and breathing football (soccer) culture. As we expand our marketing strategy across social media and YouTube, we are looking for two skilled Multimedia Editors specializing in both short-form and long-form content to scale our production capacity.



In this role, you will be responsible for creating high-retention TikToks, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts, as well as editing polished, engaging long-form YouTube videos (documentaries, listicles, match breakdowns, and video podcasts). If you understand football culture, master pacing across different video formats, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you.



Key Responsibilities

Short-Form Video Production: Edit fast-paced, high-retention short-form videos (Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts) utilizing strong hooks, trending sounds, dynamic text overlays, motion graphics, and sound effects.



Long-Form Video Editing: Structure and edit compelling long-form YouTube videos (e.g., mini-documentaries, narrative breakdowns, tactical analysis, listicles), maintaining strong viewer retention and narrative flow.



Football Culture & Trend Integration: Seamlessly incorporate match footage, statistics, memes, news clips, sound effects, and culturally relevant football banter into edits.



Thumbnail & Graphic Assets: Create or assist with high-CTR thumbnails and visual assets tailored for long-form YouTube and short-form platforms.



Fast-Turnaround News Edits: Rapidly edit quick-reaction content to capitalize on breaking news, viral matchday moments, and trending football topics.



Platform Optimization: Tailor edits to platform-specific specs (aspect ratios, pacing, safe zones, hooks, and retention strategies).



Team Collaboration: Work closely with our Marketing Strategist via ClickUp to manage video pipelines, revisions, and release schedules efficiently.



Qualifications & Requirements

Format Expertise: Proven specialization in editing both short-form (vertical 9:16) and long-form (horizontal 16:9) videos with high viewer retention rates.



Niche Passion & Knowledge: Deep understanding of global football (leagues, teams, players, tactical narratives, and social media football culture/memes).



Software Proficiency: Expert command of Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro. Strong skills in After Effects (motion graphics, animated lower-thirds, tracking) and CapCut are highly preferred.



Portfolio / Showreel: Must submit a portfolio featuring examples of both short-form and long-form football/sports edits demonstrating strong pacing, audio design, and narrative flow.



Speed & Reliability: Ability to deliver polished edits on schedule during tight deadlines and fast-moving matchdays.



Full-Time Focus: Ability to dedicate 100% of your professional focus to this role (strictly no freelancing, side gigs, or second jobs).



Schedule Alignment: Able to consistently work 1:00 PM – 9:00 PM PHT, Monday to Friday.



Remote Work Setup: High-performance editing rig, fast internet connection, and proficiency with remote tools like ClickUp.



What We Offer

Salary: ?27,000 – ?30,000 / month



Growth Potential: Opportunity to advance into a Lead Multimedia Editor or Creative Producer role as our media outlet grows.



100% remote working setup.



Work directly on exciting content within the global sports media ecosystem.



Collaborative, fast-paced, and passionate team culture.

title: Video Editor to Create Educational and How-To Videos
description:
***You must be comfortable with monthly payments for compensation.***



Location: Remote (Philippines-based referred)

Employment Type: Full-Time (40 hours/week, Monday to Friday)



About the Role

We are seeking a creative and detail-oriented Video Editor to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for creating high-quality, visually engaging videos tailored for social media platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and
.



Your work will directly impact the brand’s online presence, so we are looking for someone with strong technical skills, a keen eye for detail, and the ability to tell compelling stories through video.







Key Responsibilities

Editing & Post-Production

Assemble and refine video clips to create cohesive, high-quality content.

Add transitions, effects, and other creative elements to elevate visual storytelling.

Sync and edit audio, incorporating music and voiceovers for a polished final product.



Color Grading & Correction

Adjust color tones and lighting to maintain visual consistency across all videos.

Perform detailed color correction to enhance footage quality.



Motion Graphics & Animation

Create motion graphics, lower-thirds, and animations to make content more dynamic.

Work with 3D models and advanced graphics to enhance production value.



Collaboration

Work closely with social media coordinators and marketing teams to align content with creative goals and brand strategy.



File Management & Organization

Maintain organized folders and version control for all project files and assets.

Ensure files are stored securely for easy access and future use.



Quality Control

Review final edits to ensure videos are free of errors, including audio syncing, subtitles, and visual quality.

Meet deadlines without compromising attention to detail.



Platform-Specific Optimization

Export videos in correct formats, file sizes, and aspect ratios for various platforms.

Optimize content for mobile-first platforms like Instagram Reels and TikTok.

Continuous Learning & Creativity

Stay updated with the latest video editing trends, tools, and techniques.

Suggest new ideas and innovative approaches to enhance content quality.



Requirements

Proven experience as a Video Editor with a strong portfolio.

Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro – essential for advanced editing.

Knowledge of VFX tools such as Adobe After Effects or Blender.

Ability to create animations and work with 3D models.

Strong understanding of visual storytelling, pacing, and narrative flow.

Excellent attention to detail and a creative eye.

Familiarity with exporting content across multiple platforms and devices.

Ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.

Strong collaboration and communication skills for working with remote teams.



Work Schedule

Hours: 40 hours per week

Days: Monday to Friday

100% remote – must have reliable internet connection and ability to collaborate online.

title: Virtual Assistant – Cold Caller & Sales Closer & Strategic Relationship Development
description:
Skybound Wealth Group is a fast-growing real estate company looking for a driven, results-oriented Virtual Assistant who can take ownership of our outbound sales pipeline — from first dial to signed deal.

You'll be the first voice prospects hear and the closer that gets them to yes, backed by strong systems and a supportive team.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Cold Calling: High-volume outbound calls to motivated seller and buyer leads.

Sales Closing: Qualify, nurture, and convert leads into agreements.

Lead Management: Organize, track, and follow up on leads at every stage of the pipeline.

CRM Integration: Update and maintain pipelines in real time (Follow Up Boss, HubSpot, Podio, or similar).

Appointment Setting: Schedule consultations and property walkthroughs for our agents.

Pipeline Reporting: Provide daily summaries, KPI tracking, and conversion notes.

Strategic Relationship Development — 25% of Role: Build genuine relationships with people and businesses that can create additional deal flow for Skybound Wealth Group, including real estate agents, property managers, contractors, investors, wholesalers, and other local professionals.

Off-Market Opportunity Development: Identify potential deal sources and referral relationships that our normal marketing and lead-generation systems would not reach.

Relationship Building: Maintain and grow a network of people who can refer distressed properties, motivated sellers, off-market opportunities, or other potential deals to the company.

Your 25% Strategic Mission

Your job is to find people who can bring us opportunities that our normal marketing machine would never find.

This is not simply a networking task. The goal is to create a new, relationship-driven acquisition channel for the company that can grow alongside our outbound marketing.

REQUIREMENTS

Proven experience in cold calling, telemarketing, or inside sales (real estate background is a strong plus).

Confident, persuasive communicator with excellent English — spoken and written.

Hands-on experience with CRM platforms (Follow Up Boss, HubSpot, Podio, or similar).

Highly organized, able to manage high call volumes and multiple pipelines simultaneously.

Strong relationship-building and networking skills.

Comfortable speaking with business owners, investors, agents, contractors, and other professionals.

Self-motivated, competitive, and goal-driven.

Able to work independently and take ownership of results.

Reliable remote setup: high-speed internet, quiet workspace, and quality headset.

WHAT WE OFFER

$500/month base pay + performance bonuses per closed deal

100% remote work.

Paid training and scripts provided.

Growth opportunities within the company.

Opportunity to grow into a larger sales, business development, or leadership role as the company scales.

HOW TO APPLY

Send your resume and a 1–2 minute voice or video introduction to 
 with the subject line:

"VA Sales Closer – [Your Name]"

Applications without a voice intro will not be considered.

title: Creative streetwear and apparel graphic designer
description:
# Melodik Threadz Co™

## Streetwear Graphic Designer / Illustrator — Creative VA



### About the Role



Melodik Threadz Co™ is looking for a talented Streetwear Graphic Designer / Illustrator who can take original concepts and transform them into high-quality, production-ready apparel designs.



This is not primarily a Canva, social-media flyer, or administrative position.



We are looking for someone with genuine creative ability who can receive a concept, understand the meaning behind it, develop a strong visual direction, and execute professional artwork suitable for a premium streetwear brand.



The owner will serve as Creative Director, providing the concepts, meaning, references, feedback, and final approval. Your responsibility will be to bring those ideas to life visually.



---



## What You'll Be Creating



Projects may include:



- Original T-shirt graphics

- Hoodies and crewneck graphics

- Front, back, and sleeve artwork

- Streetwear illustrations

- Custom typography

- Vintage/distressed graphics

- Luxury streetwear concepts

- Character-based artwork

- Symbolic and metaphorical artwork

- Badges, emblems, and supporting graphics

- Garment mockups

- Print-ready production files



Many concepts will begin as an idea rather than completed artwork.



For example, you may receive a concept, meaning, mood, and several visual references. You will be expected to use your artistic ability to develop that information into an original composition rather than simply copying the references.



---



# What We Need From You



### 1. Strong Creative Interpretation



You must be able to take an abstract idea and develop it visually.



We do not want someone who needs every element, position, font, and detail explained before beginning.



We want someone who can think creatively and contribute ideas while still following the Creative Director's vision.



### 2. Strong Streetwear Understanding



You should understand current and classic streetwear aesthetics, including:



- Oversized graphic compositions

- Vintage-inspired graphics

- Premium typography

- Distressing and texture

- Placement and proportions

- Front/back relationships

- Sleeve graphics

- Garment color interaction

- Visual hierarchy



The artwork should look like something consumers would actually purchase—not simply artwork placed on a shirt.



### 3. Illustration & Graphic Design Ability



Strong skills in:



Adobe Photoshop — Required



Adobe Illustrator — Strongly Preferred



Additional illustration software is acceptable.



Canva may be used for certain marketing projects, but Canva alone is not sufficient for this position.



### 4. Production-Ready Artwork



You must understand how to prepare artwork for apparel production.



Final files may need to include:



- High-resolution artwork

- 300 DPI

- Transparent PNG

- True transparent backgrounds

- Vector files when appropriate

- PSD/AI working files

- Correct print dimensions

- Clean edges

- No unwanted backgrounds, shadows, or artifacts

- Proper color management

- Separate front/back/sleeve graphics when required



Artwork must be suitable for professional DTF, DTG, screen printing, embroidery, or other garment-production methods, depending on the project.



---



# Our Creative Philosophy



Melodik Threadz Co™ designs frequently begin with music, culture, language, emotions, experiences, and everyday expressions.



However, our goal is usually not to illustrate an idea literally.



We prefer visual metaphors.



The artwork should make someone look at the shirt, understand something deeper is happening, and potentially discover another meaning after looking at it again.



Originality is extremely important.



---



# Important Brand Rules



You will receive detailed brand standards once hired, but several principles are important from the beginning:



- Do not copy another clothing brand's artwork.

- References are for direction and inspiration, not duplication.

- Avoid generic-looking AI artwork.

- Avoid artwork that looks obviously AI-generated.

- Typography must feel intentional and professional.

- Small text must remain readable.

- Brand spelling must always be accurate.

- Avoid unnecessary elements just to fill space.

- Every element should contribute to the concept.

- Designs should feel premium and commercially wearable.



AI tools may be used to assist the creative process when approved, but the finished artwork must be professionally designed, refined, edited, and production-ready.



---



# Creative Workflow



Our normal process will be:



STEP 1 — Concept



Creative Director provides the idea, meaning, references, garment color, and general direction.



STEP 2 — Interpretation



Designer develops the visual direction and composition.



STEP 3 — Initial Design



Designer submits the first concept for review.



STEP 4 — Feedback



Creative Director provides revisions and direction.



STEP 5 — Final Artwork



Designer completes the approved design.



STEP 6 — Production Files



Designer prepares the required print-ready files.



STEP 7 — Mockup



Once artwork is approved, the design may be presented on the appropriate garment mockup.



---



# What We Are NOT Looking For



Please do not apply if your experience is primarily:



- Canva templates

- Social-media flyers

- Basic logo creation

- Simple photo editing

- Premade T-shirt templates

- Copying Pinterest designs

- Generating an AI image and submitting it without professional editing



Those skills can be useful, but they are not enough for this position.



We need an actual designer and visual problem-solver.



---



# Portfolio Requirements



Please send examples of your strongest work.



We especially want to see:



- Streetwear

- Apparel graphics

- Illustration

- Typography

- Poster-style compositions

- Character artwork

- Vintage graphics

- Complex Photoshop compositions



If you have worked with clothing brands previously, please identify which designs were actually created by you.



---



# Paid Design Test



Final candidates may be asked to complete a paid creative test.



Every candidate will receive the same concept and general instructions.



We will evaluate:



Creativity — Did you bring something original to the concept?



Interpretation — Did you understand the idea instead of simply illustrating the words?



Design Quality — Does it look professional?



Streetwear Appeal — Would someone actually buy and wear it?



Typography — Does the typography complement the artwork?



Attention to Detail — Is the artwork polished?



Communication — Did you understand and respond appropriately to feedback?



Technical Execution — Can the artwork actually be manufactured?



Originality — Does it feel unique rather than copied or obviously AI-generated?



---



# When Applying, Please Send



1. Your name and location

2. Your portfolio

3. Examples of apparel/streetwear designs

4. Software you use

5. Years of graphic-design experience

6. Whether you use Photoshop

7. Whether you use Illustrator

8. Your experience preparing artwork for garment printing

9. Your experience with DTF, DTG, screen printing, or embroidery

10. Your monthly full-time rate OR preferred per-design rate

11. Your normal working hours and time zone

12. Your computer specifications

13. Your internet speed

14. Your earliest available start date



Please also answer:



If someone gives you an idea but doesn't tell you exactly what the finished artwork should look like, are you comfortable developing the creative direction yourself?



---



# What Success Looks Like



The ideal designer eventually understands the Melodik Threadz Co™ visual language well enough that the Creative Director can explain an idea and you can take it from:



Concept ? Interpretation ? Artwork ? Revision ? Production File



without needing every creative decision made for you.



We are looking for someone interested in developing a long-term creative relationship with the brand, not simply completing random graphics.



Brand: Melodik Threadz Co™  

Position: Streetwear Graphic Designer / Illustrator — Creative VA  

Work Type: Remote

title: Meta Ads Media Buyer & Ads Launcher
description:
We are looking for a Meta Ads Media Buyer / Ads Launcher to join our team and take ownership of the day-to-day ad side of the business.



We are a 7-figure eCommerce company with a strong team, good morale, and high standards. We work fast, communicate well, and want someone who is respectful, easy to work with, and can genuinely take responsibility for their role without needing to be chased.



This is not just a role for someone who knows how to press publish in Ads Manager. We want someone who understands how to launch campaigns properly, monitor performance daily, test creatives and audiences, kill what is not working, and scale what is working without being reckless with spend.

You will work closely with our creative team to make sure ads are ready, uploaded, and launched on time. You will also be responsible for keeping the tracking sheet updated so the whole team can clearly see what is working, what is not, what we have learned, and what we should test next.



What you will be doing

You will be launching and managing Meta ad campaigns for an eCommerce brand, including campaign setup, ad sets, ads, naming conventions, budgets, targeting, and tracking checks before campaigns go live.

You will monitor performance every day and make decisions based on the data. This includes testing new creatives, hooks, angles, copy, offers, and audiences; switching off ads that are not performing; and scaling winning ads while keeping a close eye on ROAS, CPA, cost per purchase, and overall profitability.

You will make sure the account is organised and launch-ready. That includes checking Pixels or datasets, conversion events, UTMs, tracking, access, billing, and any other issues that could stop a campaign from launching or tracking properly.

You will also keep our tracking sheet up to date with spend, results, test outcomes, and learnings. We want someone who can clearly tell the team what is happening in the account, what needs more creative support, and what should be tested next.



What we are looking for

You should have real hands-on experience managing and launching Meta Ads for eCommerce brands. We are looking for someone who understands both the performance side and the operations side of paid ads.

You should be confident with campaign setup, ABO and CBO testing, audience research, creative testing, budget management, optimisation, retargeting, reporting, and scaling. You should also understand Meta Pixel or Dataset setup, conversion events, basic Conversion API support, and how to identify and solve basic tracking or launch issues.

Experience using tools such as Meta Ads Manager, Triple Whale, Google Sheets, Notion, ClickUp, Slack, and other attribution or reporting tools is a big plus.

Most importantly, we want someone who is organised, proactive, and reliable. You should be comfortable working with a creative team, communicating clearly, taking ownership of deadlines, and treating the ad budget with care.



To apply

Please send us a short introduction, your experience managing Meta Ads for eCommerce brands, the highest monthly ad spend you have managed, the tools you are comfortable using, and a few examples of results you have achieved. Please also include details of how you approach testing, killing losing ads, and scaling winning campaigns.

title: Website Developer - Wordpress
description:
Expression of Interest – WordPress Website Redevelopment



Association for Educational Projects Limited (AEPL) is seeking expressions of interest from experienced WordPress designers/developers or digital agencies to deliver the redevelopment of its public website.

AEPL is a not-for-profit organisation operating study centres and educational programs across Australia. The new website will serve as the organisation’s primary platform for communication, community engagement, volunteering and fundraising.

AEPL has developed a prototype website that establishes the proposed visual direction, navigation structure and key user journeys. The organisation is not seeking a complete redesign at this stage; rather, the focus is on refining, implementing and future-proofing the approved prototype within WordPress.



AEPL intends to proceed with the redevelopment as a single project engagement, comprising:

Phase 1A – Refinement and Technical Architecture

Phase 1B – WordPress Development and Launch

Applicants are requested to provide separate pricing for each phase as well as a combined project price.



Phase 1A – Refinement and Technical Architecture

This phase is intended to confirm the production-ready structure of the website and establish the technical foundation for future growth.



Key Requirements

- Review and refine the approved prototype for production implementation.

- Confirm responsive behaviour across desktop, tablet and mobile.

- Review accessibility, performance and security requirements.

- Define the WordPress architecture, including theme approach, plugin strategy, content structure and reusable components.

- Confirm the implementation plan and identify any required design adjustments.



Deliverables

- Finalised site map and navigation structure.

- Confirmed page hierarchy.

- WordPress technical architecture.

- Implementation plan and assumptions.



Phase 1B – WordPress Development and Launch

The approved design and architecture are to be implemented as a responsive WordPress website.



Core Deliverables

- Responsive WordPress website matching the approved prototype.

- Reusable page templates and content components.

- Home page implementation.

- About page.

- Centres landing page and individual centre pages.

- Outreach page(s).

- Volunteer page(s).

- Donate page.

- Bequest page.

- Contact page.

- News/events capability.

- Contact and enquiry forms.

- Basic SEO configuration.

- Performance optimisation.

- Security configuration.

- Testing and launch support.

- Administrator handover documentation and basic training for AEPL staff.



Future-Ready Architecture (Important)

A key objective of this project is to establish a WordPress architecture that can support future enhancements without significant redevelopment.

The following features are not part of the current implementation, but applicants should demonstrate relevant experience and explain how their proposed architecture would accommodate them:

- Volunteer registration and compliance workflows

- Online donations and payment gateway integration

- Event and program registrations

- Staff and volunteer resource area

- Training portal integration

- CRM and
 marketing integration

- Analytics and reporting

- Multi-location content management



What We Are Looking For

Essential

- Proven experience delivering modern WordPress websites.

- Strong UI/UX and information architecture capability.

- Experience with not-for-profit, education, community or membership organisations.

- Ability to implement responsive, accessible and high-performance websites.

- Experience creating reusable content components that can be maintained by non-technical staff.

- Clear communication and collaborative working style.



Highly Desirable

- Experience planning for future donation, CRM or portal integrations.

- Knowledge of scalable WordPress architecture for multi-section websites.

- Experience providing documentation and staff training.



Submission Requirements

Please provide:

1. A brief introduction to your business or professional background.

2. Links to 3–5 relevant WordPress projects.

3. A short explanation of your proposed approach / methodology to delivering Phase 1A and Phase 1B.

4. A response to the following question:

How would you structure the WordPress site so that future modules (volunteer management, donations, training/resources and CRM integrations) can be added with minimal redevelopment?

5. An indicative timeline for delivery.

6. Fixed price quotation for:

  - Phase 1A

  - Phase 1B

  - Combined total project

7. (Optional) Any key assumptions or exclusions.

title: Customer Engagement & Booking Specialist
description:
# Customer Booking & Appointment Setter



We are looking for a friendly, confident and reliable **Customer Booking & Appointment Setter** to join our team.



Your main role is to contact customer leads, follow up enquiries, answer basic questions and help turn suitable enquiries into confirmed bookings.



This is not a high-pressure sales role. We want someone who communicates naturally, follows up consistently and is comfortable asking for the booking.



## Main Responsibilities



* Call new and existing customer leads

* Follow up enquiries that have not yet booked

* Respond by phone, SMS and

* Answer basic questions about services and pricing

* Book and update appointments

* Keep accurate customer notes

* Make sure new enquiries are followed up promptly



## Working Arrangement



This role offers **flexible working hours**.



There will be a base amount of work each week for scheduled calls, follow-ups, messages and customer administration.



Outside those base hours, we are looking for someone who can remain reasonably flexible when new enquiries come in.



You will **not** be expected to sit at your computer all day. The idea is that you can manage your own day, while still checking for new enquiries and responding promptly where practical.



For example, if a new enquiry comes in, you may spend a short amount of time contacting the customer and updating the system, then continue with your day.



The role will use a **retainer plus hourly pay structure**.



We care more about **reliable follow-up and results than fixed office hours**.



## What We Are Looking For



* Excellent spoken and written English

* Clear and confident phone manner

* Friendly and professional communication

* Comfortable making outbound calls

* Strong follow-up habits

* Good organisation and attention to detail

* Reliable internet, computer and headset

* Quiet workspace suitable for customer calls

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to follow processes without sounding scripted



Previous experience in **customer service, appointment setting, reception, BPO, phone support or sales** is highly regarded.



## Individual Applicants Only



**We are not looking for an agency or outsourcing company.**



We want to hire **one individual who will be primarily dedicated to this position and our business**.



You may have other commitments, but this role should be one of your primary work commitments.



If you work through an agency, outsource your work to someone else, or actively manage many unrelated clients at the same time, please do not apply.



## Performance Expectations



Your main goal is to help turn genuine customer enquiries into confirmed bookings.



Performance will be based on a combination of:



* Confirmed bookings

* Booking conversion rate

* Follow-up consistency

* Customer communication quality

* Accuracy of bookings and notes

* Reliability and responsiveness



Booking expectations will take into account the number and quality of leads provided.



## How to Apply



Please send your application **as a message through OnlineJobs.ph**.



Do not send a generic cover letter.



Your message must start with:



**WATCHTOWER**



Then include:



1. Your name and location

2. Your previous phone/customer service experience

3. A link to a **1–2 minute voice recording**

4. Your available hours in **Perth, Western Australia time**

5. How flexible you can be outside your base hours

6. Your expected hourly rate

7. Whether you currently work for another employer or client, and approximately how many hours per week

8. Whether you work through an agency

9. Confirmation that you will personally complete all work for this role

10. Your internet connection and backup option



Also answer this in your message:



> A customer enquired a few days ago but has not booked. You call them and they say, “I’m interested, but I still need to think about it.”



**Write exactly what you would say next to the customer.**



For your voice recording, please:



* Introduce yourself

* Briefly explain your relevant experience

* Explain why you would suit this role

* Pretend you are calling a customer who recently enquired and you are trying to help them make a booking



**Applications without a voice recording or that do not follow these instructions may not be considered.**



We value **good communication, reliable follow-up, ownership and genuine customer service** over aggressive sales techniques.

Self-motivated with a genuine drive for professional growth and learning.

Ability to manage workload and meet deadlines independently.

title: Outreach VA to Build Referral Partnerships for US Housing Provider
description:
About us

We are a veteran owned supportive housing provider in Southern California. We operate safe, furnished shared homes for veterans, seniors, and adults rebuilding their lives after hardship. We are small, we are growing, and we treat the people who work with us as part of the team.



About the role

Our goal is to build a network of referral partners: social workers, case managers, and housing navigators at county agencies, veteran organizations, shelters, and nonprofits. These are professionals whose job is to find housing for their clients. When they know us, they call us.



Your job is to find those people, introduce us, and get a 30 minute meeting on our calendar.



This is not sales. There is no product, no price, no pressure. You are letting someone who needs housing options know that safe beds are available. Most of them will be glad you called.



What you will do

Research and verify referral partner contacts across Riverside and San Bernardino Counties, finding the named person and direct
 rather than a general inbox. Send personalized introduction
s using templates we provide. Make friendly follow up calls to confirm the right. Book confirmed meetings and send reminders. Log every contact, call, and outcome in a shared tracker. Follow up on anything that goes quiet.



Requirements

Clear, warm, professional spoken English. You will be speaking with government employees and licensed social workers, so friendliness and clarity matter far more than speed.



Error free written English that does not read like a mass template.



At least one year in appointment setting, outbound calling, lead generation, or B2B outreach. Experience calling US organizations is strongly preferred.



Headset, computer (not phone only), quiet workspace, reliable internet, comfort with Google Sheets, Gmail, and Calendar.



Willingness to sign a confidentiality agreement. You will handle professional contact information only, never resident information.



Schedule

US Pacific business hours, which is roughly 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM Philippine Time



How to apply

Subject line: Outreach VA + [your city] + VILLAGE



Answer in your own words: Can you realistically work overnight, and what is your sleep schedule now? Describe a time you called an organization and had to find the right person. Why would a social worker want to hear from a housing provider?

US Pacific business hours, which is roughly 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM Philippine Time. Please only apply if overnight calling is realistic for you

Subject line: Outreach VA + [your city] + VILLAGE

description:

Remote / Work from Home |AEST Hours | Supporting Australian Asset Finance Brokers



Who We're Looking For

We're building a dedicated team of asset finance support professionals to work directly with Australian asset finance brokers. If you have hands-on experience processing equipment, vehicle, or commercial asset finance applications and understand the end-to-end broker workflow, we want to hear from you.

Managing asset finance files end-to-end — from initial client enquiry through to settlement and post-settlement

Data entry and file management in broker CRM platforms (Mercury, Salesforce, or equivalent)

Post-settlement tasks — invoice reconciliation, asset registration follow-up, client retention

2–3 years of experience in Australian asset finance — broker-side, not lender operations

Asset finance product knowledge — equipment finance, chattel mortgage, novated lease, hire purchase, commercial hire purchase, finance lease, operating lease

 Lender portal experience — submitting and tracking applications with major AU asset finance lenders (e.g. Westpac, NAB, ANZ, Macquarie, Pepper Money, Angle Finance, Grow Finance, Shift, ScotPac, Liberty, Fifo Capital)

Income assessment — PAYG, self-employed, company, and trust financials for asset finance purposes

CRM proficiency — Mercury, Salesforce, or comparable broker CRM

Understanding of GST, ABN, and tax implications relevant to asset finance structures

AEST business hours — full-time, Monday to Friday

Excellent written and spoken English — direct communication with brokers, clients, and lenders



Minimum Requirements



Strong understanding of chattel mortgage and finance lease structures

Comfortable handling multiple files simultaneously with strict attention to detail and deadlines

Familiar with PPSR (Personal Property Securities Register) searches and registrations

Understanding of responsible lending obligations and privacy requirements under Australian law

Proficient in Microsoft Office — Word, Excel, Outlook

Fast internet connection and professional home office setup





Nice to Have



Experience with novated leasing or fleet finance

Exposure to construction equipment, yellow goods, or specialised asset classes

Familiarity with commercial property-backed asset finance

Experience using ApplyOnline, Loanapp, or Simpology for commercial submissions

Cert IV in Finance & Mortgage Broking or equivalent





Education

A bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field is preferred but not required. We value hands-on Australian asset finance experience above qualifications. Candidates without a degree but with 2+ years of direct broker support experience are strongly encouraged to apply.



What We Offer



Competitive base salary based on experience

HMO coverage

Leave credits

13th Month Pay

Career growth — we're building a 50+ person capability centre within 12 months





About the Role

This is a direct broker support role — you work for the broker, not a lender or bank. You are the engine behind the broker's business, managing their asset finance pipeline, keeping deals moving, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks between application and settlement.

You'll be part of Pierian Australia's dedicated back-office capability centre, supporting Australian asset finance brokers across commercial equipment, vehicles, technology, and other asset classes.

description:
Sales Development Representative (SDR) — Outbound / Cold Outreach Specialist



Company:       MyMentor Insights (by Peoplogica)

Type:                   Part-time, 20+ hrs/week, long term contract, performance bonuses



About Us

MyMentor Insights is a 360-degree feedback and AI-powered leadership development platform, used by coaches, HR teams, and leadership development providers to run assessments and build personalized development plans for their people. We're growing our outbound sales pipeline and need someone who can own the full top-of-funnel process, not run ads, not "do marketing," but actually get on
 and phone and talk to prospects. Learn more at 
 



The Role

You'll be the engine behind our outbound pipeline. This is a hands-on, execution-heavy role. You're not managing a campaign dashboard, you're personally building lead lists, writing
s, making calls, and following up until a lead is qualified and handed to sales (or nurtured until they're ready). Previous attempts using marketing agencies or "digital marketers" haven't worked for us, we need someone who thinks and acts like an SDR, not an ads manager. The focus will be on the North American market.



Responsibilities

• List building with Apollo: Use 
 (or similar tools like ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) to source and build targeted lead lists based on our ideal customer profile, filtering by industry, company size, role, and other relevant criteria, rather than relying on purchased or static lists

• AI-assisted personalization: Use AI tools to personalize outbound
s at scale. Pulling in relevant context per prospect (industry, role, company size, pain points) rather than sending generic templates

• Cold
 outreach: Write, personalize, and send outbound
 campaigns to targeted prospect lists (coaches, HR leaders, leadership development providers)

• Cold calling: Follow up on
 outreach with phone calls to qualify interest and book meetings

• Lead nurturing: Manage a sequence of follow-ups for leads who show interest but aren't ready to buy. Keep them warm over time without being pushy

• Pipeline management: Track every lead's status in our CRM, keep notes updated, and flag hot leads to the sales team promptly

• Reporting: Provide weekly updates on outreach volume, response rates, calls made, and meetings booked

• Objection handling: Respond to pushback (e.g. "we're too small for this," "we already have a solution") with tailored replies that reframe the value. Not scripted, generic responses



Candidate Profile

Must-haves:

• 2+ years of experience as an SDR, BDR, appointment setter, or outbound sales rep, ideally in B2B SaaS or a similar subscription/services product

• Hands-on experience using Apollo (or similar tools like ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) to build and export lead lists, not just working off lists someone else hands to you

• Experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or purpose-built tools like Clay/Instantly AI personalization) to personalize cold
 at scale. Should be able to explain their actual workflow, not just say "I use AI"

• Demonstrated cold calling experience, comfortable picking up the phone, not just hiding behind
 templates

• Strong written English, clear, professional, persuasive without sounding like a template

• Self-directed, can run outbound campaigns independently without needing daily hand-holding

• Comfortable with CRM tools for tracking and follow-up

• Resilient, can handle rejection and objections without losing momentum (cold outbound has a low hit rate, and that's normal)



Nice-to-haves:

• Experience selling to HR, L&D, or coaching/consulting audiences

• Familiarity with leadership development, 360 feedback, or assessment tools

• Experience combining Apollo + AI personalization + a sending tool (e.g. Apollo ? Clay/AI enrichment ? Instantly/Smartlead) as a full outbound stack



When Responding to this brief:

Applications will only be considered if you have proven SDR/BDR experience including telephone calling, so please clearly articulate your relevant experience/attributes/successes at the top of your application. Please also inform us what software/other you would expect us to supply so that you can perform at the highest level.



This role is for the North American market, we are also advertising for a similar job but for Peoplogica’s tests and assessments which will focus on the Australasian market. You do not have to apply for both, just let us know which role you are most interested in (we will be employing two part-time providers)

title: Senior Executive Assistant to Founder | Remote | Part-Time
description:
I’m looking for an exceptional, highly experienced Executive Assistant to work closely with me as the founder of Gaiama, a Singapore-based experiential culinary company creating chef-led dining experiences in extraordinary places around the world.



This is a long-term, part-time remote role for someone who is proactive, highly organised, fast, resourceful and exceptionally detail-oriented. You will support me primarily across Gaiama, alongside some personal and family administration, and occasionally support other team members on specific projects.



I am not looking for someone who simply waits for a list of tasks. I’m looking for an experienced EA who learns how I work, anticipates what needs to happen and takes ownership of getting it done.



My goal is eventually to be able to CC you on an
 and trust that you will identify the actions, ask only the questions you genuinely need answered, and close the loop without me having to manage the process.



What you’ll be responsible for



Your work will include:



* Managing calendar administration, scheduling meetings, creating video links and sending calendar invitations

* Researching flights, hotels and travel options, preparing itineraries and coordinating bookings

* Researching restaurants and making reservations internationally

* Managing expenses, receipts and expense reports

* Processing and tracking invoices and liaising with accountants/bookkeepers where required

* Making business and personal purchases and tracking deliveries

* Maintaining organised digital files and documentation

* Maintaining contact and CRM information

* Following up with suppliers, partners and other contacts and ensuring outstanding actions are closed

* Making international calls and communicating with suppliers, restaurants, hotels and other contacts

* Supporting personal and family administration, including appointments, travel, reservations, gifts, purchases and paperwork

* Learning and maintaining administrative systems including Procim

* Supporting other members of the Gaiama team with specific administrative tasks such as travel or ordering when required



The scope may evolve over time. For someone interested and capable, there is potential for the role to grow in hours and into broader project coordination or operations responsibilities as Gaiama grows.



Who I’m looking for



You should have:



* At least 7 years of relevant professional experience

* At least 3 years of proven experience as an Executive Assistant supporting a founder, entrepreneur, C-suite executive or similarly senior leader

* Proven success working remotely with international businesses or executives, ideally from the US, UK, Europe or Australia

* Exceptional spoken and written English

* Excellent judgement and the confidence to take initiative without waiting for detailed instructions

* Extremely high standards of organisation, accuracy and presentation

* Strong research skills and the ability to turn large amounts of information into clear recommendations

* The ability to manage multiple priorities, follow through and close loops

* A proactive, responsive, fast and resourceful working style

* Confidence communicating professionally with senior clients, suppliers and partners

* Strong digital skills and the ability to learn unfamiliar software quickly and independently

* Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT intelligently and responsibly to improve your work

* Your own Mac and a reliable high-speed internet connection

* A high level of discretion. You will have access to confidential business and personal information and will be required to sign an NDA.



A university degree is preferred.



Particularly valuable experience



Experience supporting a startup founder or entrepreneur is highly desirable.



Previous experience in event production, experiential marketing, hospitality, luxury, travel, a creative agency or another fast-moving project-based environment would be a significant advantage.



French or another additional language is a bonus, but not required.



Systems



Our current tools include Outlook, Apple Calendar, Google Workspace, Slack, WhatsApp, HubSpot, Dropbox, Excel/Google Sheets, Xero, Procim, Canva, Webflow, LinkedIn, ChatGPT, Google Meet, Zoom and Microsoft Teams.



You do not need experience with every system. I care much more about your ability to learn new technology quickly and independently.



Hours and working style



This is an ongoing part-time role of approximately 80 hours per month.



The hours are deliberately flexible rather than a fixed four-hour daily shift. Workload varies across the month and I travel internationally frequently, so some weeks will naturally be busier than others.



I need someone who maintains regular weekday availability, is generally reachable during Singapore business hours and can manage their workload independently. You may have other clients, but reliability and responsiveness are essential. During normal weekday working hours, I generally expect messages and new requests to be acknowledged within one hour, even if the task itself will be completed later.



There will occasionally be requirements outside normal Singapore/Philippines working hours due to international travel or events. These will be the exception rather than the norm, and working hours can flex accordingly.



Compensation



SGD 1,500–2,000 per month depending on experience, based on approximately 80 hours per month.



Exceptional candidates with particularly relevant senior EA, founder support and/or events or hospitality experience may be considered above this range.



This will be an independent contractor relationship, paid monthly.



For the right person, I am looking to build a long-term working relationship. The role has the potential to increase in hours, responsibility and scope as Gaiama grows.



Target start date is September/Q4 2026, but finding the right person is more important than starting quickly.



How to apply



Please do not send a generic cover letter.



Instead, introduce yourself briefly and answer the following five questions:



1. Tell me about the founder or senior executive you have supported most closely. How long did you work together, where were they based, what did you personally own for them, and what did you eventually learn to anticipate without being asked?

2. You are CC’d on an
 confirming that I will attend a three-day conference in Paris next month. I haven’t given you any instructions. What do you do?

3. Tell me about the most complicated international trip you have organised for someone else. What made it complicated and how did you manage it?

4. Which AI tools do you currently use in your work? Give me one specific example of how you have used AI to make your work better or faster while ensuring the final information was accurate.

5. Tell me about any experience you have in events, hospitality, luxury, travel, creative agencies or startup environments.



Please also include:



* Your CV/resume

* Your current availability and any existing client commitments

* Your current or most recent compensation/rate

* Your expected monthly rate for this role



Applications that do not answer the questions above will not be considered.

title: Quantitative Real Estate Investment Analyst – Financial Modeling & Software Development
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Quantitative Real Estate Investment Analyst with exceptional ability to formulate coherent financial logic for complex real estate investment scenarios.



This is not a traditional investment analyst position focused solely on analyzing deals or building Excel models. We are building appFM, a cloud-based financial modeling and investment analysis platform for commercial real estate, and the analyst will work closely with our software engineer to translate sophisticated real estate financial concepts into clear, deterministic financial logic that can be programmed into the software.



The ideal candidate should be highly proficient in:



>Complex real estate investments and capitalization structures

>Cash flow projections and investment return calculations

>Debt and equity structures

>Acquisitions, refinancings, recapitalizations, and dispositions

>Multi-tier equity waterfall and promote modeling

>Partnership and investor-level returns

>Formulating financial logic for unusual or complex investment scenarios

>Translating Excel-based financial modeling concepts into clearly defined logic, formulas, rules, and workflows that a software engineer can implement



You do not need to be a software engineer. However, you must be able to think systematically and work collaboratively with a developer—explaining how calculations should work, identifying edge cases, testing outputs, and helping ensure that the software accurately reflects real-world real estate investment structures.



We are looking for someone who doesn't simply know how to operate an existing financial model, but who can design the financial logic from the ground up and help us turn that logic into a scalable cloud-based financial modeling platform.



Even if you don't have extensive real estate analysis experience, we encourage you to apply if you can demonstrate an exceptional ability to quickly understand complex concepts, think creatively, and formulate clear, sophisticated financial logic.



If interested, please send your resume and, ideally, examples of sophisticated financial models you have built to

title: Product Hunter / Product Architect — Meta & TikTok Winning Products
description:
About us



International e-commerce group running multiple DTC brands across US and European markets. We hire a full-time Product Hunter /

Architect to detect winning and emerging products on Meta and TikTok before saturation, and to design how we beat them.





Mission



Feed our product pipeline with validated, differentiated product opportunities. You find the signal early, you prove it with data, you

propose the version that wins. Sourcing and testing are handled by other teams — your output is decision-ready product briefs.





Operating system — how you will work



Daily: structured hunting sessions (spy tools + organic) ? 3–5 product briefs in our standard template (traction proof, ad/advertiser

count, saturation stage, audience, angle analysis, improvement proposal, verdict).

Weekly: Monday hunting plan (niches, geos, angles to explore this week) + Friday recap (pipeline status, hit rate, what the data taught

us) + one video check-in.

Monthly: performance review on tracked KPIs — briefs delivered, briefs accepted for testing, products scaled.

All work is logged in our PM system (tasks, briefs, statuses). Every brief follows the template — no freestyle reports.





Tools you mastered



- PiPiAds, Minea, WinningHunter, 
 (at least 2

daily)

- TikTok Creative Center, Meta Ad Library, TikTok organic

search

- Google Trends, Amazon/AliExpress best-sellers, competitor

store analysis

- Notion/ClickUp or similar PM tool, Google Sheets, Loom 





Requirements



2+ years product research for dropshipping / DTC stores (name stores or niches in your application).

 A documented personal hunting process — you can explain it step by step and show the forms/templates you use.

 You read WHY a product wins (angle, audience, offer, timing) — not just trending lists.

 Strong written English, structured reporting, reliable daily output.

 Full-time 40h/week, long-term, weekly video check-in.





Conditions



Competitive monthly salary based on demonstrated skill — state your expected salary in your application. Paid on time, every month.

Performance bonus when a product you found scales. Stable long-term role in a growing group.





How to apply (mandatory — applications ignoring this are deleted)



1. Start your application with the word "HUNTER".

2. ONE product currently in early trend phase (not an already-famous winner): proof it is rising, why it works, its main weakness, and

YOUR improved version.

3. Describe your hunting process step by step, from first signal to final recommendation — and attach or screenshot the research

form/template/tracker you personally use.

4. List the exact tools you use daily and your subscription status (own account / previous employer's).

5. Your expected monthly salary (PHP) and earliest start date.

title: Solar Permitting Coordinator
description:
Position Summary

NRG Clean Power is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Solar Permitting Coordinator to join our growing team. In this role, you will act as the crucial link between our design team, project managers, local municipalities (AHJs), and utility companies. You will be responsible for preparing, submitting, and tracking all necessary permit applications to ensure our solar projects are approved accurately and efficiently. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver with excellent communication skills and a strong ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.



Key Responsibilities

Permit Preparation: Assemble and review permit application packages, including structural and electrical engineering designs, site plans, and required jurisdictional forms.



Submission & Tracking: Submit permit applications to local Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs) and Homeowners Associations (HOAs) via online portals, mail, or in-person delivery (expediting).



Interconnection Applications: Prepare and submit utility interconnection applications and track them through to the Final Permission to Operate (PTO) stage.



Relationship Management: Build and maintain positive working relationships with city planners, building departments, and utility representatives to facilitate smooth approvals.



Issue Resolution: Promptly address and resolve any permit rejections, plan check corrections, or requests for additional information by coordinating directly with internal design and engineering teams.

Attention to Detail: Exceptional organizational skills with a proven ability to manage complex paperwork and catch errors before submission.

title: SOP & Process Documentation Specialist
description:
Job Title: SOP & Process Documentation Specialist 

Employment Type: Part-Time (40 hours/week)



Location: Remote (US-Based or Global)



Department: Operations & Systems Infrastructure



About the Role

We are seeking a sharp, highly methodical FULL-Time SOP & Process Documentation Specialist to take full ownership of our internal knowledge architecture and operational playbooks.



Our company operates on an active Waybook workspace. We have clear operational departments—including Dispatch & Route Optimization, Motor Pool & Fleet Inspections, Driver Onboarding & Compliance, and Administrative Workflows—and we need a systemization professional to bridge raw field execution with structured, scalable documentation.



You will not just be writing text; you will be mapping processes, interviewing department leads, establishing testing/quiz completion gates, and building a single source of operational truth.



Key Responsibilities

Waybook Workspace Management: Architect, organize, and maintain our active Waybook platform—structuring Subjects, Categories, Modules, and Documents into a logical, easily navigable hierarchy.



Process Mapping & Workflow Capture: Interview key department heads (Lead Dispatcher, Mechanic, Fleet Coordinators, Compliance Leads) to extract daily operational workflows and convert them into clear, step-by-step SOPs.



Content Creation & Visual Clarity: Write precise, clear, and unambiguous standard operating procedures. Incorporate visual aids, decision trees, workflow diagrams, and screenshots to ensure maximum readability for field personnel and office staff.



Accountability & Training Paths: Build trackable onboarding paths, knowledge-check quizzes, and completion gates inside Waybook to ensure staff and drivers are tested and held accountable to operational standards.



Process Auditing & Continuous Improvement: Regularly review and update documentation as tools, software (Fleetio, CRM systems, dispatch software), and state regulatory requirements evolve. Eliminate duplicate, outdated, or conflicting guidelines.



Terminology & Asset Consistency: Enforce standardized terminology and documentation conventions across all company assets, policies, and operational manuals.



Qualifications & Requirements

Proven Experience in SOP/Process Documentation: 3+ years writing, organizing, and auditing operational manuals, standard operating procedures, and training frameworks.



Platform Proficiency: Direct hands-on experience using Waybook (or comparable systems like Trainual, SweetProcess, Notion, or Process Street).



Information Architecture Skills: Ability to organize complex, multi-departmental information so that end-users (from drivers to managers) can find answers in seconds.



Interview & Extraction Skills: Exceptional interpersonal skills to extract raw, unorganized knowledge from busy subject-matter experts and translate it into structured procedures.



High Detail Orientation & Compliance Mindset: Meticulous approach to grammar, formatting, step ordering, and logical consistency.



Experience in Transportation, Logistics, or Fleet Operations is a strong plus, though not required.



Position Details & Schedule

Job Type: Part-Time



Hours: Approximately 15–20 hours per week (Flexible schedule with clear weekly deliverables).



Location: 100% Remote.



How to Apply (Application Instructions)

To be considered for this role, please submit the following:



Video Introduction (Required): A short (1–2 minute) video introducing yourself (Loom, YouTube link, Google Drive link, or direct file). Briefly tell us about your background in process documentation, your experience with tools like Waybook, and why you thrive in creating structured systems. (Applications without a video introduction will not be reviewed.)



Work Samples: 2–3 samples or portfolio links showing SOPs, process maps, or training documentation you have created in the past.
