title: Admin & Receptionist (Remote - Australian NDIS Provider)
description:
VIRTUAL ASSISTANT / REMOTE RECEPTIONIST



The Positive Behaviour Support Group (PBSG) is an Australian NDIS provider seeking an exceptional part-time to become full-time Virtual Assistant / Remote Receptionist to support administrative operations, client communication, and business growth.



This is a long-term position.







ROLE OVERVIEW



This is a highly structured, process-driven role requiring exceptional professionalism, attention to detail, strong communication skills, and outstanding technological proficiency.



You will work inside a purpose-built system: step-by-step SOPs with annotated screenshots, in-app
 templates that auto-fill and send with a few clicks, custom dashboards that track every task, and automated reminders that catch follow-ups. The tools do a lot of the heavy lifting. What we need from you is speed, accuracy, and the ability to move confidently through software.







IMPORTANT:



– This is a role where reliability, responsiveness, and availability during working hours are essential.

– While workload will continue to grow over time, you must be consistently available to manage enquiries, respond promptly, and support incoming communication.

– You must be highly comfortable with technology and able to learn new software quickly. We use numerous systems (Microsoft 365, a practice management system (Splose), and several custom-built internal tools for phone calls, SMS messaging and administrative tracking) and expect team members to confidently navigate between multiple applications while working efficiently and accurately.

– Speed matters. We are looking for someone who works quickly without compromising accuracy, follows processes efficiently, and continually improves their productivity. Our systems are designed to be easy to follow. We need someone who moves through them fluently, not someone who gets stuck on unfamiliar screens.

– Independent problem-solving matters. While you will receive substantial training and support, when something unfamiliar comes up, we expect you to first check the SOP, search the system, use Google or AI tools, and think it through, then escalate with a clear summary and your suggested solution when a decision is genuinely needed.







RESPONSIBILITIES



– Manage incoming enquiries via
 and online channels

– Respond to new client enquiries and guide stakeholders through the referral process

– Gather key intake information accurately and efficiently

– Maintain clear, calm, and professional communication at all times

– Record notes and update systems

– Assist with scheduling, follow-ups, and general administrative coordination

– Support onboarding and intake processes for new participants

– Maintain and update internal tracking systems, including participant and employee trackers

– Monitor key workflows to ensure tasks are completed and follow-ups are not missed

– Assist with setting up new participants, contacts, and relevant information in internal systems

– Support employee onboarding and administration, including documentation and system setup

– Assist with organising, filtering, and coordinating job applications and interviews

– Help manage recruitment processes, including shortlisting candidates and scheduling interviews

– Perform general administrative tasks to support daily business operations and growth

– Adapt quickly to new systems, software, tools, and responsibilities as the business continues to expand

– Be available during working hours to answer incoming calls through our browser-based phone system

– Return missed calls promptly and professionally

– Follow structured call scripts and communication standards

– Escalate complex or sensitive matters appropriately — with context, what you've already checked, and your suggested next step









REQUIREMENTS



COMMUNICATION



– Excellent written and spoken English (exceptional communication is essential as you will be customer-facing )

– Professional, warm, calm, and confident communication style

– Strong attention to detail

– Ability to handle sensitive conversations professionally



TECHNOLOGY & PRODUCTIVITY



– Excellent computer skills and strong technological proficiency

– Able to quickly learn new software, systems, and workflows

– Fast and efficient when working across multiple systems

– Highly proficient with Microsoft 365, Microsoft Office, and Outlook

– Comfortable learning and using practice management systems and custom dashboards

– Confident navigating multiple applications simultaneously

– Strong typing skills and efficient computer navigation

– Comfortable using AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT) and Google to solve problems independently



WORK ENVIRONMENT



You must have:



– A modern laptop (Windows preferred)

– A high-quality noise-cancelling headset

– A backup power solution (UPS, generator, or equivalent) to prevent downtime during unexpected power outages

– A stable, reliable high-speed internet connection with back-up power

– A professional, organised work-from-home setup with minimal background noise and distractions



The above requirements are essential. If you do not have the above, please avoid applying as we would like to progress only with candidates who we can consider for the position.



EXPERIENCE



Previous experience in administration, customer service, reception, healthcare, or a similar role is highly regarded. Demonstrated speed and fluency with technology is weighted more heavily than years of experience. NDIS experience in highly desirable.







IDEAL CANDIDATE



You are someone who:



– Loves technology and enjoys learning new software

– Works quickly while maintaining excellent attention to detail

– Is highly organised and process-oriented

– Follows systems and SOPs consistently

– Tries to solve problems yourself first, then asks well-structured questions rather than making assumptions

– Communicates professionally without being overly casual

– Builds rapport while maintaining professional boundaries

– Is dependable, responsive, and highly reliable

– Wants a long-term career rather than a short-term job







OUR HIRING PROCESS



We want to be upfront about the process so you know what to expect. There are three stages:



1. First interview - a video call to get to know you, your experience, and your communication style.

2. Second interview - a deeper conversation about the role, our systems, and how you approach problem-solving and unfamiliar situations.

3. Paid practical trial - a short, paid working session (a few hours) in a safe training version of our real systems. You'll follow our actual SOPs to complete realistic tasks - for example, setting up a participant from a referral, sending a templated
, and handling a scenario the SOP doesn't fully cover. Your work is graded on accuracy, speed, and how you handle the unfamiliar. This is a two-way trial: you get to see exactly what the job is like before committing, and we get to see how you work. You are paid for this time regardless of the outcome.



Successful candidates receive a formal offer after the trial.







APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.



To apply, please submit:



1. Your resume.

2. A short video (2–3 minutes) introducing yourself.



Please submit only via onlinejobs.ph messaging. As there anticipate a high volume of enquiries for this position, direct
s will be ignored and blacklisted. Our inbox has a high volume of important
s for our NDIS participants and employees; we do not want to add to our customer response time by receiving applications there. Thank you for understanding.



IN YOUR VIDEO, PLEASE TELL US:



– Who you are

– Your previous experience

– Why you are interested in joining PBSG

– Why you believe you would be a great fit for this role

– Your experience with technology and learning new software. Including a specific example of a time you figured out an unfamiliar system or tool on your own



This video is a mandatory part of the application process and helps us assess your communication skills, professionalism, confidence, and English fluency.







ADDITIONAL INFORMATION



Please only apply if you are extremely confident in your communication skills, technological ability, and capacity to meet a high professional standard. We will be undergoing a thorough and comprehensive interviewing and trial process.



We are hiring for a long-term position and will be carefully screening applications. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



We provide comprehensive step-by-step SOPs with screenshots, structured systems, ongoing training, regular check-ins, and continuous support. Our goal is to develop a strong long-term working relationship with someone who can become a trusted and valued member of our organisation as we continue to grow.







PAY & BENEFITS



– USD $8.00 per hour, plus a 13th-month bonus (pro rata), paid via Wise weekly

– 2 weeks paid personal leave per year (pro rata)

– 5 paid sick days per year (pro rata)

– The practical trial stage is paid at the usual rate.

title: Hospitality / Airbnb Operations Specialist
description:
STR & Hotel Operations Manager



Airbnb | Vrbo | 
 | Expedia | Mews | SiteMinder | Breezeway | PriceLabs



We operate a 39-suite hospitality property that combines the **short-term rental model with traditional hotel operations.**



We are looking for someone with strong experience managing:



* Airbnb

* Vrbo

* 

* Expedia

* OTA listings and distribution

* Short-term rental operations

* Hotel operations

* Dynamic pricing

* Property management systems

* Channel managers

* Property operations software



**This is NOT a basic Virtual Assistant position.**



We are not looking for someone whose experience is limited to answering Airbnb messages, customer service, data entry, or basic administrative work.



We need someone who understands **Airbnb/Vrbo AND hotel/OTA operations** and is technically comfortable enough to understand how all of the systems behind them work together.



OUR TECHNOLOGY STACK



Our operation currently uses:



* Airbnb

* Vrbo

* 

* Expedia

* Mews PMS

* SiteMinder

* Breezeway

* PriceLabs

* Google Drive

* Google Sheets



Experience with several of these systems is strongly preferred.



You do NOT necessarily need experience with every single platform.



However, you MUST have enough real hospitality and short-term rental experience to understand how OTAs, PMS systems, channel managers, pricing systems, reservations, inventory and property operations connect.



 OUR BUSINESS MODEL



Our property is unusual because it combines two hospitality models.



We operate with the infrastructure and systems of a hotel, while our inventory primarily consists of large multi-bedroom suites designed for groups.



We therefore need someone who understands both:



**Airbnb / Vrbo / Short-Term Rentals**



AND



**Hotels / 
 / Expedia / OTA Distribution**



We need someone capable of helping us blend these two worlds into one efficient operation.



AIRBNB, VRBO & OTA MANAGEMENT



You will eventually help take ownership of:



* Airbnb

* Vrbo

* 

* Expedia

* Additional OTAs as we expand



Responsibilities include:



* Creating new listings

* Writing listing titles and descriptions

* Updating existing listings

* Managing photos and listing content

* Updating amenities

* Updating policies

* Managing room and property information

* Checking bedroom/bathroom counts

* Monitoring listing accuracy

* Monitoring availability

* Monitoring rates

* Monitoring minimum stays

* Managing promotions and discounts

* Identifying duplicate listings

* Troubleshooting OTA problems

* Communicating with OTA support

* Monitoring reservation delivery

* Identifying incorrect pricing or availability



You should be comfortable navigating Airbnb, Vrbo, 
 and Expedia without needing the owner to show you where everything is.



LISTING CONTENT



You must be capable of creating professional hospitality listing content.



This includes:



* Airbnb titles

* Airbnb descriptions

* Vrbo descriptions

* 
 content

* Expedia content

* Room descriptions

* Property descriptions

* Amenity descriptions

* House rules

* Guest instructions

* Check-in information



Your written English must be excellent.



We do not want descriptions that sound robotic, generic, poorly translated, or obviously AI-generated.



PMS & CHANNEL MANAGEMENT



Our property uses:



**Mews — PMS**



**SiteMinder — Channel Manager**



You will help manage and troubleshoot:



* Room and space categories

* Rate plans

* Inventory

* Availability

* Restrictions

* Minimum stays

* Reservation delivery

* Channel mappings

* Room mappings

* Rate mappings

* OTA connectivity

* Synchronization problems



You should understand the basic flow of information between:



**Property ? PMS ? Channel Manager ? OTA**



and understand that manually changing something in one system can sometimes be overwritten by another system.



PRICING & REVENUE SYSTEMS



We use PriceLabs for dynamic pricing.



You should understand or be capable of quickly learning:



* Dynamic pricing

* Base rates

* Minimum rates

* Minimum stays

* Event pricing

* Last-minute pricing

* OTA markups

* Promotions

* Length-of-stay discounts

* Channel-specific pricing

* Rate discrepancies



You do not need to be a professional Revenue Manager.



You DO need to recognize when pricing doesn't make sense and know how to investigate why.



BREEZEWAY & PROPERTY OPERATIONS



Breezeway is an important part of our operation.



You will help manage:



* Inspections

* Maintenance tasks

* Cleaning tasks

* Guest-reported issues

* Task assignments

* Due dates

* Open tasks

* Overdue tasks

* Completed tasks

* Staff follow-up

* Property readiness



This job is NOT simply creating tasks.



You need to make sure tasks actually get completed.



If maintenance marks something FINISHED but an inspection shows that the problem still exists, the problem is not finished.



You will be expected to follow up with staff and keep open items visible until they are genuinely resolved.



The owner should NOT have to open Breezeway every night to discover what employees failed to complete.



GOOGLE DRIVE & GOOGLE SHEETS



You must be comfortable using:



* Google Drive

* Google Sheets

* Google Docs

* Shared folders

* File organization

* Filters and sorting

* Basic formulas

* Operational trackers

* Reports



You may receive messy information from several different systems and be expected to organize it into something useful.



THE PERSON WE WANT



We want someone who can receive a message like:



**"
 says sold out, Airbnb has availability, Expedia has the wrong price, a reservation didn't reach Mews, and Breezeway has overdue maintenance tasks."**



And respond:



**"I'm looking into it."**



Then actually figure it out.



You should be able to determine:



* What system is causing the problem

* Where the information originated

* Who needs to be contacted

* What should be changed

* What should NOT be changed

* Whether the problem was actually fixed

* How to prevent it from happening again



We want someone who is:



* Extremely proactive

* Analytical

* Detail-oriented

* Technically comfortable

* Organized

* Persistent

* Independent

* Excellent in English

* Good at troubleshooting

* Comfortable holding staff accountable

* Comfortable communicating with support departments

* Able to learn unfamiliar software quickly



We DO NOT want someone who waits all day for the owner to give them individual tasks.



If you see something wrong, investigate it.



If someone hasn't completed a task, follow up.



If a reservation didn't synchronize, investigate it.



If pricing looks wrong, investigate it.



If a listing contains incorrect information, fix it.



If you cannot solve something, escalate it with a clear explanation of what you already investigated.



**Our goal is for this person to eventually understand our online hospitality operation well enough that ownership does not need to constantly monitor it.**



!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!               REQUIRED APPLICATION TEST BELOW               !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!



Generic applications will not be considered.



Do not simply tell us you are hardworking, organized, proactive, detail-oriented or a fast learner.



**We want to see how you actually think.**



SCENARIO



You manage online operations for a 39-suite hospitality property.



The property sells through:



**Airbnb**



**Vrbo**



**
**



**Expedia**



The property also uses:



**Mews — PMS**



**SiteMinder — Channel Manager**



**PriceLabs — Dynamic Pricing**



**Breezeway — Inspections, Maintenance & Operational Tasks**



You log in one morning and discover:



* Mews shows 5 suites available for a particular date.

* Airbnb shows 5 available.

* 
 shows SOLD OUT.

* Expedia shows availability, but the price is $200 lower than Airbnb.

* PriceLabs appears to show the correct price.

* A 
 reservation received yesterday appears in SiteMinder but is missing from Mews.

* Breezeway shows 12 overdue maintenance tasks.

* Three tasks are marked completed by maintenance, but the most recent inspection shows the same problems still exist.

* One Airbnb listing has an incorrect bedroom count.

* The owner tells you a new room type was created last week and may not have been added everywhere.



You are the only OTA/operations manager working that morning.



QUESTIONS



1. PRIORITIES



What do you investigate first?



Put the problems above in the order you would address them and explain why.



2. 
 AVAILABILITY



Give at least **five possible reasons** 
 could show SOLD OUT while Mews and Airbnb show availability.



What systems would you check and in what order?



3. EXPEDIA PRICING



How would you determine whether Expedia's $200 price difference originates from:



* PriceLabs

* Mews

* SiteMinder

* Expedia

* An OTA promotion or discount



Explain how you would trace the price through the systems.



4. MISSING RESERVATION



The 
 reservation exists in SiteMinder but is missing from Mews.



What do you do?



What would you check before manually entering the reservation into Mews?



5. BREEZEWAY



You have 12 overdue Breezeway tasks.



Explain how you would determine:



* What is urgent

* Who owns each task

* What needs follow-up

* What needs escalation

* What needs to be reopened

* Whether supposedly completed work was actually completed



Do NOT simply answer, "I would follow up with maintenance."



6. FALSE COMPLETION



An employee marks a Breezeway maintenance task FINISHED.



The next inspection shows the exact same problem still exists.



What do you do?



7. AIRBNB LISTING ERROR



An Airbnb listing says:



**4 Bedrooms / 4 Bathrooms**



The actual suite is:



**5 Bedrooms / 5 Bathrooms**



Would you immediately change Airbnb?



What other systems, listings, documents or mappings would you check to make sure the incorrect information does not exist somewhere else?



8. NEW ROOM TYPE



A new room type was created in Mews last week.



What other systems would you check to make sure it was properly configured throughout the entire operation?



9. GOOGLE SHEETS



The owner asks you to create a Google Sheet showing:



* Unit

* Reservation status

* OTA

* Arrival

* Departure

* Open maintenance issues

About the Company

Go Ignite is partnering with an established Australian IT managed services company supporting small and medium businesses across a range of industries. They are known for clear communication and honest advice — the same standard they apply to how they handle their own client accounts.

You will take ownership of the accounts receivable ledger in Xero, working alongside the company's local bookkeeper. This is a client-facing position: you will contact Australian business owners and their accounts teams directly by phone and
 to follow up on outstanding invoices, resolve billing disputes, and secure payment commitments. Where accounts remain unresolved, you will escalate and coordinate suspensions in line with company policy.



This is the company's first offshore hire in this function. You will be establishing how the process runs, not inheriting someone else's version of it. Broader administrative support sits alongside the AR work as the business requires.



Responsibilities:

Monitor the accounts receivable ledger in Xero and identify overdue or at-risk accounts

Contact clients by phone and
 to follow up on outstanding invoices and secure payment

Escalate unresolved accounts and coordinate suspensions in line with company policy

Process and allocate incoming payments, reconcile AR records, and flag discrepancies to the local bookkeeper

title: Cold Caller
description:
We're hiring ONE appointment setter. Not a batch, not a

pool. One seat, one person, long term.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



You call business owners and financial advisors in the US

and Canada from a list we build and enrich for you. You

introduce the offer, qualify them against written

criteria, and book a meeting on our client's calendar.



Then you stay with that prospect. You confirm the meeting,

you remind them, and when someone reschedules or doesn't

show up, you call them back personally and get the meeting

back on the calendar. That last part is the most important

part of this job. Most setters stop at the booking. You

won't.



Roughly 100 to 150 dials a day. We use a dialer, a CRM,

and a script you'll be trained on before your first call.



WHAT WE PROVIDE



- The list. You never prospect or scrape your own leads.

- The script, and training on it before you dial.

- The dialer, CRM, and phone system.

- Direct access to me. I train and brief every setter

  personally. You will not be handed off to a manager.



SCHEDULE



Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time

(9:00 PM to 6:00 AM Philippine Time).



This is a graveyard shift. Please be honest with yourself

about this before applying. If you can't hold this

schedule consistently, this role will not work for you and

we'll both waste our time.



PAY



$700 USD per month base, paid twice monthly.

Plus $25 USD for every appointment you book that actually

shows up.



Consistent performers land 8 to 12 showed appointments a

month, which puts realistic total pay at $900 to $1,000.



REQUIREMENTS



- Clear, confident spoken English. Neutral accent

  preferred but a clear one matters more than a neutral

  one.

- A working headset with a noise-cancelling mic.

- Stable internet, minimum 20 Mbps, with a backup

  connection or a plan for outages.

- A quiet room. No roosters, no tricycles, no family in

  the background. Business owners hang up on background

  noise.

- Willing to be recorded and coached on your calls weekly.



Experience in BPO, telemarketing, or appointment setting

is a plus. It is not required. If you've never done this

and you can hold a conversation with a stranger, apply

anyway. Everyone who passes the screen gets the same

15-minute call.



WHAT THIS IS NOT



- Not commission only.

- Not an unpaid trial.

- Not "build your portfolio."

- Not a client-hopping agency where you get moved every

  month.



HOW TO APPLY



Reply with:



1. The word ORANGE as the first word of your message.

   Applications without it are not read.

2. Your city and your internet speed.

3. A 60-second voice recording introducing yourself and

   answering this question: a business owner says "I'm

   not interested" three seconds into your call. What do

   you say next? Just answer it out loud, unscripted.



The voice recording is the whole application. I'll listen

to that before I read anything else.

title: Outbound B2B Business Development Representative
description:
We are looking for a confident, naturally talkative and highly articulate person with previous experience in B2B outbound calling, lead generation, telemarketing, appointment setting or a similar role.



This is not an inbound customer service or script-reading call centre role. We need someone who genuinely enjoys talking to people, can think quickly, build rapport naturally and turn cold calls into meaningful business conversations and opportunities.



Key Responsibilities & Requirements

Make proactive outbound calls to businesses and reach owners, managers and relevant decision-makers.

Previous experience in a similar outbound calling/business development role is essential.

Speak fluent, clear and professional English with an excellent telephone manner.

Be naturally talkative, personable, confident and engaging — someone for whom conversation comes naturally.

Build rapport quickly and communicate naturally without relying heavily on scripts.

Ask intelligent questions, listen carefully and understand the prospect's business and circumstances.

Explain our business and services clearly and professionally.

Identify and qualify genuine business opportunities rather than simply making high volumes of calls.

Confidently handle objections and rejection without being aggressive or pushy.

Know when to continue a conversation, when to follow up and when to escalate a qualified opportunity.

Accurately summarise each meaningful conversation and enter clear, useful notes into the provided CRM.

Record key details including who was contacted, what was discussed, opportunities identified, objections, agreed actions and next steps.

Schedule, manage and complete follow-up calls, reviewing previous CRM notes and continuing conversations from where they finished.

Maintain an organised pipeline so potential opportunities and follow-ups are not missed.

Have good written English, attention to detail and strong computer/CRM skills.

Be self-motivated, organised and able to work towards measurable KPIs without constant supervision.



The ideal candidate can pick up the phone, confidently start a conversation with a complete stranger, earn their attention, identify an opportunity, document it properly in the CRM and know exactly when and how to follow it up.

title: Architect & Estimating VA for OWSI Flooring & Design + Gemstone Development
description:
We’re on the lookout for an Architect & Estimating Virtual Assistant who’s ready to bring talent, energy, and creativity to our growing team!



This is a joint position with OWSI Flooring & Design and Gemstone Development, two leading Utah-based companies that design and build some of the most beautiful custom homes in the state. From ground-up builds to detailed remodels, we’re looking for someone who can help us turn ideas into full, professional house plans and accurate estimates that our builders can count on.



If you’re passionate about architecture, rendering, and design – and you love collaborating with a driven, positive team – this is your chance to be part of something amazing.



Your Key Responsibilities:



~ Create full residential floor plans, elevations, and layouts using AutoCAD and other professional programs.

~ Develop high-quality, realistic 3D renders that bring spaces to life.

~ Use MeasureSquare (provided by us) to generate takeoffs and integrate data into our estimating system.

~ Confidently communicate with suppliers and subcontractors to gather bids, confirm details, and schedule work.

~ Work directly with the owner and design team on cabinetry, bathroom, and interior layouts.

~ Prepare detailed spec sheets, product lists, and design documentation for projects.

~ Support both companies with a wide range of design, estimating, and coordination tasks as needed for our overall success.



Skills & Qualifications:



~ Strong background in architectural drafting, residential design, and plan creation.

~ Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Revit, Lumion, V-Ray, Enscape, or similar rendering software.

~ Must have and supply your own design and rendering programs.

~ Experience using MeasureSquare for takeoffs and estimating (we provide the license).

~ Familiar with USA and Utah building code standards and residential plan requirements.

~ Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

~ Professional confidence when communicating with suppliers, builders, and subcontractors.

~ High attention to detail, accuracy, and time management.

~ Must have a computer capable of rendering (GPU-ready setup preferred).

~ Familiar with Dropbox, Google Drive, and task management tools like ClickUp or Notion.

~ Must be solution-oriented — we value people who take initiative and figure things out.



Bonus Skills (Preferred but Not Required):



~ Background in interior design or finish selection.

~ Experience with cabinet layouts, millwork drawings, or custom room detailing.

~ Previous estimating experience for finish materials (tile, flooring, lighting, cabinetry, etc.).

~ Experience working with US-based builders or construction companies.



Schedule and Work Requirements:



~ Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Mountain Standard Time (Utah Time)

~ Must work live on screen with the owner and team during those hours.

~ Must be available for occasional urgent needs outside of schedule.

~ High productivity and strong results will lead to more hours, growth, and long-term opportunities.

~ Use of Hubstaff for Time Tracking is a must



About OWSI & Gemstone Development:



OWSI Flooring & Design and Gemstone Development are Utah-based companies that work together to create high-end custom homes and luxury remodels. Through OWSI, we partner with builders to supply design-driven products and finishes. Through Gemstone, we design and build one-of-a-kind custom homes across Utah.



We value hard work, honesty, creativity, and a team spirit. Our ideal teammate is confident, resourceful, and passionate about doing excellent work — someone who wants to grow with us for years to come.



How to Apply:

Please include the following in your application:



1) Subject line: “Architect & Estimating VA – Building Utah’s Best Homes!”

2) A short video introduction (1–2 minutes) telling us about your background, your experience with architectural design, rendering, and estimating, and why you’d be a great fit for our team.

3) Links to your portfolio or work samples (AutoCAD plans, renders, or similar).

4) A short written summary describing the design and rendering programs you use, along with your computer specifications.

5) Confirmation that you are available M–F, 8AM–5PM Mountain Standard Time.

title: Practice Manager
description:
FULL-TIME VIRTUAL PRACTICE MANAGER – AUSTRALIAN ALLIED HEALTH CLINIC



Location: Philippines – Work From Home

Hours: Full-Time – 38–40 hours per week (8am-5pm) 

Schedule: Australian business hours

Business: Inner Balance Health – Darwin, Australia

Position: Virtual Practice Manager / Operations Manager



ABOUT INNER BALANCE HEALTH: 

Inner Balance Health is a growing multidisciplinary allied health and rehabilitation clinic based in Darwin, Australia.



Our services include:

Physiotherapy: Neurological rehabilitation, Seniors rehabilitation, Community and home-visit physiotherapy, Hydrotherapy & Sports physiotherapy and rehabilitation

Exercise Physiology: Aged care independent and group session gym 

Remedial Massage

Clinical Pilates

Studio Reformer Pilates

24/7 Pilates

Recovery services including sauna, ice baths and compression therapy



We work with private clients as well as a wide range of Australian healthcare and funding programs including 

NDIS, DVA, Medicare/EPC, Home Care Packages, Short-Term Restorative Care, Workers Compensation, Motor vehicle, and private health insurance. 



We are growing and looking for an exceptional Full-Time Virtual Practice Manager who can take ownership of the administrative and operational side of the clinic - This will be taking over a current role. - Handovers will be provided. 



This is NOT a basic Virtual Assistant position.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a key member of our leadership team and help us build an extremely organised, structured and well-run healthcare business.



THE ROLE

- As our Virtual Practice Manager, you will work closely with the Clinic Director and Clinical Lead to ensure the clinic operates smoothly every day.

- Your job is to manage, organise, follow up, problem-solve and make sure things actually get done.

- We don't want someone who needs to be constantly told what to do.

- We want someone who notices problems, finds solutions, follows things through and takes genuine ownership of their role.

- You will help manage our reception/admin team and become the central point for many of the clinic's administrative systems and processes.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

1. DAILY PRACTICE MANAGEMENT

You will oversee the day-to-day administrative operations of the clinic, including:

* Ensuring the clinic runs smoothly each day

* Monitoring reception and administrative workflows

* Ensuring tasks are completed correctly and on time

* Following up outstanding tasks

* Identifying problems before they become bigger problems

* Escalating important issues to the Director or Clinical Lead

* Maintaining clinic calendars, schedules and operational checklists

* Keeping the Director informed without requiring the Director to micromanage

* Creating structure and accountability across the administrative team



2. RECEPTION & CLIENT EXPERIENCE

You will oversee and assist with:

* Incoming and outgoing phone calls

*
s

* New client enquiries

* Appointment bookings

* Appointment changes and cancellations

* Waitlists

* Client follow-ups

* Practitioner diaries

* Referral management

* Client forms and documentation

* Ensuring clients receive an excellent experience from their first enquiry through to completion of treatment



!!!!!   You must be extremely confident speaking English on the phone !!!!!!



You will be communicating with Australian clients, healthcare professionals, doctors, case managers, support coordinators and funding organisations.



3. CLINIKO & PRACTITIONER SCHEDULE MANAGEMENT

You will become an expert in our practice management system, **Cliniko**.



Responsibilities include:

* Managing practitioner schedules

* Monitoring appointment utilisation

* Identifying gaps in practitioner diaries

* Managing waitlists

* Following up cancellations

* Ensuring appointments are booked correctly

* Monitoring recurring appointments

* Checking client information is complete

* Ensuring referrals and funding information are recorded correctly

* Supporting practitioners with administrative issues

* Helping improve diary utilisation and clinic efficiency



Previous Cliniko experience 
sirable, but experience with another healthcare practice-management system is also valuable.



4. AUSTRALIAN HEALTHCARE FUNDING & BILLING

You will receive training, but you will ultimately be expected to become highly knowledgeable in our different health funding streams.



These include:

* NDIS

* DVA

* Medicare / EPC / Chronic Condition Management

* Workers Compensation

* Home Care Packages

* Short-Term Restorative Care

* Private Health Insurance

* HICAPS

* Private-paying clients



You will help ensure:



* Referrals are valid

* Funding approvals are current

* Correct practitioners are linked to services

* Billing information is correct

* Treatment limits are monitored

* Required documentation is received

* Funding does not expire unnoticed

* Clients and referrers are followed up when required

* Outstanding accounts are followed up

* Administrative billing processes are completed correctly



**Accuracy is extremely important.**



5. REFERRALS & EXTERNAL STAKEHOLDERS



You will help manage relationships and communication with:

* General Practitioners

* Specialists

* NDIS Support Coordinators

* Plan Managers

* Home Care Package providers

* Case Managers

* Workers Compensation insurers

* DVA

* Hospitals

* Aged-care providers

* Community organisations

* Other referral partners



This includes monitoring incoming referrals, following up missing information and ensuring communication does not get lost.



6. ADMIN TEAM MANAGEMENT



A major part of your role will be helping lead our administrative / reception team.



You will:

* Delegate tasks

* Monitor task completion

* Follow up incomplete work

* Train team members

* Help onboard new staff

* Maintain reception procedures

* Create checklists

* Conduct quality checks

* Identify recurring errors

* Provide feedback

* Improve workflows

* Help create accountability within the team



You need to be comfortable **leading people**, not simply completing your own task list.



7. SYSTEMS, SOPs & ORGANISATION



One of our biggest priorities is making Inner Balance Health extremely structured and systemised.



You will help us:



* Create Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

* Maintain SOPs

* Build checklists

* Document clinic processes

* Create training resources

* Improve workflows

* Organise shared files and documents

* Maintain templates

* Build repeatable systems

* Identify inefficiencies

* Automate processes where appropriate

* Ensure staff actually follow the systems we create



We want someone who LOVES organisation.



If you see a messy process, your instinct should be: "How can I make this simpler, clearer and repeatable?"



8. STAFF ONBOARDING & TRAINING



You will help coordinate onboarding for new team members, including:

* Employment documentation

* Accounts and software access

* Training schedules

* Policies and procedures

* Practice-management software training

* Clinic services training

* Funding and billing training

* Administrative processes

* Communication systems

* Onboarding checklists

* Following up completion of required training



9. ROSTERS, TIMESHEETS & PAYROLL SUPPORT



You will assist with:



* Administrative rosters

* Staff availability

* Leave requests

* Timesheets

* Checking hours

* Payroll preparation

* Contractor information

* Staff documentation

* Following up missing information



Experience with Australian payroll or bookkeeping is highly desirable.



10. ACCOUNTS & BOOKKEEPING SUPPORT



Depending on your experience, responsibilities may include:



* Monitoring accounts

* Following up outstanding invoices

* Reconciling payments

* Preparing information for bookkeeping/accounting

* Checking invoices

* Expense organisation

* Basic reporting

* Assisting with payroll preparation

* Maintaining financial administration systems



Formal accounting qualifications are **not required**, but strong numerical skills and bookkeeping experience would be highly regarded.



11. PILATES & MEMBERSHIP OPERATIONS



Inner Balance Health also operates Pilates and recovery services.



You will help oversee administrative systems relating to:



* Studio Pilates

* Clinical Pilates

* 24/7 Pilates

* Memberships

* Recovery memberships

* Client enquiries

* Membership changes

* Payments

* Class bookings

* Client communication

* Instructor administration



12. REPORTING & KPIs



We want our Practice Manager to help us run the business using data rather than guesswork.



You will help monitor things such as:



* New enquiries

* New client conversions

* Practitioner utilisation

* Diary gaps

* Cancellations

* No-shows

* Rebooking

* Outstanding accounts

* Referral numbers

* Administrative performance

* Memberships

* Other operational KPIs



You should be comfortable using **Excel / Google Sheets** and learning how to create simple management reports.



13. RECRUITMENT SUPPORT



You may also assist with:



* Posting job advertisements

* Reviewing applications

* Shortlisting candidates

* Organising interviews

* Communicating with applicants

* Reference checks

* Preparing onboarding

* Maintaining recruitment trackers



14. WORKING DIRECTLY WITH THE DIRECTOR



You will work closely with the business owner/director.



A major goal of this position is to allow the Director to focus on:



* Leadership

* Coaching the team

* Clinical development

* Recruitment

* Financial oversight

* Strategy

* Business development

* Quality and compliance

* Growing the clinic



Rather than constantly managing small administrative problems.



You therefore need to be someone who can say: "I've handled it"



Not: "What do you want me to do?"



for every small decision.



# WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone who is:



* Extremely organised

* Reliable

* Proactive

* Intelligent

* Detail-oriented

* Confident

* Calm under pressure

* A strong communicator

* Comfortable managing people

* Comfortable making decisions

* Excellent at following through

* Good at prioritising

* Able to manage multiple projects

* Naturally interested in improving systems

* Comfortable learning new software

* Able to work independently

* Happy to ask questions when genuinely required

* Accountable for mistakes and willing to learn from them



Most importantly:



**You take ownership.**







ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS



You MUST have:



* Excellent spoken English

* Excellent written English

* Minimum 2 years' relevant professional experience

* Previous experience in administration, operations, practice management, healthcare administration, executive assistance or team leadership

* Experience managing multiple responsibilities

* Strong computer skills

* Excellent attention to detail

* Excellent organisational skills

* Confidence speaking with Australian clients over the phone

* Reliable high-speed internet

* Reliable computer

* Quiet professional work environment

* Ability to work Australian business hours

* Ability to attend video meetings

* Long-term availability



# HIGHLY DESIRABLE EXPERIENCE



We would LOVE to hear from candidates with experience in:



* Australian healthcare

* Allied health

* Physiotherapy clinics

* Medical practices

* Practice management

* Medical Virtual Assistant roles

* Cliniko

* NDIS

* DVA

* Medicare

* Workers Compensation

* Home Care Packages

* Private health insurance

* HICAPS

* Bookkeeping

* Payroll

* Team leadership

* SOP creation

* Process improvement

* Recruitment

* KPI reporting



You do **not** need to know every Australian healthcare system already.



We will provide training.



However, you must demonstrate that you are capable of learning complex systems and eventually **owning them**.



WHAT WE OFFER



* Full-time long-term position

* Work from home

* Stable Australian employer

* Australian daytime working hours

* Extensive training

* Opportunity to develop expertise in Australian healthcare administration

* Direct involvement with the business owner

* Significant responsibility and autonomy

* Opportunity to grow into a senior operational leadership position

* Be part of a growing allied-health business rather than simply completing repetitive VA tasks



For the right person, we want this to become a **long-term career with Inner Balance Health.**







IMPORTANT – APPLICATION PROCESS



We are intentionally making our application process detailed because we are looking for an exceptional person.



ROUND 1 – APPLICATION



Please send:

1. Your CV / Resume

2. A short cover letter

3. Your previous relevant work experience

4. Details of any healthcare, medical, allied-health or Australian business experience that you know of 

5. Your expected hourly/monthly salary

6. Confirmation that you can work full-time Australian business hours



7. A link to your **application video** 



## VIDEO APPLICATION IS MANDATORY - applications without video will be overlooked/ discarded. 

**Applications without a video will NOT progress to Round 2.**



Please record a **3–5 minute video** introducing yourself.



You do NOT need professional editing. We want to hear directly from you.



In your video, please answer:



**1. Tell us about yourself and your professional background.**



**2. Why do you believe you have the skills to be the Practice Manager Inner Balance Health needs?**



**3. Tell us about a previous role where you were responsible for keeping a business, team or department organised. What did you personally manage?**



**4. Give us an example of a problem you identified and solved without waiting for your manager to tell you what to do.**



**5. Have you ever managed or supervised other staff? If yes, tell us how you managed accountability and performance.**



**6. Tell us about your experience with healthcare administration, billing, practice-management software, bookkeeping, payroll or similar systems.**



**7. If you started with us and found that our administrative systems were disorganised, what would you do in your first 30 days?**



**8. Why are you looking for a long-term position, and why does this particular role interest you?**



**9. What do you know about the Australian health care system?, especially when discussing Private Physiotherapy clinic health care? **



Please upload the video to **Loom or Google Drive** or another accessible platform and include the link with your application.



Make sure we have permission to view it.



# ROUND 2 – INTERVIEW



Only applicants who demonstrate the required communication, experience, initiative and leadership potential through their written application **and video** will be selected for a second-round video interview.



Further stages may include a practical skills assessment and final interview.



---



# PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF:



* You are looking for a temporary role

* You cannot work Australian business hours

* You are uncomfortable speaking to clients on the phone

* You require constant supervision

* You regularly need to be reminded to complete tasks

* You dislike managing people

* You struggle with detailed administrative work

* You are applying to dozens of VA jobs without reading the job description

* You are unwilling to complete the video application



---



## HOW TO APPLY

Please use the subject/title:

**"IBH PRACTICE MANAGER – [YOUR NAME]"**

In the **first sentence of your application**, please write:

**"I have read the entire Practice Manager job description and understand that a video application is required."**



Then include your:

* CV

* Cover letter

* Relevant experience

* Expected salary

* Australian-hours availability

* Video link



**Incomplete applications will not progress to the next stage.**



We are excited to find someone exceptional who wants to grow with Inner Balance Health and become a genuinely important part of our team.

title: Appointment Setter — US Marketing Agency (HVAC Cold Calling, Long-Term)
description:
NeuroBoost Media is a Meta ads agency serving home-service businesses (HVAC, roofing, painting) across the United States. We're a small, growing team hiring dedicated appointment setters to become a core part of what we're building. This is not a temporary gig — we want people who will grow with us long-term.



SCHEDULE



Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM US Pacific Time (roughly 12 AM to 8 AM Philippines time). Graveyard shift — you must be able to commit to this schedule long-term.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- 100 to 150 outbound calls per day to HVAC business owners in the United States

- Follow our proven script and playbook (full training provided)

- Book qualified discovery meetings on our founder's calendar

- Log every call in our custom-built dialer tool

- Get real-time AI coaching during every call — our custom tool shows you exact lines to say, objection responses, and warnings if you're going off-script. You will never be alone on a call.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Near-native American English pronunciation — this is non-negotiable, HVAC business owners in the US need to hear an accent they trust

- Minimum 6 months of prior outbound cold-calling or appointment-setting experience

- Stable high-speed internet, quiet home office, reliable computer, and quality headset

- Thick skin — you can handle rejection and push through 100+ dials a day without losing energy

- Someone who wants long-term stability, not a stopgap job between other work



COMPENSATION



We don't pay for showing up — we pay for work done. Here's the structure:



- Week 1 (Trial Week): $200 USD, released only after you complete 300 dials during your first week. If you don't hit 300 dials, you don't get paid for that week. This is intentional — it filters out non-serious applicants and ensures we're both committed before we invest further in each other.

- Base (Week 2 onward): $1,000 USD per month, paid weekly, contingent on maintaining a minimum of 100 dials per working day.

- Meeting Bonus: $30 USD for every qualified meeting you book.

- Retainer Sign Bonus: $300 USD for every client that signs a retainer from meetings you booked.

- Realistic top performers earn $1,800 to $2,500 USD per month total.



A qualified meeting is defined as one where the prospect (a) attends the scheduled call, (b) is the owner or decision-maker, and (c) operates an HVAC business with at least 2 trucks. Meeting bonuses are paid weekly for meetings that meet all three criteria.



TRAINING AND SUPPORT



- Script and playbook training on Day 1 before you start dialing (unpaid — this is your investment in the role, same as we invest in you)

- Access to recorded example calls

- Direct daily support from the founder

- Team Slack channel with other appointment setters

- Real-time AI coaching tool active on every call you make



HOW TO APPLY



Applications without answers to all 3 questions below will be ignored:



1. How many months of outbound cold-calling experience do you have, and in what industry or industries?



2. What are you currently doing during 12 AM to 8 AM Philippines time, and how will you commit to this graveyard schedule long-term?



3. Record a 60-second voice sample introducing yourself as if you were opening a cold call to a US HVAC business owner. Attach the audio file to your application, or upload it to a public hosting site like SoundCloud or YouTube and include the link in your application.



We respond to serious candidates within 48 hours.

title: Sales & CS Team Lead
description:
About Us

We're Premium Invention — an e-commerce company selling premium solar-powered security cameras to ranchers, farmers, and property owners across North America. Seven years in business, growing rapidly, and expanding our product line. Customer experience is our top priority, and our support team is becoming a revenue channel. We're hiring the person who leads that shift.



About This Role

You'll run the day-to-day of our CS team and turn it into a team that sells. This is a player-coach position: you coach agents daily, handle escalations, keep quality high, and take frontline shifts when volume demands it. You'll own the numbers that matter — conversion on pre-sale conversations, upsells, saved refunds, and reviews earned.

Our Head of CX is building the systems side — automation, retention, customer journey design. You take the floor so she can focus there. She'll be your manager and closest partner.



What You'll Own

- Daily coaching and development of every agent — with a sales lens on every customer interaction

- Pre-sale conversations on chat and
: buyers asking "will this work on my property?" and turning those into conversions

- Upsells and cross-sells inside support: accessories, bundles, plan upgrades

- Save attempts on refund and cancellation requests before revenue is lost

- End-to-end escalation handling

- QA scorecards, KPI tracking, and performance conversations with agents

- Systematically turning strong support moments into public reviews

- Sales flows and scripts for our chatbot

- A weekly voice-of-customer report to marketing and product: top objections, confusions, and feature requests straight from tickets



What This Role Requires

- 5+ years of sales experience with results you can show us — real numbers, not just "I supported the team"

- 2+ years leading or coaching a team with clear examples of how you improved performance

- Excellent spoken and written English — our customers are 50+ American property owners who value straight talk

- Comfortable learning technical products quickly. Our cameras involve SIM cards, solar charging, signal strength, and app setup. You don't need an engineering background — you need to enjoy figuring things out and explaining them simply to frustrated customers

- Experience in e-commerce or physical products is a strong plus

- Available during US business hours, with flexibility for early/late hours when team coordination requires it

- Availability: 8 hours on weekdays + half day on weekends (44 hours/week total)

- Comfortable with time tracking (Hubstaff)



Who Should NOT Apply

- Pure inbound CS agents with no sales or management experience 

- People who've only managed chatbots or automation — this role is hands-on with humans

- Managers who coach from dashboards but can't jump into a live conversation and handle it better than their team 



What We Offer

- $1,800–2,300/month depending on experience

- Performance bonuses tied directly to the revenue your team generates

- A company that promotes on proof — both personal & career growth path

- Full-time, long-term role



How to Apply

- Do not message on onlinejobs.ph 

- Complete the form: (10-15minutes)





Take your time to show us how you think and share your experience, we value your time and will carefully review each application. Strong candidates are invited to interview within 48 hours.

title: Social Media Specialist (Content Creator)
description:
About Homeish

Homeish is a new website and soon-to-be mobile app for home enthusiasts. We give homeowners, renters, and property owners a utility-focused platform to manage, track, and archive everything they do to their home – from project budgets to timelines, photos, and ideas – and share it with other home enthusiasts. We prioritize an authentic, real-life utility brand over high-gloss corporate polish. We also follow a strict "No-Noise" Rule—meaning our platform and content are 100% free from politics, news, sports, and controversial topics. 



The Role

We are looking for a creative, highly organized Social Media Specialist to design and draft social media content for our brand.

Important: Your role is to create content for review. You will upload graphics, carousels, videos, and captions into our scheduling platform (PostFlow), which our team will review before publishing.



Primary Responsibilities

-->Platform Content Creation: Suggestions below, but you are the expert and we are looking to you to lead and execute the social media strategy.

*Instagram: Design "Aesthetic Utility" carousels featuring home ideas and organized timelines.

*TikTok: Create UI walkthroughs and "Silent Solutions" (ASMR/lo-fi) style short video content.


: Draft trust-building community posts, "Neighbor" advice threads, and home milestone posts.

*Reddit: Seed engaging, helpful conversations in niche subreddits (e.g., r/Homeish).

-->Content Pillars: Focus on raw "Before & After" or "In-Progress" footage, high-quality room imagery, and direct home management tips.

-->Social SEO: Write SEO-friendly captions using high-density keywords (e.g., "home project tracker," "renovation timeline") in the first two lines.

-->Scheduling: Set up all draft posts inside PostFlow for quick team approval.



Hard Skills Required

-->Graphic & Video Design: Proficiency in Canva, Figma, CapCut, Adobe Creative Suite or other graphic/video design software.

-->Social SEO: Strong understanding of keyword optimization for Instagram and TikTok captions.

-->Content Adaptation: Ability to take one concept and format it cleanly across multiple platforms (IG, TikTok,
, Reddit).

-->Tool Familiarity: Experience using social schedulers like PostFlow.



Soft Skills Required

-->Lo-Fi Aesthetic Sense: Ability to appreciate and create real, raw, "authentic" content rather than overly glossy, corporate ads.

-->Attention to Detail: Excellent written English skills with a clean, organized, and helpful brand voice.

-->Self-Starter: Able to work independently following our brand guidelines.



How to Apply

To apply, please send a message with the following:

-->Subject Line: Must be "Homeish Content Creator - [Your Name]"

-->First Sentence of Your Message: Start your message with a description of one home project you’ve done so we know you’ve read this entire job post.

We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: SaaS Operations & Automation Specialist — Data Quality & Client Delivery
description:
FULL-TIME | LONG-TERM | REMOTE | APPROXIMATELY 40 HOURS PER WEEK | U.S. CENTRAL TIME OVERLAP



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are building a new technology-enabled data-intelligence and operational-review service for businesses in the United States.



Our work involves reviewing information from multiple business systems, identifying conflicts and missing actions, verifying evidence, and producing clear reports showing clients what deserves attention.



We are looking for our first full-time operations and automation specialist. This person will help shape the service from its early stages and may grow into a central operational and client-facing role.



This is not a basic virtual-assistant position. It is also not a traditional software-development position.



The right person will combine:



* Investigative and analytical judgment

* Excellent attention to detail

* Comfort working with messy or conflicting information

* Automation and technical ability

* Clear written and spoken English

* Reliable follow-through

* The ability to eventually communicate confidently with U.S. clients



Industry experience is not required. We can teach the industry. We are looking for someone who is naturally careful, curious, honest, dependable, and capable of working through unfamiliar problems.



Because this is an early-stage project, specific industry details, workflows, and client applications will be shared with serious finalists rather than disclosed publicly.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



* Review information from Excel, CSV files, Google Sheets, PDFs, database exports, calendars, photographs, and other business records.

* Compare multiple sources and identify inconsistencies, missing information, unusual records, and unfinished operational actions.

* Investigate findings carefully instead of assuming the first result is correct.

* Separate verified findings from possibilities requiring additional evidence.

* Assign appropriate confidence levels and preserve the evidence supporting each finding.

* Help create repeatable workflows for reviewing each client’s information.

* Build and improve automations using tools such as n8n, Make, Zapier, Power Automate, APIs, scripts, or similar systems.

* Create clean client reports, exception lists, trackers, and internal documentation.

* Perform quality control before findings are presented to clients.

* Explain technical or data-related findings in simple language.

* Join selected U.S. client calls after training.

* Track open questions, blockers, next actions, and deadlines.

* Help turn an early-stage service into a dependable and scalable operation.

* Handle confidential company and client information responsibly.



You will never be expected to present an uncertain result as a verified fact. If the evidence is incomplete, we expect you to say so and explain what should be checked next.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Excellent written English

* Strong enough spoken English for future U.S. client conversations

* Advanced comfort with Excel or Google Sheets

* Experience reviewing, cleaning, reconciling, or analyzing messy data

* Experience with automation, integrations, databases, APIs, or technical workflows

* Strong research and problem-solving ability

* Exceptional attention to detail

* Ability to document work clearly

* Ability to work independently without guessing when instructions or evidence are incomplete

* Willingness to ask thoughtful questions and identify risks

* Ability to handle confidential information appropriately

* Dependable internet connection and a reliable computer

* Availability for approximately 40 hours per week

* Availability for meaningful overlap with U.S. Central Time and scheduled client calls

* Interest in a serious, long-term position



We care more about demonstrated ability, judgment, and reliability than degrees or job titles.



HELPFUL BUT NOT REQUIRED



* Experience with n8n, Make, Zapier, Power Automate, Airtable, SQL, Python, APIs, or similar tools

* SaaS operations or implementation experience

* Data-quality, quality-assurance, audit, research, or business-analysis experience

* Experience creating client-facing reports

* Experience speaking directly with U.S. business owners

* Experience helping build a new process, product, or service from an early stage



THIS ROLE MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU



* Enjoy solving problems that do not have perfectly clean instructions.

* Want to understand why information conflicts instead of merely correcting a spreadsheet.

* Notice small details that other people overlook.

* Can distinguish between a verified fact, a reasonable possibility, and an unsupported assumption.

* Are comfortable saying, “I do not know yet, but here is how I would find out.”

* Like building processes that become more accurate and efficient over time.

* Can communicate with both technical and nontechnical people.

* Want responsibility and growth rather than repetitive task work.



DO NOT APPLY IF YOU



* Only want to write code and do not enjoy investigation, documentation, or communication.

* Need every step explained before you can make progress.

* Frequently guess when information is missing.

* Are uncomfortable having your work carefully reviewed.

* Are looking for a short-term position or a second full-time job.

* Cannot reliably provide meaningful overlap with U.S. Central Time.

* Are unwilling to follow reasonable confidentiality and data-handling requirements.



SCHEDULE



* Full-time, long-term, and remote

* Approximately 40 hours per week

* Monday through Friday

* Meaningful overlap with U.S. Central Time is required

* Finalists may be asked to complete a short paid work sample before an offer is made

* Serious finalists may be asked to sign a reasonable confidentiality agreement before receiving sensitive project information



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the exact words:



DATA INTEGRITY



Do not send only a generic cover letter. Answer all seven questions below in your own words. Clear, specific, and honest answers are more important than polished corporate language.



1. Are you currently employed or working for other clients? Can you consistently work approximately 40 hours per week with meaningful U.S. Central Time overlap, and when could you begin?



2. Describe the messiest data, records, or operational project you have personally handled. What made it difficult, what did you do, and what was the result?



3. Describe a situation where two sources contained conflicting information. How did you determine which information was more reliable?



4. Describe one automation or technical workflow you personally built. What problem did it solve, which tools did you use, and which parts did you complete yourself?



5. Imagine one business system identifies Customer A as the owner of an asset, another system identifies Customer B, and the available transaction history is incomplete. What would you do before reporting an ownership problem to the client?



6. Have you spoken live with U.S. clients or business owners? How would you explain a complicated technical or data problem to a nontechnical client? If you do not have U.S. client experience, answer honestly.



7. Which technical tools are you strongest with, why does this particular role interest you, and what hourly rate are you requesting?



Also include a link to a 20–30 second English audio or video recording. Briefly introduce yourself and explain why you believe you could be a good fit for this position. A simple recording is fine; production quality does not matter.



Applications that omit the words “DATA INTEGRITY,” the seven answers, or the recording may not be reviewed.



We are not trying to hire the fastest applicant. We are looking for someone unusually dependable, thoughtful, technically capable, and careful enough to grow into an important role in the company.

WHO WE ARE

Symmes Law Group is a consumer bankruptcy and real estate law firm in Seattle, WA, in practice since 2010. We're intentionally small — you'd work directly with the attorney handling your files, not through layers of case managers at a high-volume shop. Our last VA in this role stayed 2 years and is leaving on good terms for a new opportunity; we're looking to build that kind of long-term relationship again, at a competitive wage.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



A self-starter who doesn't need to be micromanaged to stay on top of deadlines

Genuinely organized — the kind of person who catches a missing document before anyone asks

Someone who actually cares about helping people through financial distress, not just processing files. Our clients are often at a hard point in their lives, and how you talk to them matters as much as how accurately you fill out a schedule.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Prepare Chapter 7 and Chapter 13 petitions from client intake documents: pull data from credit reports, paystubs, bank statements, and tax returns

Complete schedules, the Statement of Financial Affairs, and the means test worksheet using bankruptcy software (Best Case, NextChapter, Jubilee, or Glade a strong plus)

Spot missing documents and follow up with clients directly

Submit 341 documents to bankruptcy trustees

Answer phones, schedule appointments, handle professional client communication

Draft correspondence and legal documents under attorney guidance

Support debt settlement negotiations and case tracking

Manage matters in Lawmatics (our CRM/practice management system) — updating case status, tasks, and client communication

Cross-train into other practice areas as you grow: purchase and sale transactions, short sales, estate planning, probate — more variety than a pure-BK shop



REQUIRED



At least 1 year preparing US bankruptcy petitions, or 2+ years in a US law firm, mortgage servicing, or similar role handling US financial documents daily

Strong English reading and Communication ability — able to read a tax return or mortgage statement and know what you're looking at and communiate with clients and third parties over the phone and through e-mail. 

Comfortable with Adobe Pro, MS Word, Google Workspace

Reliable internet (25+ Mbps) and backup power



NICE TO HAVE



Experience with Jubilee, Lawmatics, or similar legal CRM/case management software

Debt settlement or debt negotiation experience



WHY STAY



Direct access to the attorney — real mentorship, not a queue

Broader skill set across practice areas, not single-track petition assembly

Proven track record: predecessor was here 2 years

Competitive pay at the top of market for proven skill



TO APPLY

Start your message with PETITION, then answer:



What US bankruptcy or legal document work have you done, and what software have you used?

What's the difference between Schedule I and Schedule J, and what does a negative bottom line on Schedule J mean for a Chapter 13 case?

If you visited the United States as a tourist, what would you most want to see — or if you've been, what was your favorite part?



Attach your resume and your expected monthly wage.

Compensation: Around $
USD / month (commensurate with experience)

About Us



We are Shore Legacy Insurance (
), a family-owned independent insurance agency specializing in Health Insurance, Home Health Care, Indemnity insurance, and other vital products and benefits tailored for seniors.



We pride ourselves on delivering white-glove, compassionate customer care, helping our senior clients navigate claims, paperwork, and billing issues with absolute patience and empathy. As a growing family-owned agency, we view our remote team members as a core extension of our family business—not just another number in a massive call center.

title: Tiktok UGC Video Creator
description:
TikTok Shop UGC Video Creator & Brand Partnerships Specialist



We are looking for a creative, resourceful, and results-driven TikTok Shop UGC Video Creator to identify profitable product opportunities, produce engaging short-form videos, and develop relationships with brands. This role combines content creation, affiliate marketing, product research, trend analysis, and brand outreach.



The ideal candidate understands what makes TikTok content feel authentic and compelling, can quickly identify products with strong sales potential, and is comfortable reaching out to brands to negotiate collaborations and paid partnerships.



Key Responsibilities



Product and Promotion Research



Research TikTok Shop to identify trending, high-converting, and underserved products.

Find attractive affiliate opportunities, including products offering competitive commission rates, limited-time commission boosts, free samples, coupons, and other promotional incentives.

Evaluate products based on customer demand, reviews, pricing, commission potential, competition, content opportunities, and overall brand quality.

Monitor TikTok trends, viral products, seasonal opportunities, creator campaigns, and emerging categories.

Maintain an organized pipeline of products, samples, content ideas, commission rates, and performance results.

Recommend which products should be prioritized for content production.



UGC Video Creation



Develop original video concepts designed to promote TikTok Shop products naturally and persuasively.

Script, film, edit, and publish high-quality vertical videos optimized for TikTok.

Create product demonstrations, reviews, tutorials, problem-and-solution videos, unboxings, comparisons, testimonials, lifestyle content, and trend-based videos.

Write compelling hooks, captions, on-screen text, and calls to action.

Produce multiple creative variations to test different hooks, angles, formats, and audiences.

Ensure videos feel authentic and entertaining while clearly communicating each product’s benefits.

Follow TikTok Shop policies, advertising disclosure requirements, brand guidelines, and content best practices.

Maintain a consistent publishing schedule and meet agreed content deadlines.



Performance Optimization



Track video views, engagement, clicks, conversions, sales, commissions, and other relevant performance metrics.

Identify the creative styles, products, and messaging that generate the strongest results.

Use performance data to improve future videos and scale successful concepts.

Test different opening hooks, video lengths, calls to action, posting times, and product positioning.

Provide regular updates on content performance, product opportunities, and outreach activity.



Brand Outreach and Partnerships



Research brands that are a strong fit for our content, audience, and TikTok Shop strategy.

Contact brands through
, TikTok, creator marketplaces, social media, and other appropriate channels.

Pitch UGC services, affiliate collaborations, sponsored videos, product-seeding arrangements, and long-term brand partnerships.

Follow up professionally with potential partners and maintain an organized outreach pipeline.

Discuss deliverables, usage rights, timelines, rates, commissions, exclusivity, and other campaign terms.

Build and maintain positive relationships with brand representatives and marketing agencies.

Look for opportunities to convert successful affiliate content into paid collaborations or ongoing retainers.



Required Qualifications



Experience creating TikTok, Reels, Shorts, or other short-form vertical video content.

Strong understanding of TikTok trends, hooks, storytelling, audience retention, and purchasing behavior.

Ability to research products and recognize promising affiliate opportunities.

Strong on-camera communication skills and a natural, relatable presentation style.

Experience filming and editing videos using tools such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar software.

Strong written communication and professional outreach skills.

Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines.

Comfortable contacting brands, following up, and discussing partnership opportunities.

Reliable access to a smartphone with a good camera, appropriate lighting, clear audio, and a suitable filming environment.



Preferred Qualifications



Previous experience with TikTok Shop, affiliate marketing, UGC, influencer marketing, or social commerce.

A portfolio of short-form product videos or examples of content that has generated sales or engagement.

Experience securing brand deals or managing creator partnerships.

Understanding of content analytics, conversion tracking, and creative testing.

Familiarity with TikTok Shop’s affiliate tools, creator campaigns, product samples, and commission structures.

Experience writing scripts, developing creative briefs, and negotiating content usage rights.

Knowledge of FTC disclosure requirements and platform compliance standards.



What Success Looks Like



Success in this position will be measured by:



Consistent production of high-quality TikTok Shop videos.

Identification of promising products and competitive commission opportunities.

Growth in product clicks, conversions, sales, and affiliate revenue.

Strong video engagement and audience retention.

Number and quality of new brand relationships established.

Paid brand deals and ongoing partnerships secured.

Reliable communication, organization, and on-time delivery.



To Apply



Please submit:



A brief introduction describing your relevant experience.

Links to your TikTok account, portfolio, or short-form video samples.

title: Influencer Marketing Manager
description:

This is not a passive “coordinate influencers” role. You will be responsible for finding promising creators, getting them excited about Legend, negotiating partnerships, managing content production, and measuring which creators actually drive users and funded traders.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN



• Find and evaluate trading, finance, crypto, gaming, and lifestyle creators across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and X

• Conduct high-volume, personalized creator outreach every day

• Negotiate paid, affiliate, performance-based, and long-term creator partnerships

• Develop briefs, hooks, scripts, and content concepts that feel native to each creator

• Manage the complete creator pipeline: sourcing ? outreach ? negotiation ? onboarding ? posting ? performance analysis

• Ensure creators consistently deliver high-quality content on schedule

• Track views, CPM, clicks, signups, deposits, funded users, CAC, and creator-level ROI

• Identify winning creators and creative formats, then rapidly scale them

• Maintain an organized creator CRM and provide clear weekly reporting

• Study competitor campaigns and emerging short-form content trends

• Build genuine long-term relationships with creators and trading communities



YOU SHOULD APPLY IF



• You have previously managed influencer, affiliate, UGC, or creator campaigns

• You are extremely online and understand TikTok, Reels, Shorts, X, and internet culture

• You can recognize strong content and creators before the numbers make it obvious

• You are comfortable negotiating and following up persistently

• You are highly organized, fast, resourceful, and accountable to measurable results

• You communicate clearly in written and spoken English

• You understand performance marketing—not just views and engagement

• You are interested in trading, crypto, finance, gaming, or adjacent cultures

• You thrive in a fast-moving startup where you are expected to solve problems independently



BONUS POINTS



• Existing relationships with creators or creator agencies

• Experience promoting financial, trading, crypto, gaming, or mobile-app products

• Experience with affiliate programs, attribution links, Airtable, Notion, or creator-management platforms

• Ability to write short-form video hooks and creative briefs

• Familiarity with paid amplification, whitelisting, or Spark Ads



HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS



• Qualified creators contacted and conversations started

• Creators activated and pieces of content published

• Cost and turnaround time per piece of content

• Views, CPM, clicks, signups, funded users, and attributable deposits

• Number of profitable creators and formats successfully scaled



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. A short introduction and your relevant experience

2. Examples of creator campaigns you personally managed and their results

3. Five creators you would approach for Legend and why

4. One short-form video concept or hook you believe could perform for a social trading app

5. The word “Legend” at the beginning of your application



Generic or AI-generated applications that do not answer these questions will not be considered.
