title: Executive Recruiter
description:
Executive Recruiter / HR Specialist | US-Based MSP | 100% Remote | Full-Time



You're not just filling seats. You're protecting the standard every hire either raises or lowers.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the Company



We're a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We've been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We've grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role



This is not a transactional recruiting role.



We're looking for an Executive Recruiter who operates as both a strategic hiring partner and trusted advisor — to clients, to leadership, and to the candidates moving through the process. You'll manage full-cycle recruitment for executive, leadership, technical, and specialized roles while supporting the HR operations that keep the internal team running well.



You'll work directly with clients to understand their business and what a great hire looks like — then go build it. The judgment calls you make directly shape the teams clients trust us to build. We need someone who takes that seriously.



The Mindset We're Looking For



The best recruiters we've worked with share a few traits:



They protect the bar. When a candidate is almost right, they don't talk themselves into a yes — they know a weak hire is never the safe option, just a delayed and more expensive problem.



They're honest even when it costs them. If a role brief is unclear, they push back. If a candidate isn't the right fit, they say so — directly, kindly, and early.



They're genuinely curious. They don't run the same interviewscript for every role — they study the business, ask questions other recruiters miss, and keep getting sharper at reading people over time.



They build systems, not just pipelines. Every hiring cycle produces something better than the last — tighter screening, cleaner processes, sharper evaluation criteria.



Who Thrives Here



People who care deeply about quality — in who they hire, in how they advise clients, and in how they work. You find satisfaction in identifying the right person. You take it personally when a weak candidate slips through. You're organized, direct, and comfortable making judgment calls without needing consensus.



We're a growing MSP — not every process is built yet. For the right person, that's the opportunity to build the systems that scale with the business, not just manage what already exists.



What You'll Do



You'll walk into an environment where clients need to hire well across multiple roles, industries, and seniority levels — and where the quality of every hire reflects directly on our company.



That looks like:



Managing full-cycle recruitment for executive, leadership, technical, and specialized roles — from intake through offer, owning every step



Leading intake calls with clients — understanding their business, pushing back when a brief isn't clear enough to hire well against, and providing strategic hiring recommendations when needed



Proactively sourcing and headhunting candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, networks, and AI-powered tools — not waiting for applications



Conducting structured interviews that assess mindset, ownership, communication, and cultural fit — not just credentials



Presenting candidates with clear, honest hiring recommendations so clients make better decisions faster



Writing and posting culture-fit job descriptions across all platforms that attract the right candidates and filter out the wrong ones



Supporting HR operations — onboarding, contractor documentation, records management, and internal policy compliance



Tracking recruitment metrics and pipeline health — surfacing what's working and what needs to change



Building and improving recruitment SOPs, interview guides, scorecards, and onboarding checklists



Using AI tools to accelerate sourcing, screening, and communication without cutting corners on quality



What We're Looking For



Excellent conversational English — clear, natural, and easy to listen to; clients and candidates always feel heard



Strong full-cycle recruitment experience — executive, technical, and specialized roles across multiple clients or industries



Proven client communication and stakeholder management skills — you run intake calls, push back on vague briefs, and advise with confidence



Sharp interviewing and candidate assessment ability — you probe for specifics and can tell the difference between someone who sounds good and someone who actually is



Active, confident use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, LinkedIn Recruiter, or equivalent) — daily use, not occasional



Strong proactive sourcing and headhunting skills — you build pipelines, you don't wait for them



Proficiency in ATS platforms and HR tools (Workable, ClickUp, or equivalent)



High integrity and sound judgment — honest calls, confidential information handled without exceptions



Self-directed once you understand the environment — but asks the right questions early



Nice to Have



Experience in executive search, agency recruitment, or outsourcing environments



Background in MSP, IT services, or operations-heavy environments



How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)



We're honest about how we work with new tea
mbers.



In your first weeks and months, you'll have real hands-on support from the team. We'll work closely with you to understand how we hire, our clients, our tools, and how the business operates. We expect questions — and we'll give you the time to learn.



As you show what you can do — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly — and significant latitude to shape how we hire and build the team.



We earn each other's trust through real work — then we get out of the way.



What Success Looks Like

At three months:



You've run multiple full-cycle searches end-to-end. Your candidate assessments are sharp, honest, and already what leadership and clients rely on. You know the business well enough to push back on a vague brief.



At six months:

You’re not here to answer
s and schedule meetings. You’re here to make sure the clients you support never have to think twice about whether something is handled.

You’ll own administrative operations, client communication, and organizational systems across a fast-moving environment. You’ll also be expected to use AI tools actively — not occasionally — to work faster, produce better outputs, and eliminate manual work that shouldn’t exist in the first place.



The Mindset We’re Looking For



The best Executive Support Specialists we’ve worked with share a few traits:



They’re the person their friends call when they need to figure something out. Not because they always have the answer — but because they know how to think through a problem, ask the right questions, and get to a solution

They don’t wait to be told. If they see something that needs to happen, they handle it — then let the client know it’s done, not ask if they should do it

They’re honest even when it costs them. If they make a mistake, they say so immediately. If something isn’t working, they raise it. They don’t manage perception — they manage reality

They’re genuinely curious. It’s not enough to be smart — they actively seek out new things to learn, ask questions other people don’t think to ask, and find most topics at least a little interesting

They treat confidentiality as non-negotiable. What happens in the client’s world stays there — no exceptions, no grey areas

They use AI the way a sharp operator would — not as a novelty, but as a tool that makes their output faster and better than anyone who isn’t using it



Who Thrives Here



People who are quietly excellent — not flashy, but consistently sharp, reliable, and ahead of the curve. You don’t need recognition for every task you handle. You find satisfaction in the fact that things run smoothly because of you, even if no one notices the work behind it.



We’re a growing MSP, which means priorities shift, new tasks appear, and not everything is perfectly documented yet. For the right person, that’s not a problem — it’s an environment where someone who takes initiative and uses every tool available naturally stands out.



What You’ll Do



You’ll walk into a client’s world that has real moving parts — relationships, internal deadlines, communication threads, administrative backlogs, and calendar complexity. Your job is to bring order, anticipate what’s next, and make sure the client is always walking into rooms prepared — and to use AI tools to do all of it faster and better than it’s been done before.

, phone, and messaging platforms — triaging, responding where appropriate, and escalating only what genuinely needs the client’s attention

s are clear, professional, and require no revisions before they’re sent

ntum

title: DevOps Engineer
description:

About the company

The Role



You're not here to deploy code and move on. You're here to make sure the systems that deliver that code are reliable, secure, automated, and continuously improving.

We're looking for a DevOps Engineer who thinks in pipelines, not tasks. You'll own the infrastructure that keeps our development and client environments running — CI/CD pipelines, Linux systems, cloud platforms, monitoring, and security. When something breaks, you find the root cause. When something works, you ask how to make it more reliable, more automated, and less dependent on human intervention next time.

They treat manual processes as technical debt. If something requires a human to do it repeatedly, their instinct is to eliminate that dependency — not just document it

They take ownership. From the 
nt an infrastructure problem is theirs, it's theirs until it's resolved, documented, and hardened against happening again

They think in systems. They don't just fix what's broken — they ask what else could break, and why, and build accordingly

They communicate clearly. Status, blockers, and deployment risks are shared openly — before being asked for

They keep learning. The DevOps landscape moves fast. Twelve months from now they know more than they do today — because they made sure of it

People who are technically sharp, operationally minded, and genuinely excited by the challenge of building infrastructure that just works. We're a growing MSP, which means not every pipeline is optimized and not every process is documented yet. For the right engineer, that's not a warning — it's the opportunity to build things the right way from the ground up.

Designing, building, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines that make deployments fast, reliable, and repeatable — so shipping code is a non-event, not a risk

Building scripts and automation (Bash required; Python and PHP a plus) that eliminate repetitive manual work from the team's daily operations

Monitoring infrastructure, resource utilization, and security events — building alerting systems that catch problems before they become i

Working with cloud platforms and virtualization — managing hypervisors and cloud service providers with the confidence of someone who's done it in production



What We're Looking For

Hands-on CI/CD experience — you've built and maintained real pipelines, not just used them; you know what makes a deployment safe and what makes it a liability

Web server administration experience — Nginx and Apache, configuration, performance tuning, and troubleshooting

Database administration experience — you can manage database servers, optimize queries, and keep data environments healthy

Bash scripting proficiency (required) — you write automation that works, that others can read, and that makes the team faster; Python and PHP experience is a plus

Solid cloud computing and virtualization experience — working with hypervisors and cloud service providers (AWS, GCP, Azure, or equivalent) in real production environments

Infrastructure and event monitoring experience — you build alerting systems that surface the right information at the right time, not noise

Understanding of DevSecOps — you treat security as part of the build, not something bolted on at the end

Strong diagnostic skills — you find the root cause of a production issue, not just the fastest path to closing the ticket

Self-directed once you understand the environment — but you ask smart questions early to get there

Honest communicator — you surface risks and blockers clearly and early, even when the news isn't good

Long-term mindset — you want to build something that lasts, not move on when things get complex





How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)



We're honest about how we work with new tea
mbers.

At six months: Deployments are more reliable and less stressful than when you joined. Monitoring is catching problems before they become i

description:
Purchasing Agent/Procurement Account Representative 

McKenzie Freight Solutions LLC

Remote | Immediate Start

About McKenzie Freight Solutions

McKenzie Freight Solutions provides procurement, logistics, and supply chain services to independently owned retailers throughout The Bahamas.

We are rapidly deploying an internal operations platform to support our procurement, pricing, warehouse, logistics, finance, and customer management workflows.

This is NOT an eCommerce website.

Our Procurement Account Representatives build customer orders over the phone by pricing the products retailers already purchase every week. The platform supports product pricing, landed costs, quotations, invoicing, supplier purchasing, warehouse coordination, logistics, customer communications, and operational reporting.

We are assembling our founding operations team and are looking for professionals who enjoy building long-term customer relationships while helping independently owned retailers reduce their procurement costs.



Compensation

Launch Sprint: $3.00 USD/hour

Ongoing Operating Rate: $4.00 USD/hour

Procurement Account Representatives who successfully complete the launch period, demonstrate excellent attendance, professionalism, communication, product knowledge, and consistently follow procedures with minimal operational errors will be eligible to transition to the ongoing operating rate following Cycle 1.

Estimated Hours

20–40+ hours during the launch sprint depending on call volume.



Immediate 48-Hour Launch Sprint

Applicants must be available to begin immediately.

We are launching a live wholesale procurement platform serving independently owned retailers throughout The Bahamas.

Training, operating procedures, call scripts, and the procurement platform will be provided before contacting customers.



About the Role

This is NOT a cold calling position.

There is no outbound cold prospecting.

Our Independent Marketing Representatives have already visited retailers in person, verified each business, and introduced McKenzie Freight Solutions.

During those visits, retailers were informed that they would be assigned a dedicated Procurement Account Representative to assist them with pricing, quotations, and their first purchase order.

You will be assigned a portfolio of retailers and will work with the same customers during recurring weekly purchasing cycles.

Your responsibility is not to pressure customers into making a purchase.

Your responsibility is to understand each customer's business, listen carefully to what they need immediately, prepare accurate product quotations, demonstrate potential savings, and build long-term procurement relationships.

You must be highly detail-oriented. Every customer conversation results in the creation of a purchase order, so accuracy in product selection, quantities, package sizes, case packs, and customer information is essential.



Customer Relationship Management

Each Procurement Account Representative will manage an assigned portfolio of retailers.

You are expected to become familiar with your customers and understand:

Their business

Their weekly purchasing patterns

Preferred brands

Value-brand alternatives

Retail package sizes

Foodservice package sizes

Typical order quantities

Frequently purchased products

New product requests

Your goal is to become your customer's trusted procurement representative throughout each weekly purchasing cycle.



Product Knowledge

Applicants should be comfortable learning and discussing products commonly purchased by Caribbean retailers, including:

Grocery

Beverages

Household products

Cleaning supplies

Paper products

Foodservice products

Applicants should understand or be willing to quickly learn:

Retail package sizes versus foodservice package sizes

Case pack configurations

Cases per pallet

Brand-name products

Comparable value-brand alternatives

Training will be provided.



Responsibilities

Contact your assigned retailers by phone and WhatsApp.

Introduce yourself as their dedicated Procurement Account Representative.

Build long-term customer relationships.

Listen carefully to the customer's immediate purchasing needs.

Price-check products the customer already purchases.

Search requested products within the procurement platform.

Compare wholesale pricing with approved suppliers, including Jetro, Costco, Sam's Club, and other available supplier pricing.

Discuss estimated landed costs and potential savings.

Recommend appropriate brand or value-brand alternatives when available.

Accurately build detailed customer purchase orders within the procurement platform.

Verify products, quantities, package sizes, and case pack configurations before issuing quotations and invoices.

Submit Source Item Requests for products not currently available in the Product Universe.

Generate a tentative, non-binding invoice for the products the customer is prepared to purchase during the current purchasing cycle.

Send invoices and secure payment links through WhatsApp.

Schedule follow-up conversations for future purchasing cycles.

Maintain accurate customer notes and purchasing history.



Required Skills

Excellent spoken English.

Professional phone etiquette.

Strong customer service skills.

Excellent communication and listening skills.

Strong attention to detail.

Ability to accurately build customer purchase orders.

Ability to identify and compare products across multiple suppliers.

Typing accuracy.

Basic computer skills.

Reliable internet connection.

Quiet work environment.

USB headset with microphone.

Positive attitude.

Ability to learn product knowledge quickly.

Ability to follow operating procedures accurately.

Sales experience is preferred but not required.



Preferred Experience

Experience with one or more of the following is preferred:

Grocery

Wholesale

Procurement

Retail

Foodservice

Distribution

Customer Service

Call Center

Hospitality

Knowledge of grocery products, wholesale purchasing, foodservice products, and consumer packaged goods (CPG) is a significant advantage.



What We Are Looking For

Applicants must:

Enjoy helping customers solve procurement challenges.

Build long-term customer relationships.

Be dependable and punctual.

Be highly detail-oriented.

Enjoy researching products and identifying the correct items for customers.

Learn quickly.

Develop strong product knowledge.

Understand that accuracy is more important than speed.

Work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

Follow procedures accurately.

Represent McKenzie Freight Solutions professionally.

Be available to begin immediately.



How to Apply

Please
 the following to:



Resume

Voice recording (if available)

Customer service or procurement experience

Grocery, wholesale, or foodservice experience (if applicable)

Earliest available start date

Internet speed

Hours available during the launch sprint

Confirmation that you can begin immediately

title: B2B Sales Executive
description:
About the Job

Job Summary:

The B2B Sales Executive is responsible for identifying potential business clients, diagnosing their digital marketing bottlenecks, and presenting tailored growth strategies. This role acts as the bridge between a prospect's business goals and the agency's marketing execution, focusing on turning cold prospects into long-term, high-value agency partners.



Core Responsibilities:

Lead Generation & Prospecting (Outbound):

Targeting High-Growth Accounts: Identify and research mid-market to enterprise businesses that have gaps in their digital footprint (e.g., poor search rankings, weak ad campaigns).

Multi-Channel Outreach: Execute outbound prospecting via LinkedIn, cold
 sequences, personalized video pitches (like Loom), and industry networking.

Inbound Qualification: Rapidly follow up with and qualify warm inbound leads generated by the agency's own marketing efforts.

Consultative Selling & Discovery:

Conducting Audits: Collaborate with internal growth strategists to review a prospect’s current digital marketing metrics (traffic, conversion rates, ad spend).

Discovery Calls: Ask deep, probing questions to understand the prospect’s business model, customer acquisition costs (CAC), lifetime value (LTV), and revenue goals.

Value Proposition: Shift the conversation away from "buying services" to "buying growth and ROI."

Proposals & Pitching:

Tailored Presentations: Present comprehensive digital marketing proposals alongside a Solution Architect or Account Director.

Handling Objections: Address complex concerns regarding ad spend risk, attribution tracking, and timelines to see results.

Closing & Contracting: Negotiate contract terms, monthly retainers, and performance-based incentives to close the deal.

Pipeline Management & Retention:

CRM Upkeep: Maintain meticulous records of all interactions, deals, and pipelines in CRMs like HubSpot or Salesforce.

Smooth Handover: Work closely with Account Managers and Growth Marketers to ensure the client's goals are accurately transferred during onboarding.



Qualifications:

Technical & Professional Experience:

Experience: 2-5 years of B2B sales experience, ideally within a digital marketing agency, SaaS company, or tech-consulting environment.

Industry Literacy: A strong understanding of modern digital marketing concepts (e.g., SEO, Paid Social, Programmatic Ads, Lead Gen Funnels, Agentic AI marketing tools).

Data Savvy: Ability to read and interpret basic marketing data reports (Google Analytics, SEMrush, or HubSpot dashboards) to speak intelligently with marketing executives.

Soft Skills & Competencies:

Consultative Mindset: Act more like a business consultant and less like a transactional salesperson.

High Emotional Intelligence (EQ): Ability to navigate long sales cycles and build trust with multiple stakeholders in an enterprise.

Resilience: A proven track record of handling rejection and managing quota-driven stress in a fast-paced environment.

title: Direct Response Copywriter — Long-Form Meta Ads for Health/Supplement Brand ($2,000/mo)
description:
We are a $600K/month oral health supplement brand selling to women 50+ in the United States through Meta 
/Instagram) ad funnels. We are hiring a full-time Direct Response Copywriter and Creative Strategist to produce our primary ad format — what we call native ads.



WHAT A NATIVE AD IS:



A native ad is a single-image
 ad with long-form direct response copy in the primary text. The copy is typically 1,500 to 4,000 words. It reads like a real person writing a story or personal experience — not a sales pitch, not a brand ad, not a product description. The image looks organic and editorial — like content, not advertising. Think x-ray images, doctor/lab visuals, handwritten sticky notes, screenshots, or low-fi photos. The ad clicks through to a long-form advertorial landing page.



If you have never written a
 ad longer than 
 words, this role is not for you.

If you do not know what an advertorial funnel is, this role is not for you.

If you think "native ad" means a short caption with a pretty product photo, this role is not for you.



WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY:



Scan Meta Ad Library, GetHooked, BrandSearch, and other spy tools across health and supplement niches — not just oral health. You will study what is spending money in vision, joint pain, tinnitus, hair loss, weight loss, skincare, gut health, and any other health vertical where long-form native ads are running.

Identify winning native ads and understand WHY they work — the story structure, the hook, the mechanism, how the product is introduced, the emotional arc, the proof elements.

Rebuild those winning structures for our brand, our product, our mechanism, and our audience. Same story skeleton. Different angle, different product, different landing page.

Produce the full ad — both the long-form copy AND the image. You will use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) to assist with copy production and Canva, Higgsfield, or similar tools for image creation.

Ship 4 to 6 unique ad concepts per day once you are fully ramped (after your first 1-2 weeks of onboarding and training).

Come up with new angles and concepts on your own — from customer reviews, Reddit threads, competitor research, and our internal research documents. You are not just cloning. You are also generating original concepts.

Identify what is working from our existing ads and iterate on it — new hooks, new story frames, new angles on the same mechanisms.



WHAT YOU MUST ALREADY HAVE:



Direct response copywriting experience. You understand hooks, mechanisms, belief installation, objection handling, proof stacking, and emotional arcs. You have written long-form copy that was used in paid advertising — not blog posts, not SEO articles, not social media captions.

Experience in the health, supplement, or wellness niche specifically. You have written ads or copy for products sold to people dealing with real health concerns — pain, aging, weight, skin, teeth, vision, hearing, joints, gut, hair, or similar. You understand how this buyer thinks, what she is afraid of, what she has already tried, and why she is skeptical.

Fluent, perfect English. Non-negotiable. Your copy must read as if it was written by or for an American woman between 50 and 75 years old. Not polished corporate English. Natural, conversational, emotional American English. If your writing sounds like a textbook or a press release, you will not pass the screening.

Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) as part of your production workflow. You use AI to move faster — not to think for you. You can read AI output and immediately identify when the hook is weak, the voice is off, the mechanism is unclear, or the story lost the reader. You edit and improve AI output with your own judgment. You do not copy-paste blindly.

Experience using ad spy tools. You already spend time in Meta Ad Library, GetHooked, BrandSearch, AdSpy, or similar platforms studying what is running in health markets. This is something you already do — not something you are willing to learn.

Ability to create ad images. You can use Canva, Higgsfield, or similar tools to produce the single image that accompanies the ad copy. The image must look organic and editorial — not like a branded product ad.



STRONG PREFERENCES (not required but will put you ahead):



You can name 3 to 5 health or supplement brands running long-form native ads on
 right now and explain specifically what they are doing well.

You have worked with a DTC (direct-to-consumer) brand or performance marketing agency, not just freelance gig platforms.

You understand advertorial funnels — you know the difference between an ad that sends traffic to a product page versus an ad that sends traffic to an editorial-style landing page, and you know why the second one converts better on cold traffic.

You have produced native ads yourself — not just written copy, but chosen the image, matched the copy to the image, and shipped the complete ad.



THIS ROLE IS NOT:



Social media management

Brand advertising or brand awareness campaigns

Graphic design

Short-form copywriting (under 500 words)

Blog writing or SEO content

 marketing

Video editing or video ad production

A junior or entry-level position where you will learn on the job



If your portfolio is short captions, product descriptions, social posts, or brand ads, please do not apply.



TOOLS WE USE:



Claude and/or ChatGPT for AI-assisted copy production

Higgsfield for AI image and video generation

Canva for image creation and editing

Meta Ad Library for competitor research

GetHooked and BrandSearch for ad spy and research

Google Docs for production organization



You do not need to know all of these before starting. But you must already be using AI tools and ad spy tools in your current workflow.



COMPENSATION AND DETAILS:



$2,000 USD per month

Full-time, 40 hours per week

Fully remote — work from anywhere

Flexible schedule — we do not require specific hours, but we do require daily output and a daily end-of-day check-in via WhatsApp and a short Loom video recap of what you produced

Clear, easily understood phone communication. A large share of our customers are retirees. You will regularly speak with people who are hard of hearing or who describe their needs vaguely. Patience and clarity are not optional in this role.

Demonstrated follow-up discipline. You will be given a list and expected to work it without supervision or reminders.

Your own computer, reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection, a quiet workspace, and a working headset.

Availability for the full shift, five days a week, consistently.

8:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Eastern Time, Monday through Friday, with a one-hour unpaid break.

$7.50 USD per hour — approximately $1,300/month at 40 hours per week

Paid twice monthly via Wise, on schedule, without exception

Performance review at 90 days with a raise based on results

Backup internet reimbursed

This is an independent contractor position

Final candidates will complete a paid trial before a long-term offer is made.

Josiah Ginn

Owner, NextGen Junk Removal & Demolition

## About Unity Staffing Services



Unity Staffing Services, LLC is a recruiting firm specializing in connecting qualified professionals with career opportunities, with a strong focus on engineering and technical positions. We are seeking a dependable, organized, and results-driven Recruiting Sourcer/Recruiter to support our candidate sourcing and screening efforts.



## Position Summary



The Recruiting Sourcer/Recruiter will be responsible for finding qualified candidates for assigned job openings, conducting structured prescreening interviews using questions provided by Unity Staffing Services, and scheduling qualified candidates for a follow-up call with the Lead Recruiter.



The ideal candidate understands how to search for passive and active candidates, review resumes carefully, communicate professionally, and follow a defined recruiting process. This person must be comfortable working independently, managing multiple open positions, and maintaining accurate candidate records.



## Primary Responsibilities



### Candidate Sourcing



* Source candidates for engineering, technical, and other assigned positions.

* Search for candidates using LinkedIn, job boards, resume databases, social media, professional organizations, referrals, and other approved sourcing channels.

* Create and use Boolean search strings based on each position’s requirements.

* Review job descriptions and candidate resumes to identify potential matches.

* Evaluate candidates against the required education, experience, certifications, technical skills, location, compensation, and other must-have qualifications.

* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified candidates for active and future positions.

* Avoid submitting candidates who do not meet the stated minimum requirements.



### Candidate Outreach



* Contact prospective candidates using approved
, LinkedIn, phone, and text-message templates.

* Clearly explain the general opportunity and determine the candidate’s initial interest.

* Follow up with candidates according to the company’s outreach process.

* Respond to candidate inquiries professionally and promptly.

* Maintain a positive candidate experience throughout the initial recruiting process.



### Candidate Prescreening



* Conduct phone or video prescreening interviews using questions provided by the Lead Recruiter.

* Ask every required screening question and document the candidate’s complete responses.

* Confirm the candidate’s relevant experience, skills, education, certifications, work authorization, location, availability, compensation expectations, and interest in the opportunity.

* Ask appropriate follow-up questions when a response is unclear, without changing or skipping the required screening process.

* Identify potential concerns, inconsistencies, employment gaps, or missing qualifications.

* Provide an accurate screening summary without exaggerating or changing the candidate’s answers.

* Refer candidates who meet the established requirements to the Lead Recruiter for further evaluation.



### Scheduling and Follow-Up



* Schedule qualified candidates for a call with the Lead Recruiter using the company’s approved scheduling process.

* Send scheduling links, confirmations, and appointment reminders.

* Confirm that candidates have received the necessary information before their calls.

* Follow up with candidates who have not scheduled or who miss an appointment.

* Notify the Lead Recruiter promptly of cancellations, rescheduling requests, or important candidate concerns.



### Recruiting System and Recordkeeping



* Enter and update candidate information in Zoho Recruit or the company’s designated applicant tracking system.

* Upload resumes and maintain complete, organized candidate profiles.

* Record sourcing activity, outreach attempts, screening notes, candidate responses, and scheduled appointments.

* Move candidates through the correct recruiting stages.

* Protect confidential candidate, client, and company information.

* Provide regular reports on sourcing activity, screens completed, qualified candidates, and scheduled calls.



## Required Qualifications



* Previous experience in recruiting, candidate sourcing, talent acquisition, or a related role.

* Experience finding candidates through LinkedIn and online job boards.

* Ability to review resumes and compare candidate experience with job requirements.

* Experience conducting candidate prescreens or phone interviews.

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

* Strong organizational, time-management, and follow-up skills.

* Ability to follow detailed instructions, scripts, screening questions, and recruiting procedures.

* Ability to manage multiple job openings and candidate pipelines simultaneously.

* Reliable computer, high-speed internet connection, and a professional remote work environment.

* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle candidate information responsibly.

* Comfortable using applicant tracking systems, spreadsheets,
, video conferencing, and scheduling software.



## Preferred Qualifications



* Experience sourcing engineering, manufacturing, construction, power, civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, or other technical professionals.

* Experience using Zoho Recruit or another applicant tracking system.

* Experience creating Boolean search strings.

* Experience sourcing passive candidates on LinkedIn.

* Familiarity with technical job descriptions, professional licenses, and engineering terminology.



## Performance Expectations



The Recruiting Sourcer/Recruiter will be evaluated based on:



* Number of qualified candidates sourced

* Quality and accuracy of candidate matches

* Number of completed prescreening interviews

* Number of qualified candidates scheduled with the Lead Recruiter

* Accuracy and completeness of screening notes

* Candidate response and follow-up times

* Attendance rate for scheduled candidate calls

* Accuracy of applicant tracking system records

* Consistent compliance with the company’s sourcing and screening procedures



Activity goals may vary by position based on the difficulty of the search and candidate availability.



## Important Role Boundaries



The Recruiting Sourcer/Recruiter will identify, contact, and prescreen candidates using company-provided requirements and questions. The Lead Recruiter will make final qualification decisions, conduct the next-stage interview, approve candidate submissions, communicate with clients, and manage offers or negotiations unless otherwise authorized.



The Sourcer/Recruiter must not submit candidates to clients, promise interviews or employment, negotiate compensation, or make commitments on behalf of Unity Staffing Services without authorization.



## Ideal Candidate



You may be a strong fit for this position if you are:



* Persistent and resourceful when searching for difficult-to-find candidates

* Comfortable making calls and speaking with candidates

* Detail-oriented when reviewing resumes and recording screening answers

* Able to distinguish required qualifications from preferred qualifications

* Consistent with follow-up and scheduling

* Coachable and willing to learn technical and engineering terminology

* Professional, dependable, and able to work independently

* Focused on candidate quality rather than simply producing a high number of resumes



## How to Apply



Please submit your resume along with a brief response addressing the following:



1. How many years of recruiting or candidate-sourcing experience do you have?

2. What types of positions have you sourced for?

3. Which sourcing platforms and applicant tracking systems have you used?

4. Describe your experience conducting candidate prescreening interviews.

5. Provide an example of a difficult position you successfully sourced for.

6. Are you comfortable making candidate calls and following a structured screening questionnaire?

7. What is your availability to begin working full-time?

8. What are your compensation expectations?



Selected applicants may be asked to complete a short paid sourcing exercise to demonstrate their resume-review, Boolean-search, and candidate-matching skills.

title: WordPress Developer & SEO/AEO Specialist — Remote, Philippines
description:
Compensation: $1,800–$2,500 USD/month, depending on experience and demonstrated technical ability. This is a long-term, full-time remote position with opportunity for compensation and responsibility to increase as you take ownership of our SEO/AEO systems.



About GK Marketing:



GK Marketing is a US-based agency focused on growth for dental practices. We provide a full range of marketing services — advertising management, conversion optimization, call analytics, listings management (Google Business Profile and beyond), marketing attribution, and in-office strategy training. Website development is one piece of a larger system we build around each practice. Our sites are custom-built on WordPress and optimized to perform in both traditional search and AI-powered answer engines like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, and Perplexity.



The Role:



This is a two-phase position:



Phase 1 — Site Architecture Rebuilds (Primary Focus)

We have a portfolio of existing dental client sites that need their content and architecture restructured for AEO. The designs already exist — this is not a design role. You'll be restructuring sites using our Kadence theme setup, Advanced Custom Fields (ACF), and our documented AEO framework. This means rebuilding the underlying architecture — reorganizing content into structured service pages, provider profiles, entity-rich FAQs, schema markup, and local SEO foundations. The systems and templates are built — you need to execute them well and flag problems when you see them.



Phase 2 — AEO Growth & Strategy

Once the rebuild pipeline stabilizes, the role shifts toward growing our clients' visibility in AI answer engines. This means writing optimized articles, developing strategies to help dental practices collect more patient reviews, testing new content formats, and staying ahead of how search and AI engines surface local business information. You'll have input into what we try and how we measure it.



What You'll Do:



Restructure existing WordPress sites — reorganize content architecture, build out structured pages, and implement our AEO framework using Kadence, ACF, and established templates

Implement structured data, schema markup, and entity-rich content across service pages, provider bios, and FAQs

Develop and optimize content for both traditional SEO and AI answer engines, using LLMs to assist with drafting and refinement

Research and develop new AEO and SEO strategies — articles, local SEO improvements, review acquisition programs

Troubleshoot technical problems independently — CSS issues, plugin conflicts, layout bugs, broken functionality

Use LLMs and AI coding tools to solve styling and development problems efficiently

Follow documented systems, identify gaps or inefficiencies, and suggest improvements

Communicate clearly about progress, blockers, and questions



What We're Looking For:



Must Have:



WordPress development experience — comfortable working under the hood of a site, not just editing page content. You should know your way around Kadence (or similar theme frameworks), ACF, custom page templates, and site architecture. This is a web developer and content developer role, not a design role — the visual design is handled separately.

Solid SEO fundamentals — on-page optimization, technical SEO, local SEO, Google Business Profile management. You understand how search engines crawl and rank content.

Understanding of AEO concepts — structured data, entity optimization, 
 markup, and how AI answer engines pull and surface information differently than traditional search.

Strong English communication skills — you'll be coordinating with US-based team members and occasionally interfacing with clients. You need to communicate clearly, ask good questions, and explain your thinking. Polished writing is less important than clear communication — LLMs can help refine content, but they can't replace the ability to understand and be understood.

Problem-solving ability — this is the most important trait. When something breaks or doesn't look right, you figure out why and fix it. You don't wait to be told every step. You search, test, and find solutions.

Systems thinker — you follow processes, but you also notice when a process could be better. You think about how your work fits into the bigger picture.

Proficiency with LLMs — you should have a strong working knowledge of large language models (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) and know how to use them effectively to debug code, solve CSS/styling issues, generate content, and accelerate your workflow. This isn't optional — AI tools are part of how we work.



Nice to Have:

Experience with dental or healthcare marketing

Content writing experience — service descriptions, articles, or similar

Familiarity with review management platforms or strategies

Experience with Google Search Console, analytics, and rank tracking tools



Schedule & Time Zone



We are based in US Central Time (CT). The Philippines is roughly 13 hours ahead, which means our working hours rarely overlap naturally. To make collaboration work, we need you to be available during 2 to 3 hours of US Central Time business hours each day. This overlap is essential early on for onboarding, feedback loops, and real-time problem solving. As you become more independent, this may reduce to 1 hour of daily overlap.

Outside of the overlap window, you manage your own schedule. We care about output and communication, not clock-watching.



Why This Role:

You'll work on a clear, repeatable system — not chaos. Our tech stack and processes are documented and improving.

You'll have real ownership. Once you've proven you can execute, you'll have significant autonomy over how the work gets done.



The AEO space is early and evolving fast. You'll be working on strategies that most agencies haven't figured out yet.

Growth opportunity as the agency scales — more clients, more sites, and a bigger role if you grow with us.

How to Apply



Send us:

A statement of desired monthly compensation in USD.

A brief introduction — who you are and why this role interests you

Your experience with WordPress site builds (links to sites you've built or worked on)

A short description of an SEO or technical problem you solved and how you approached it

Your availability for US Central Time overlap hours

We need someone who can hit the ground running and take ownership quickly.



WORK SCHEDULE



- 40 hours per week (may start lighter during training)

ABOUT US



Freedom Business Mentoring



We help coaches, consultants, and service providers build profitable online businesses using social media and a proven sales framework.



The company scaled to multi-million revenue in under 12 months and has helped hundreds of clients build six-figure businesses.



BENEFITS



- Stable full-time role

- Direct work with sales leadership

- Long-term growth opportunity

- Exposure to sales operations and performance systems

- Opportunity to grow into Quality Control or Sales Ops leadership

- Access to paid AI tools and software. If needed, personal subscriptions will be reimbursed upon invoice submission.

- 15 days paid time off per year

- 15 days paid sick leave per year



TASKS



- Review setters’ end-of-day reports

- Check sales trackers, call notes, and KPIs

- Flag missing data or process gaps

- Keep the CRM clean and updated

- Review sales-to-coaching handoff notes

- Learn and improve internal SOPs

- Use Google Sheets, Excel, and AI to improve systems

- Follow up with setters via WhatsApp and Slack when needed

- Support inbox and calendar management over time

- Build and maintain automated workflows using AI and tools to eliminate manual work

- Help systemize and automate repeat tasks

- Gradually take over more operational and light personal tasks

REQUIREMENTS



- Experience as an Executive Assistant, Operations Assistant, or Coordinator supporting a leader

- Strong Google Sheets or Excel skills

- Confident using AI tools to improve workflows and systems

- Experience building or improving automated workflows and processes

- Strong written and spoken English

- Highly organized and proactive

- Comfortable working with KPIs and sales performance metrics

- Comfortable working in a performance-driven environment

- Comfortable being on video calls during training and shadowing



SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE (FIRST 90 DAYS)

- Fully understand the Setter Manager’s workflow and priorities

- Independently manage daily reporting and CRM checks

- Proactively identify issues before they are escalated

- Reliably execute tasks once given a clear SOP

title: Video Editor — Motion Graphics for Long-Form YouTube + SaaS Launch Videos | Part-Time 30 hrs/week
description:
Hi, I'm Hudson — an Australian founder. I build software and document the whole thing on YouTube.



I'm hiring ONE editor, part-time, 30 hours a week, long-term. The same guaranteed volume every week. This is not project-by-project work.



There is no test project, paid or unpaid. I'm hiring on your past work, your attention to detail, and how you answer the questions at the bottom.



WHAT YOU'LL EDIT



1. Long-form YouTube. This is the main job. Build-in-public videos, tutorials, breakdowns, 8 to 20 minutes. They have to stay interesting the whole way through. That is the actual skill I'm paying for.



2. SaaS launch and product videos. 60 to 90 seconds, high polish, for the software I'm building.



3. Short-form vertical cuts. Some pulled out of the long-form, some filmed standalone. This is what keeps your week full and the work consistent rather than feast-or-famine.



THE QUALITY BAR



Go and watch the hero video on the Kleo 3.0 launch page. OnlineJobs strips links out of job posts, so type the address into your browser yourself. It is: kleo dot so slash 3



That is the standard. Specifically, here is what I mean by it:



- Kinetic typography that lands on the beat, one word at a time, with the key word in a brand colour while the rest stays white

- Clean UI mockups that animate in 3D space and settle

- Real depth. The speaker is masked and layered into the graphics, with some cards passing behind her and others sitting in front. She is inside the graphics, not pasted on top of them

- Dark gradient interstitials with a soft brand glow, used as punctuation between sections

- Cards and testimonials that stagger in on their own timing, hold, and leave cleanly

- Split layouts where the speaker drops to a rounded picture-in-picture beside the information

- Cutting and sound design that keep the pace up without turning it into a meme edit



Note that the whole video is one person at one desk. No b-roll is carrying it. Every bit of watchability is motion graphics. That is exactly what I need, because that is how I film.



If you can't build the things in that list in After Effects, this role isn't for you. Please don't apply — I'll only say no, and we both lose the time.



WHAT I NEED



- Strong After Effects. Premiere or Resolve for the assembly is fine

- Motion graphics you built yourself, not bought templates

- The ability to hold a viewer's attention through a 15 minute video

- Reliable weekly turnaround and clear communication in English

- A real 30 hours a week, consistently



WHAT YOU GET



- US$700 to US$1,000 per month depending on what your portfolio actually shows

- 30 hours a week, every week, long-term

- Paid on time every time, via Wise, PayPal or GCash

- Organised briefs. Footage, brand kit, script, references and timestamped notes in one folder. You will never be chasing me for an asset

- Your rate reviewed at 3 months



HOW TO APPLY



Read this part carefully. How you answer it is most of my decision.



1. Start your message with the word TANGERINE



2. Send 2 or 3 links to videos you personally edited. Public links only — YouTube, Vimeo, or your own site. No Google Drive, no Dropbox, no WeTransfer, no downloads. For each one, tell me exactly which parts you made



3. Send one link that is specifically motion graphics work. If your best motion graphics sits inside a longer video, give me the timestamp



4. Pick one effect from that Kleo hero video (kleo dot so slash 3) and tell me in a few sentences how you would build it. I'm not looking for a perfect answer. I want to see how you think



5. Tell me what you edit in, and how many hours a week you can genuinely commit



6. Tell me your monthly rate for 30 hours a week



Short is fine. Two great links and six honest answers beat ten paragraphs.



I read every application and I reply either way.



Hudson

title: Social Media Manager: Content Strategy & Calendar (Botanical Gray Market Industry)
description:
We have three business brands plus our CEO personal brand posting. We need someone who owns why, when, and what next.



Rebel X Brands is a botanical house. We build and hold consumer brands across kratom, kava, and alcohol-alternative wellness, including GRHKratom, King K, and GÜD Tonics. Each brand has its own voice and its own audience. We need a social media manager who owns the full picture: strategy, calendar, and craft.



We need a Social Media Manager who can build the content calendar and strategy for all three brands and work directly with our Marketing Manager, our Graphic Designer, and our Video Editor to get the content made. Paid social experience is a nice-to-have here, not a requirement.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- Content calendars and strategy for GRHKratom, King K, and GÜD Tonics, each with its own voice, content pillars, and posting cadence

- Creative briefs for our Graphic Designer and Video Editor, covering static posts and quick-turn video

- Platform strategy that accounts for the fact that Meta and TikTok both restrict kratom and kava content; you'll need to know or learn the workarounds (code words, visual language, avoiding flagged terms) that keep our accounts live

- Weekly and monthly reporting tied to engagement and growth, not just vanity metrics



**Nice to have: planning and running paid social campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and other channels



OUR CEO'S PERSONAL BRAND

You'll also build the content plan and strategy for our CEO's personal brand and account, working with the same Graphic Designer and Video Editor on his static posts and short-form video

This calendar runs alongside the brand calendars, coordinated with our Marketing Manager and, where relevant, a separate Personal Branding/PR Strategist who handles our CEO's outreach and press



WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

- You'll report to our Marketing Manager for cross-brand priorities and approvals

- Our Graphic Designer, for static creative

- Our Video Editor, for short-form and quick-turn video

- A separate Personal Branding/PR Strategist for our CEO: you own his content calendar, they own his outreach and opportunities



REQUIREMENTS

- A track record building and executing content calendars and strategy for more than one brand at a time

- Experience or comfort working in a restricted advertising category (supplements, CBD, kratom, kava, alcohol alternatives, or similar); you understand platforms restrict certain words and topics, and you know how to plan around it

- Direct experience briefing and collaborating with designers and video editors, not just posting what's handed to you

**Nice to have: hands-on graphic design or video editing skills (Canva, Adobe Suite, CapCut, or similar) — you don't need to be the primary creative, but being able to jump in and create or edit content yourself is a plus



**Nice to have: experience running paid social ads (Meta and TikTok) with real budget and real results



TO APPLY

Skip the generic proposal. Include:

- A content calendar or strategy you built across more than one brand, and how you sequenced it

- If you have one, a paid social campaign you ran with real numbers (spend, CAC, ROAS, whatever you tracked)

- Anything you see yourself working on when you look at our social media pages?

- Answer this: "Instagram just flagged one of your posts and quietly reduced its reach because it contains a restricted keyword. What do you check first, and what do you change going forward?"

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



IF YOUR BACKGROUND IS PRIMARILY CUSTOMER SERVICE OR VIRTUAL ASSISTANT AND NOT SALES, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.



Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works.



If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for:



- Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role.

- Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings.

- Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going.

- Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe.

- Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists.



Everything else:



- ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 50 wpm minimum (65+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a 
nt to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait.

- You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it.

- You can't hold a conversation without a script telling you what to say next.

- You type slowly. Under 50 wp
ans you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking.

- Your background is primarily customer service, general VA work, or admin support with no direct sales or appointment setting experience. This role requires proven experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment. Customer service experience alone is not sufficient.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

- You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation



---



HIRING PROCESS

6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance



---



HOW TO APPLY

)

Applications submitted via direct messages on OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be reviewed. Use the Tally form.

Looking forward to meeting the right person.
