title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



IF YOUR BACKGROUND IS PRIMARILY CUSTOMER SERVICE OR VIRTUAL ASSISTANT AND NOT SALES, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.



Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works.



If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for:



- Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role.

- Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings.

- Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going.

- Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe.

- Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists.



Everything else:



- ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 50 wpm minimum (65+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a 
nt to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait.

- You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it.

- You can't hold a conversation without a script telling you what to say next.

- You type slowly. Under 50 wp
ans you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking.

- Your background is primarily customer service, general VA work, or admin support with no direct sales or appointment setting experience. This role requires proven experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment. Customer service experience alone is not sufficient.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

- You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation



---



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions

2. 20-minute pre-screen call with our hiring partner

3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay

4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion

5. Offer — targeting hires between August 10 – August 20

6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance



---



HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application through this Tally form: | 
 |



IMPORTANT: There is a confirmation requirement embedded in this post. Applications that miss it will be skipped regardless of experience.



The form will ask for:

)

- A screenshot of your internet speedtest (speedtest.net)

- A screenshot of your computer specs (RAM and processor)

- A description of your backup plan for power/internet outages

- A few short questions to gauge fit

- A short voice recording (Vocaroo or similar)

- A short Loom video introducing yourself



Applications submitted via direct messages on OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be reviewed. Use the Tally form.



---



Looking forward to meeting the right person.



Ethan

Founder, Midnight Siren

title: Etsy Digital Product Designer & Shop Builder – Small Business Forms & Template Bundles
description:
I am building a new Etsy shop focused on digital products that help small service-based businesses run more professionally and efficiently.



I am looking for a creative, organized, and experienced person who can help me build the shop from the ground up, including product research, template creation, branding, mockups, Etsy listings, and SEO.



The shop will offer both individual business forms/templates and larger coordinated bundles or complete operational systems. Customers may be able to purchase one specific document they need or save by purchasing a larger package containing multiple related forms.



The initial business niches will include:



Professional Organizing

Residential Cleaning

Pet Sitting / Dog Walking

Mobile Auto Detailing

Photography

Home Staging

Event Planning



Additional small-business niches will be added over time.



Types of Products We Will Create



Products may be sold individually, as smaller themed bundles, or as complete business systems.



Examples include:



Client intake forms

Lead inquiry forms

Consultation questionnaires

Client assessments

Service agreements

Contract templates

Proposal templates

Estimate and quote templates

Pricing guides

Service menus

Welcome packets

Client onboarding forms

Client preparation guides

Policies and procedures

Scheduling forms

Service checklists

Project checklists

Client communication templates

 templates

Follow-up forms

Cancellation and rescheduling policies

Payment policy forms

Client feedback forms

Review request templates

Referral forms

Offboarding documents

Internal workflow templates

Business trackers

Client management forms

Business organization templates



For example, a professional organizer may be able to purchase a Client Intake Form individually, a Client Onboarding Bundle containing several related documents, or a much larger Professional Organizer Business Forms Bundle containing most of the documents needed to manage clients from inquiry through project completion.



The goal is to give customers options at different price points while also creating larger, higher-value bundles.



Your Responsibilities



You will help:



Research each business niche and determine which forms and templates business owners are actively looking for

Identify opportunities for both individual products and bundles

Create professional editable templates, primarily in Canva

Develop coordinated collections so individual products can later be combined into bundles

Create clean, attractive, easy-to-use business documents

Maintain consistent branding and formatting across product collections

Create Etsy listing images and professional mockups

Prepare customer instruction PDFs and Canva template links

Create Etsy SEO titles, descriptions, and 13 tags

Research competitors and Etsy search opportunities

Recommend new products based on demand and gaps in the market

Help organize the Etsy shop into logical sections and product categories

Help develop larger premium bundles from individual products



I want the product catalog built strategically so that one form can become several selling opportunities.



For example:



Client Intake Form ? Client Onboarding Bundle ? Complete Business Forms Bundle



This will allow us to create a large Etsy catalog while also offering customers multiple purchasing options.



The Person I Am Looking For



You should be very comfortable using Canva and have a strong eye for professional, attractive business-document design.



Etsy experience is strongly preferred, especially experience with:



Digital products

Etsy SEO

Etsy keyword research

Canva templates

Small-business documents

Printable forms

Business systems

Client onboarding materials



Strong written English is important because many of these products will contain customer-facing business language.



You should also be extremely organized. We will be creating many related products, and documents need to be designed so they can work both individually and as part of larger coordinated bundles.



I am especially interested in someone who can research, think strategically, and suggest products, rather than waiting for me to provide every idea.



Product Research Is Important



I do not want someone who only knows how to make attractive Canva templates.



I want someone who can help answer questions such as:



What forms does a residential cleaning business actually need?

What documents are photographers searching for?

What forms are selling individually on Etsy?

Which products should be combined into bundles?

Which business niches have good demand but less competition?

What important forms are competitors leaving out?

How can we create a better or more complete product?



The goal is to create products that solve real operational problems for small-business owners.



Original Work Only



All work must be original and created specifically for this shop.



I do not want:



Copied Etsy listings

Copied competitor templates

Resold PLR products

Copyrighted designs

Templates purchased elsewhere and slightly modified



Any fonts, graphics, photos, icons, or design assets used must be appropriate for commercial use.



For contracts, legal forms, waivers, or other documents that could create legal obligations, templates should be clearly presented as customizable business templates and not represented as attorney-prepared legal advice unless they have actually been reviewed by a qualified attorney.



Long-Term Opportunity



This is not intended to be a one-time project.



My goal is to build a large Etsy digital-product shop containing potentially hundreds of listings across multiple small-business niches.



The shop will include:



Individual Forms ? Small Bundles ? Client Systems ? Complete Business Bundles



If we work well together, there will be ongoing work creating additional products, adding new industries, improving listings, creating bundles, researching keywords, and expanding the shop.



I am looking for someone who is interested in helping me build and grow the business long term.



To Apply



Please include the following:



A short introduction about your experience.

Examples of Canva templates, business documents, Etsy digital products, or forms you have created.

Details about any Etsy shops you have helped create or manage.

Your experience with Etsy SEO and keyword/product research.

Your experience creating digital products.

Your hourly rate and/or project rate.

How many hours per week you are available.

Position Overview



Century 21 Fairways is seeking an exceptional Executive Virtual Assistant to support an active Broker/Owner, real estate producer, property management executive, investor, and real estate coach.



This is a high-level position for someone who can become the right hand to a busy entrepreneur operating multiple real estate revenue streams.



The position supports four primary areas:



Residential Real Estate Sales

Commercial & Investment Real Estate

Property Management Business Development

Real Estate Coaching & Personal Brand



The Broker already has transaction coordination support for properties once they are under contract. Therefore, this position is heavily focused on the activities that happen before the contract and outside the transaction: lead generation, database management, client follow-up, listing preparation, scheduling, research, marketing coordination, presentations, business development, and executive organization.



The goal is simple:

1. RESIDENTIAL REAL ESTATE SUPPORT

 campaigns

Commercial & Investment

Property Management



New owner leads, appointments, proposals, agreements pending, new clients and potential units.

Strong organizational ability.

Professional telephone skills.

Sales and business-development mindset.

Canva

Google Workspace

Microsoft Excel

Zoom

 marketing platforms

AI productivity tools

Winning listings.

Negotiating deals.

Leading the company.

knowledge shines through every piece.

 newsletters,

and scripts for video content

title: In-House SEO Strategist — Local + AI Search for a US Cleaning Brand
description:
Read every word. There's a challenge near the bottom that d
 whether we ever talk. Skim it and you're already out — an SEO who doesn't read carefully isn't an SEO we want.



We're Greater Phoenix Cleaning. We clean homes and businesses across Phoenix, Arizona, and we're building this into a multi-seven-figure company with locations opening across the United States. We already know how to sell and how to clean. Now we're going all-in on owning search — traditional AND AI — and we want one person to own it completely.



This is not a "post a few blogs and tweak title tags" job. This is the keys to our entire organic growth engine.



THE MISSION

Take Greater Phoenix Cleaning to 300+ inbound organic leads per month. Dominate the Google Map Pack in every ZIP code we serve, go deeper neighborhood by neighborhood for our ideal customer, and make us the business that shows up whether someone types it into Google, says it into Maps, or asks an AI assistant "who's the best cleaner near me." Then hand us the repeatable playbook to do it again in every city we open. You'll be honest that this is a 12–18 month compounding build, not a magic switch — and then you'll go build it.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The best of the best. An SEO nerd in the best possible way — someone who lives, eats, sleeps, and breathes search. The profile:

- 10+ years in SEO, and it's the ONLY thing you do. Not "SEO + web design + ads." Pure SEO obsession.

- Deep expertise across Local SEO, GEO / location-based SEO, AI Search Optimization (AEO/GEO), and Google Business Profile optimization.

- You've ranked local service businesses to the top of the map pack and page one, with proven, measurable growth in rankings, organic traffic, leads, and engagement. Cleaning companies = ideal. Home-service businesses (HVAC, plumbing, pest, landscaping, roofing) = strong. Everyone else with real proof = welcome.

- You're on the bleeding edge of AI search RIGHT NOW — Google AI Overviews, answer engines, LLM/generative search — and you already optimize for AI-generated results, not just the ten blue links.

- You go to SEO masterminds. You have (or had) an SEO mentor. You sharpen constantly — because whoever stopped learning in 2022 is already obsolete.

- Happy, hungry, humble, sharp. Good energy. Coachable ego. Zero laziness — anywhere.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- Full SEO audits of our website, technical health, and entire local presence.

- Keyword and competitor research — local, long-tail, and neighborhood-level.

- On-page and technical SEO: site structure, content optimization, schema markup, page speed, internal linking.

- Local ranking signals: Google Business Profile optimization, business listings and citation management, NAP consistency, and review velocity strategy.

- GEO / location-based SEO: unique, genuinely valuable service-area and neighborhood landing pages across every ZIP we serve.

- AI Search Optimization / Answer Engine Optimization: optimize our content and entities so we surface in AI Overviews, generative results, and AI assistant answers.

- A relentless content engine — blogs and pages that are actually valuable, never thin junk.

- Real reporting. We keep score here: leads, rankings, traffic, engagement — not vanity metrics.

- The repeatable system we roll out to every new city.



WHY THIS BEATS AGENCY LIFE

We're anti-corporate. No clients to juggle, no account managers watering down your work, no politics. ONE brand, your full focus, real budget, and a team that actually ships what you recommend — fast. You'll work directly with the owner. Perform, and you help architect the SEO engine for a national franchise. We build leaders here, and we pay for results.



THE PAY

Base of $1,500/month, plus a performance bonus tied directly to the results you create:

- +$250/month once we sustain 100+ organic leads/month

- +$500/month once we sustain 200+ organic leads/month

- +$1,000/month once we sustain 300+ organic leads/month (the mission)

That's up to $2,500+/month total for hitting the target you were hired to hit — and for someone who proves they're truly elite, we'll go higher. We pay for results here, not for logging hours.



THE HONEST PART

We're demanding and we move fast. We'll give you resources and get out of your way — and in return we expect ownership, honesty about timelines, and relentless execution. If you want to coast, we're not it. If you want one brand you can take to the absolute top and point to for the rest of your career — welcome home.



HOW TO APPLY (this is the real test — most SEOs will fail it, and that's the point)



We're hiring an expert, so prove you're one. Generic copy-paste proposals get deleted unread. Do all of this:



1. Start your message with the word PAGEONE in all caps. No PAGEONE, no reply — we'll know you skimmed. (First test: passed or failed.)



2. Go look at our website (
) and our Google Business Profile. In 5–8 sentences, tell us the single biggest thing you'd fix in your first 30 days to move our map pack rankings — and WHY. Be specific. This is what separates the real ones from the fakers.



3. Show us proof. Send at least one business you personally ranked — the URL, the keyword(s), and the before/after (screenshots, Ahrefs/SEMrush data, or a case study link). Cleaning or home-service examples move to the top of our pile.



4. Tell us your exact SEO stack (the tools you use) and one specific way you're optimizing for AI search / answer engines in 2026 that most people aren't.



5. Tell us the last SEO mastermind, course, mentor, or community you were part of — and one thing it changed about how you work.



Do all five and you're ahead of 95% of applicants. We read every application that starts with PAGEONE.



Let's take this brand to the top.



— The Greater Phoenix Cleaning Team

title: AI-Native Web Builder for Quiz Funnels (Consumer Subscription Apps) — Conversion-Obsessed
description:
ABOUT US

We're an AI-first venture studio building a portfolio of consumer subscription wellness apps — weight loss, GLP-1, menopause, walking, yoga. We move fast and we build everything with AI.



WHAT WE'RE HIRING FOR — READ THIS CAREFULLY

We build "web2app" quiz funnels: the exact style used by BetterMe (Genesis), Noom, Simple, and Welltech (WalkFit, Yoga-Go). If you don't know these apps, go look at them on your phone before you apply.



Here is the model:

Paid ad (Meta/TikTok) ? a long, personalized quiz of 30-50 steps ? a "here's your personalized plan" reveal ? a paywall where the user pays ON THE WEB (Stripe/Paddle) ? then they download the app with the subscription already active.



The quiz is not filler. Every question is a micro-commitment, and the answers feed a personalized result that makes the person feel the plan was built specifically for them. The whole thing is a conversion machine built on psychology: micro-commitments, personalization, social proof, loss aversion, sunk cost, and "processing theater" loading screens ("calculating your plan...").



THIS IS NOT B2B SAAS FUNNELS

Please do NOT apply if your experience is B2B SaaS lead-gen — book-a-demo funnels, MQLs, lead magnets, HubSpot/GoHighLevel booking flows, ClickFunnels webinar funnels. That is a completely different craft. This is consumer, direct-to-subscriber, long-form quiz-to-paywall. We get a lot of SaaS-funnel applicants and they are not a fit.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build long-form quiz funnels (30-50+ steps) end-to-end, using AI to do the heavy lifting

- Build the branching logic, the personalized result/reveal screens, and the three-tier paywall (1 / 3 / 12 month) with a post-purchase upsell

- Wire up the tracking: Meta CAPI + TikTok server-side events, UTM pass-through, deep links, and step-level drop-off analytics

- A/B test and iterate relentlessly — we optimize on conversion, not opinions



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

This is one role: an AI-native builder who can produce the entire web funnel with AI. We care about two things above all:



1. AI-NATIVE / VIBE CODER. You build web things by directing AI — Claude, Claude Cowork, and tools like Base44, Lovable, Cursor. You do NOT need to be a senior engineer. You need to be able to make AI build a real, working, well-designed funnel and know when the result is right. If you still hand-code everything from scratch and don't use AI, you're not who we're looking for.



2. CONVERSION. You can look at a funnel and explain WHY it converts or exactly where it leaks. You obsess over the small details that move the number. This is non-negotiable.



You do NOT need to have built a web2app funnel before. If you have — show us. If you haven't but you're AI-heavy and you understand conversion — apply.



HOW TO APPLY — FOLLOW THIS EXACTLY (applications that skip steps get deleted)

Start your message with the word: COPPER



Then answer these three:



1. Which AI tools do you build web projects with (e.g. Claude, Claude Cowork, Base44, Lovable, Cursor)? Send me ONE live link to something you built mostly with AI, and tell me roughly how much of it was AI vs. you hand-coding.



2. Go spend 5 minutes inside the BetterMe or Simple quiz funnel on your phone. Tell me ONE thing you would change to increase conversion, and why.



3. In 3-4 sentences: how would you approach building a 40-step weight-loss quiz funnel end-to-end with AI — which tools, in what order, and how would you handle the paywall and tracking?

title: Paid Social Creative Designer – Meta Ads
description:
Superior Hair Extensions is looking for a talented Paid Social Creative Designer based in the Philippines to join us on an ongoing remote freelance basis.



We are an established hair-extension and beauty e-commerce brand operating across New Zealand, Australia and the United States.



This role focuses specifically on creating high-performing video and static advertising content for Meta Ads. You will work directly with our internal team and paid-media specialists to develop original ad ideas, execute creative briefs and produce variations for ongoing testing.



This is not a social media management role, and you will not be responsible for managing advertising campaigns or budgets.



What you’ll be doing:



* Creating static and video advertisements for
 and Instagram

* Developing your own original ad concepts, hooks and creative angles

* Following briefs supplied by our paid-media specialists

* Producing variations of existing and successful ad concepts

* Editing short-form videos using supplied footage, product content and UGC

* Creating static ads, carousels, GIFs and promotional creatives

* Adapting creatives for different products, promotions and markets

* Researching competitor ads and current direct-response creative trends

* Reviewing performance feedback and using it to improve future creatives

* Working closely with our team to deliver content on schedule

* Organising source files and completed creative assets clearly



What we’re looking for



* Experience creating paid social advertisements for Meta

* Strong graphic-design and video-editing skills

* Experience working with e-commerce, beauty, fashion or consumer brands

* An understanding of direct-response advertising and conversion-focused design

* The ability to create original concepts rather than only following templates

* Experience creating multiple variations for creative testing

* Strong attention to detail

* Clear written English and reliable communication

* The ability to work independently and meet agreed deadlines

* Openness to performance feedback and creative revisions



Experience with Shopify or international e-commerce brands would be helpful but is not essential.



Tools



Please tell us which tools you use. Experience with the following may be helpful:



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* After Effects

* Photoshop

* Illustrator

* Canva

* CapCut

* Figma



We are open to different software provided you can deliver professional, editable source files.



Role structure



* Fully remote

* Philippines-based applicants preferred

* Part-time initially, with the potential for increased hours and responsibility

* You will work directly with our internal team, not through an agency

1. A brief introduction and summary of your experience

Please clearly confirm whether you work independently or as part of an agency.

title: WordPress + Elementor Web Designer
description:
# WordPress + Elementor Web Designer (Conversion-Focused, Trades / Local Service) — Part-Time, Long-Term



**Read this whole post before applying. Applications that skip the steps at the bottom will be ignored.**



## About the role



We run two established Australian trade businesses: an electrical services company and a security installation company (CCTV, alarms, intercoms, access control). Both are licensed, insured, and well-reviewed, and both need to convert website visitors and Google Ads clicks into phone calls and form leads.



We are looking for a WordPress and Elementor designer to work with us **long-term on an ongoing retainer**. One designer will handle both brands. You will not be building pretty portfolio sites. You will be building lead machines that load fast, look clean, and convert.



You will work directly with the business owner and the SEO and Google Ads specialist. Clear briefs and fast feedback are part of how we operate.



## What you will do



- Design and build conversion-focused pages in WordPress with Elementor

- Build landing pages for Google Ads campaigns that improve conversions and Quality Score

- Create and improve service pages and suburb pages for local SEO

- Keep everything mobile-first, since most of our traffic is on phones

- Optimise page speed and Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP)

- Place calls to action, click-to-call, forms, and trust signals where they convert

- Test forms, links, and tracking before anything goes live

- Keep both brands visually consistent using the brand kits we provide



## What we are looking for (must-have)



- 5+ years building WordPress sites with Elementor, with **live examples you can show us**

- Real conversion-focused design: CTA placement, trust signals, clean section flow, mobile-first

- Strong page speed discipline (image compression, lightweight builds, no slider bloat)

- Clear written English and reliable with deadlines

title: Creative Strategist / Direct Response Copywriter — Dog Supplement Brand
description:
Creative Strategist / DR Copywriter for Scaling Dog Supplement Brand (Ecom)



We're a US-based dog supplement brand (daily gut-health soft chews, subscription-first) looking for a sharp creative strategist who can write direct response copy AND think like a marketer. This is not a "just write me captions" role. You'll own competitor research, angle development, and briefs that my editing team turns into winning video ads.



What you'll do:



Research competitors (Meta Ad Library, AdSpy) and break down what's working and why

Do manual research on Reddit, Amazon reviews, and YouTube to pull real customer language, pain points, and angles — you actually enjoy digging for insights

Write direct response scripts (hooks, shot lists, on-screen text, dialogue) for UGC video ads

Build customer avatars and match angles to them

Work alongside my video editors — brief them clearly and fast so turnaround stays quick

Help level up the team; some management/leadership on the creative side



Who you are:



Proven ecom experience — you've worked with DTC brands (ideally ones doing $20k+/month or more) and can show it

Can share a portfolio of ads/scripts AND data/results behind them (spend, ROAS, what scaled)

Strong direct response fundamentals — you understand hooks, mechanisms, and buyer psychology

Great communicator, reliable, works well over
/async

Comfortable leading and collaborating with a team of editors

You like dogs (it's a dog brand — it helps)

Growth-minded — you want to get better and grow with the brand



Details:



Part time to start, ~20 hrs/week, with room to increase hours and pay based on performance

Remote

Pay is performance-based — strong performers earn more as the brand scales

To apply: send your resume, a portfolio with results/data, and include the secret word "MONEY" at the top of your application so I know you read this fully



If every winning ad shouldn't have to come from the founder, and you want to be the person who changes that — apply.



Mini-task (do this to stand out):



Pick one ad from a competitor dog supplement brand — Dog Is Human, Zesty Paws, or any DTC pet supplement running on Meta — and give me a quick teardown. Keep it short (5–8 bullets or a few short paragraphs). I want to see:



The hook — what's the first 3 seconds doing, and why does it stop the scroll?

The angle — what desire or problem is it targeting? Who's the avatar?

The mechanism — how does the ad explain why the product works?

What's working — what would you steal?

What's weak — what would you test differently or do better?



Don't overthink the format. I'm not looking for a polished deck — I'm looking for how you think, whether you actually watched the ad closely, and whether you can turn research into an angle. This is the exact work you'd be doing day one.



Bonus points if you pull a real customer quote from Reddit, an Amazon review, or a YouTube comment and show how you'd turn it into a hook.

description:

We are looking for an **Experienced Credit Repair Specialist / Credit Operations VA** to support the credit repair and credit education side of our business.



This is **not a general VA role**. I need someone who already has hands-on credit repair experience and can bring immediate value.

You must have at least **1 year of real credit repair experience**.



If you do not have at least 1 year of credit repair experience, please do not apply.



I am looking for someone who reads carefully, follows detailed instructions, asks smart questions, and can work with minimal hand-holding once the workflow is explained.



## About the Business



You may see a few business names:



* **TABB Enterprises** = overall LLC

* **Vantage One Solutions** = umbrella business brand

* **Ground Zero Credit** = credit education, credit repair, and Skool community brand

* Credit Repair Cloud / CRC client setup

* Client onboarding

* Document checklist review

* Credit report organization

* Dispute workflow support

* Bureau response tracking

* Furnisher response tracking

* Client notes and update summaries

* SOPs, checklists, and workflow documentation

* Inquiries

* Collections

* Charge-offs

* Late payments

* Repossessions

* Bankruptcies

* Duplicate accounts

* Bureau differences

* Date inconsistencies

* Balance inconsistencies

* Personal information issues



I need someone who can look at a file and explain what stands out, what documents are needed, what should be reviewed first, what should not be disputed, and what the next step should be.



## Tools / Skills Preferred



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



* Credit Repair Cloud

* DisputeFox

* Credit Dispute Manager

* Metro 2 basics

* FCRA basics

* FDCPA basics

* CFPB complaints

* FTC identity theft reports

* Bureau disputes

* Furnisher/direct disputes

* Google Drive / Google Docs

* SOP creation



## Very Important



We do **not** make up fake claims, fake FTC reports, fake identity theft reports, or unsupported disputes.



Everything must be based on real facts, real documents, actual reporting issues, or a legitimate consumer concern.



## Schedule



This role starts part-time:



**5 to 10 hours per week**

    $5.00 per hour



Hours may increase if the fit is strong.



## Paid Trial Assignment

* What documents are needed

title: ERPNext Developer and AI Integration Specialist
description:
About Us

We are a growing automotive group based in Fredericksburg, Virginia, operating two businesses under one roof. My Car Business Services is our independent dealership and My Car Care Services is our auto repair shop. We are building a unified AI-native platform to replace our current spreadsheet-based operations and run both businesses from one system.



We move fast, we invest in technology, and we are serious about AI. This is not a generic CRM project. We are building something custom, the architecture is already designed, and we need someone who can own the execution.



What You Will Be Building

A unified ERP and AI platform on ERPNext and Frappe Framework covering all operations across both businesses. The system replaces 200+ Google Sheets tabs and becomes the single source of truth for inventory, sales, BHPH loans, repair jobs, HR, payroll, accounting, marketing, and customer management.



On top of the ERP you will integrate AI agents that automate the work humans currently do manually. Inbound voice calls, lead follow-up, content generation, job application screening, inventory updates, financing decisions, and OBD2 vehicle health alerts.







Your Responsibilities



Phase 1 — Foundation (Weeks 1-4, go-live Week 4)

Provision Frappe Cloud and Google Cloud Platform infrastructure using Terraform

Set up Google Workspace SSO for all users

Build core DocTypes: Vehicle (14-stage lifecycle), Recon Task, QC Checklist, Parts and Vendors

Migrate vehicle and vendor data from Google Sheets

Build ClickUp-style task views (List, Kanban, Calendar) for the Recon team

Set up role-based workspaces for Executive, Sales, Recon, HR, Accounting, and Body departments

Build Extended Lead DocType with SLA timers and CRM pipeline

Deploy first Claude API content generation agent

Build Mobile PWA for field use

Set up Playwright MCP automated test suite



Phase 2 — Operations depth (Weeks 5-8, UAT Week 8)

Build auction intelligence module with full margin model (ADJ MMR, fees, floor-plan 30/60/90)

Build BHPH loan servicing extending Frappe Loan Management (payment schedules, repo workflow)

Set up direct lead capture from CarGurus,
/Meta, Google, website, and third-party sources

Build customer portal for BHPH payments, service appointments, and document uploads

Integrate OBD2 vehicle health feed (Teltonika FMB003 device) with service alert routing into My Car Care

Set up multi-entity accounting with GL separation between dealership and repair shop

Deploy Vertex AI Document AI OCR for titles, invoices, and auction slips

Build marketing module with Claude-driven content generation agents



Phase 3 — AI and hardening (Weeks 9-11, final go-live Week 11)

Build HR, payroll, and time/attendance modules across 4 pay plan structures

Deploy KPI and SOP DocTypes per role

Set up BigQuery analytics warehouse via Datastream and Looker Studio executive dashboards

Deploy Vertex AI Search universal search across all modules

Build and deploy Twilio + Claude AI inbound/outbound sales agent (voice and SMS)

Security hardening, load testing, and full team training

Final go-live



Required Skills



ERPNext / Frappe Framework

Proven experience building custom Frappe apps with DocTypes, controllers, hooks, and workflows

Experience with Frappe Cloud or self-hosted ERPNext deployments

Comfortable with Frappe's permission model, role-based access, and multi-company setup

Familiarity with Frappe's REST API, webhooks, and background workers



AI and Automation

Experience integrating Claude API or OpenAI API into real production applications

Experience building voice or SMS agents using Twilio, Vapi, Bland AI, or similar tools

Comfortable with automation platforms such as Make, Zapier, or n8n

Experience with prompt engineering for production AI workflows



Google Cloud Platform

Hands-on experience with GCP services: Cloud Storage, Vertex AI, BigQuery, Secret Manager, Cloud Build

Comfortable with Terraform for infrastructure as code

Experience with Google Workspace SSO integration



General Technical Skills

Strong Python skills — Frappe backend runs on Python

Comfortable with JavaScript and Vue.js for frontend customization

Experience with GitHub version control and CI/CD pipelines

Strong written English for documentation, weekly reports, and client communication



Nice to Have

Experience with the Frappe Assistant Core MCP server or AI-native ERPNext tooling

Familiarity with Claude Code or Cursor for AI-augmented development

Experience with Playwright MCP for automated browser testing

Background in automotive, dealership, or repair shop operations

Experience with BHPH (Buy Here Pay Here) loan servicing workflows

Knowledge of Twilio for voice and SMS integrations



How to Apply — Required Items







Your application must include all four of the following:



At least one example of a custom Frappe or ERPNext app you have built. Describe the DocTypes, what it does, and who uses it in production.

At least one example of an AI integration you have built and deployed. Describe the tool, the workflow, and the real-world outcome.

Your honest assessment of the 11-week timeline for a project of this scope. Do you think it is achievable and why? Be specific.

Your availability in Philippine Standard Time, how many hours per day you can commit, and your expected hourly rate in USD.



What We Offer

A complete technical proposal, architecture documents, and phase plan ready from day one — you are not figuring out what to build

Direct access to decision-makers — no layers of approval or slow communication

A project that is a strong portfolio piece covering ERPNext, AI agents, voice automation, multi-entity accounting, and OBD2 IoT integration

Performance bonus available at go-live based on delivery quality

90-day post-delivery support arrangement with potential for ongoing paid retainer

Flexible remote working arrangement — you manage your own schedule within the committed hours

title: Marketing & Document Design VA – Word, PowerPoint, Excel & Canva
description:
# Job Description



We are a small U.S.-based HVAC Independent Testing, Adjusting, and Balancing (TAB) company looking for a reliable, creative, part-time Marketing & Document Design Virtual Assistant.



I am looking for someone who is highly skilled in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Canva and who has a strong eye for professional design and formatting.



You will help create, improve, and format:



* Microsoft Word documents, reports, and Statements of Qualifications (SOQs)

* Professional PowerPoint presentations

* Excel spreadsheets, tables, charts, and organized data

* Marketing flyers and one-page sales sheets

* Brochures and other marketing materials

* LinkedIn and social media graphics

*
 marketing materials

* Conference and trade-show materials

* Reusable Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Canva templates

* Existing company materials that need to look more polished and professional



Our customers include Directors of hospitals, healthcare facilities, and engineers. Our materials need to look clean, modern, professional, credible, and sophisticated — not flashy, cluttered, or overly sales-oriented.



I need someone who can take rough information, existing documents, photos, logos, written content, and basic ideas and turn them into polished, professional materials without needing detailed instructions for every design decision.



Because much of our work is within healthcare facilities, some projects may involve researching and creating materials related to **The Joint Commission (TJC) and DNV accreditation standards ** and ASHRAE, including standards and requirements relevant to HVAC systems, ventilation, indoor air quality, testing and balancing, and facility compliance. Prior knowledge of these standards is not required, but you must be comfortable researching technical information, following reliable sources, and turning complex information into clear, professional marketing and educational materials.



REQUIRED SKILLS:



Strong Microsoft Word skills, including professional formatting, styles, tables, headers/footers, templates, page layouts, and table of contents

Strong Microsoft PowerPoint presentation and design skills

Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, formatting, tables, sorting/filtering, charts, and organizing data

Excellent Canva skills

Strong graphic design and layout judgment

Excellent written and spoken English

Excellent attention to detail

Ability to follow and maintain a consistent company brand

Ability to create reusable templates

Reliable communication and ability to meet deadlines

Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT when helpful



TEACHING IS ALSO IMPORTANT:



I want someone who is patient and comfortable teaching me how to become better at Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Canva. At times, I may ask you to screen-share with me through Zoom or Microsoft Teams and walk me through how you completed a task so I can learn to do similar things myself.



Experience creating materials for B2B companies, healthcare, engineering, construction, HVAC, or other technical/professional businesses is a major plus.



This position will begin at approximately 5–10 hours per week, with the possibility of additional hours and responsibilities if we work well together.





HOW TO APPLY:



Please send:



1. A brief introduction about yourself and your experience.

2. Your hourly rate.

3. Examples of Microsoft Word documents you have designed or professionally formatted.

4. Examples of PowerPoint presentations you have created.

5. Examples of Canva or other marketing materials you have designed.

6. A description of your Excel experience.

7. Any experience you have creating materials for B2B, healthcare, engineering, construction, HVAC, or other professional businesses.

8. Tell me about any experience you have teaching or training someone through screen sharing.



Please do not send a generic application. I am specifically looking for someone with strong Microsoft Office AND design skills.



Finalists will be offered a small PAID test project before I select someone for ongoing work.

title: Podcast Content & Social Media Assistant
description:
About the Role



I'm looking for a creative and reliable Podcast Content & Social Media Assistant to help produce and distribute The Next Nova, a business podcast featuring founders, CEOs, and e-commerce leaders discussing growth, innovation, leadership, and the realities of building companies.



The podcast is presented by Vexnova.



The core podcast production workflow is already established in Riverside, and the visual brand direction, logos, colors, and overall design style are already in place.



I'm looking for someone who can take each completed recording and turn it into a polished, consistent package of podcast and social content.



The goal is simple:



I handle the conversations and recording. You help turn each episode into finished, publish-ready content.



Responsibilities

Riverside Podcast Editing

Edit podcast recordings directly within Riverside.

Remove unnecessary pauses, mistakes, dead space, and weak sections.

Create a polished conversational flow while keeping the discussion natural.

Apply existing podcast layouts, branding, logos, intros, outros, and other elements.

Create the final full-length video version of each episode.

Ensure audio, speaker framing, captions, and visual presentation are clean and consistent.

Short-Form Video Content

Review each podcast episode and identify the strongest moments, insights, stories, and quotes.

Create approximately 3–6 short-form clips per episode using Riverside.

Select clips that can stand alone and capture attention quickly.

Add captions, titles, hooks, and established branding.

Format clips appropriately for platforms such as LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram Reels.

Graphics & Brand Execution

Create episode thumbnails, guest graphics, quote cards, and promotional assets.

Work within established Vexnova and The Next Nova brand elements rather than developing a new brand identity.

Maintain consistency in fonts, colors, logos, layouts, and overall visual style.

Make thoughtful design decisions while staying within the existing brand system.

Use tools such as Canva or similar graphic-design platforms when needed.

Social Content

Identify podcast insights that could become compelling social content.

Draft captions and supporting copy for episode releases and short-form clips.

Suggest strong quotes, hooks, and angles for LinkedIn posts.

Help turn each podcast episode into multiple pieces of useful content rather than simply promoting the full episode.

Content Organization

Maintain an organized library of episodes, clips, graphics, and final assets.

Track each episode from recording through editing and publication readiness.

Keep content organized by guest and episode.

Help maintain a consistent publishing workflow.



Typical Episode Deliverables



For each podcast recording, the expected deliverables will generally include:



One edited full-length episode in Riverside

One episode thumbnail / guest graphic

3–6 short-form video clips

1–2 quote or promotional graphics

Suggested captions or social copy

Organized final assets ready for publishing



What I'm Looking For



The ideal candidate has:



Experience using Riverside, particularly its editing and clip-creation tools.

Experience editing podcasts, interviews, or conversational video content.

Strong judgment about what makes an effective short-form clip.

Canva or similar graphic-design experience.

Strong attention to visual consistency.

Good written English.

Familiarity with LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, Spotify and business-oriented content.

The ability to work independently within an established brand system.

Strong organization and dependable communication.



I'm not looking for someone who simply cuts video at timestamps I provide.



I want someone who can watch a conversation and recognize:



"That's the strongest 45-second clip."

"That statement would make a great LinkedIn post."

"That's the quote we should feature on the episode graphic."

"This section doesn't add enough value and should be removed."

"The opening needs to be tighter to keep someone's attention."





Tools



The primary tools for this role will be:



Riverside — podcast editing, video production, captions, and short-form clips

Canva or similar — thumbnails, guest graphics, quote cards, and other supporting graphics

Existing Vexnova / The Next Nova brand assets and templates



You will not be expected to develop a new visual identity from scratch.



Nice to Have



Experience with:



Business or entrepreneurship podcasts

E-commerce, technology, or AI content

LinkedIn content creation

YouTube thumbnails and video optimization

AI-assisted content repurposing



I'm looking for someone who can grow into a long-term role helping manage the content operation for The Next Nova.

title: Executive Assistant to CEO — Full-Time Remote
description:
# Executive Assistant to CEO — Full-Time Remote (Philippines)



**Southern Domestic Diva & Southern Diva Living**



**Location:** Remote — Philippines

**Position:** Executive Assistant to CEO

**Employment:** Full-Time — 40 Hours Per Week

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, **8:00 AM–4:00 PM U.S. Central Time**

**Compensation:** **$6 USD per hour**



---



## POSITION OVERVIEW



Southern Domestic Diva & Southern Diva Living are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and dependable **Executive Assistant to the CEO**.



This is a high-trust position for someone who can protect the CEO's time, manage important communications, coordinate follow-through, support sales and customer administration, organize events and travel, and proactively identify opportunities for business and brand growth.



We operate in the **commercial and residential cleaning industry**. Previous experience with a commercial cleaning, janitorial, residential cleaning, facility-services, property-services, or similar service-based company is **strongly preferred**.



Experience using **Xero and Stripe** for invoicing and payment administration is also strongly preferred.



This is **not a basic data-entry or general Virtual Assistant position**.



We need someone who can think, prioritize, communicate professionally, maintain confidentiality, solve problems, and follow through without requiring constant supervision.



---



# YOUR PRIMARY MISSION



Your responsibility is to help the CEO operate efficiently and ensure important details do not fall through the cracks.



You will be expected to:



* Protect the CEO's time.

* Keep the CEO organized and prepared.

* Manage important communications.

* Track commitments and deadlines.

* Follow up until there is a clear outcome.

* Support sales proposals and customer follow-up.

* Assist with invoices and payment follow-up.

* Maintain accurate information in Asana.

* Coordinate events and travel.

* Identify speaking, podcast, partnership, and visibility opportunities.

* Anticipate problems before they become emergencies.

* Bring solutions and recommended next steps.



**We are looking for an Executive Assistant who takes ownership—not someone who simply waits for instructions.**



---



# CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



## 1. CEO Calendar & Schedule Management



Manage and protect the CEO's calendar, including:



* Client meetings

* Sales meetings

* Internal meetings

* Speaking engagements

* Conferences

* Networking events

* Business appointments

* Travel

* Focus time

* Personal appointments when requested



Responsibilities include:



* Scheduling and confirming meetings.

* Preventing scheduling conflicts.

* Coordinating reschedules.

* Confirming attendees, locations, and meeting links.

* Adding necessary information to calendar appointments.

* Preparing reminders.

* Ensuring the CEO has the information needed before meetings and events.



**Performance Standard: Zero preventable scheduling errors or missed meetings.**



---



## 2. CEO
 & Communication Management



Assist with managing the CEO's Outlook inbox and business communications.



Responsibilities include:



* Reviewing incoming
s.

* Identifying urgent and priority communications.

* Organizing messages requiring CEO attention.

* Drafting professional responses.

* Sending approved communications on behalf of the CEO.

* Following up on unanswered communications.

* Keeping important conversations from getting buried.

* Maintaining professional communication across
, text, phone, and approved business channels.



You must be comfortable communicating with:



* Clients

* Prospects

* Property managers

* Vendors

* Business partners

* Event organizers

* Podcast hosts

* Community organizations

* Sales contacts

* Internal team members



**Excellent written and spoken English is required.**



---



# 3. Sales Proposals & Follow-Up



Support the CEO and sales team with proposal administration and follow-through.



Responsibilities include:



* Sending approved proposals.

* Following up after sales meetings.

* Tracking proposals in Asana.

* Maintaining organized prospect information.

* Tracking follow-up dates.

* Documenting next steps.

* Organizing business cards and sales contacts.

* Following up until there is a clear outcome.

* Escalating opportunities requiring CEO involvement.

* Attending weekly sales meetings.

* Preparing proposal and follow-up KPIs.



We expect **professional persistence**.



A proposal should not disappear because nobody remembered to follow up.



---



# 4. Commercial Cleaning Industry Support



Previous experience with a **commercial cleaning company is strongly preferred**.



Relevant backgrounds include:



* Commercial cleaning

* Janitorial services

* Residential cleaning

* Facility services

* Property services

* Building services

* Other recurring field-service businesses



Experience with the following is valuable:



* Commercial cleaning accounts

* Property managers

* Facility managers

* Cleaning crews

* Field employees

* Customer communication

* Service scheduling

* Recurring accounts

* Proposals and bids

* Sales follow-up

* Quality-control communication

* Customer complaints

* Coordinating between clients, office staff, salespeople, and field crews



You do not need to know our entire operation on Day 1.



You **do** need to learn quickly, take accurate notes, retain information, and understand how the pieces of the business connect.



---



# 5. Xero — Customer Invoice Administration



Previous **Xero experience is strongly preferred**.



Responsibilities may include:



* Creating customer invoices.

* Sending approved invoices.

* Locating customer invoices.

* Reviewing invoice status.

* Confirming customer information.

* Assisting with routine invoice administration.

* Following up professionally regarding outstanding invoices.

* Documenting customer communication.

* Escalating invoice discrepancies to the appropriate person.



You should understand the difference between routine invoice administration and accounting.



### Financial Responsibility Boundary



This position is **not responsible for:**



* Company bookkeeping

* Payroll

* Financial reporting

* Paying company bills

* Bank reconciliation

* Company financial management



Those responsibilities remain with company leadership and/or accounting personnel.



---



# 6. Stripe — Payment Administration



Previous **Stripe experience is strongly preferred**.



Responsibilities may include:



* Creating or sending approved payment links.

* Reviewing customer payment status.

* Assisting with routine payment questions.

* Following up on outstanding customer payments.

* Documenting payment-related communications.

* Escalating disputes, refunds, discrepancies, or unusual situations to management.



Accuracy, professionalism, and confidentiality are required when working with payment information.



---



# 7. CEO Brand Growth, Speaking & Public Relations



This position is expected to help **create opportunities**.



You will proactively research opportunities for the CEO, including:



* Podcasts

* Speaking engagements

* Conferences

* Panels

* Business events

* Networking opportunities

* Community events

* Award nominations

* Media opportunities

* Strategic relationships



Responsibilities include:



* Researching qualified opportunities.

* Maintaining a rolling opportunity pipeline.

* Identifying application deadlines.

* Conducting professional outreach.

* Submitting applications.

* Sending approved bios and headshots.

* Coordinating speaker information.

* Following up with organizers.

* Tracking responses.

* Documenting next steps.



We do not want someone simply waiting for opportunities to arrive.



**Part of your responsibility is helping find them.**



---



# 8. Southern Diva Living Brand Partnerships



Support Southern Diva Living with brand affiliations, partnerships, sponsorships, and promotional opportunities.



Responsibilities include:



* Researching potential partners.

* Conducting approved outreach.

* Coordinating sponsorships.

* Tracking affiliate relationships.

* Managing discount codes.

* Tracking partnership requirements.

* Communicating with brand contacts.

* Tracking deliverables and deadlines.

* Following up on outstanding items.



Every active partnership should have a documented:



* Contact

* Status

* Commitment

* Deadline

* Deliverable

* Next action



---



# 9. Event & Sponsorship Coordination



Coordinate administrative and logistical requirements for events, conferences, sponsorships, speaking engagements, and networking opportunities.



Responsibilities include:



* Registering the CEO for events.

* Completing event portals and forms.

* Processing approved sponsorship registrations.

* Submitting logos.

* Submitting headshots.

* Submitting bios.

* Providing advertisements and links.

* Confirming tickets.

* Confirming guest counts.

* Confirming arrival times.

* Confirming locations.

* Confirming setup requirements.

* Confirming dress requirements when applicable.

* Coordinating promotional materials and giveaways.

* Tracking event deadlines.

* Maintaining event preparation checklists.



**The CEO should arrive prepared.**



Important event requirements should not become last-minute surprises.



---



# 10. Travel Coordination



Coordinate approved CEO business travel.



Responsibilities include:



* Researching flights.

* Booking approved flights.

* Researching and booking approved hotels.

* Coordinating ground transportation.

* Coordinating rental cars when needed.

* Organizing confirmation numbers.

* Preparing itineraries.

* Adding travel details to the calendar.

* Organizing relevant event information.



Travel information should be accurate, organized, and easily accessible before departure.



---



# 11. Asana & Executive Project Management



**Asana will be the primary task-management and accountability system for this position.**



Responsibilities include:



* Creating tasks.

* Setting deadlines.

* Tracking CEO commitments.

* Tracking sales follow-ups.

* Tracking proposals.

* Tracking customer follow-ups.

* Tracking event requirements.

* Tracking partnerships.

* Tracking speaking opportunities.

* Updating task status.

When you identify a problem, whenever possible bring:



**Problem ? Options ? Recommended Solution**



Do not simply forward problems to the CEO that you could reasonably help solve.



---

---

### Monday–Friday



### 8:00 AM–4:00 PM U.S. Central Time

**Do not apply if you cannot reliably work this schedule.**

---



# COMPENSATION

### 40 Hours Per Week



This is a full-time remote position based in the Philippines.



Strong performance, reliability, increased responsibility, and demonstrated ability to operate independently may create opportunities for increased responsibility and advancement.



---



# PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS & KPIs



Performance will be measured based on results and reliability.



Key standards include:



* Zero preventable scheduling errors.

* Priority communications handled promptly during business hours.

* Asana maintained accurately and consistently.

* Assigned proposals tracked with clear next steps.

* Sales follow-ups completed by deadline.

* Invoice follow-ups properly documented.

* Active opportunities have clear next actions.

* Speaking, podcast, award, event, and partnership pipeline maintained.

* Event and sponsorship requirements completed on time.

* Partnership commitments completed by deadline.

* Travel logistics confirmed before CEO departure.

* CEO commitments properly tracked.

* Open tasks consistently followed through to completion.



**Being busy is not the same as producing results.**



---



# DO NOT APPLY IF



This role is not a fit if:



* You cannot consistently work **8:00 AM–4:00 PM U.S. Central Time, Monday–Friday**.

* You have another full-time job that conflicts with these hours.

* You regularly miss deadlines.

* You need repeated reminders.

* You disappear during scheduled working hours.

* You have unreliable internet without backup.

* You struggle to communicate professionally in English.

* You are uncomfortable communicating with clients and business professionals.

* You are uncomfortable following up with people.

* You wait for instructions before taking obvious next steps.

* You frequently forget assignments.

* You cannot manage multiple priorities.

* You resist learning new technology.

* You are looking for a low-responsibility data-entry position.

* You applied without reading the entire job description.



We do not expect perfection.



We expect **integrity, accountability, attention to detail, communication, and follow-through.**



---



# HOW TO APPLY



**Generic applications will not be considered.**



Follow the instructions below carefully.



## Step 1 — Attention-to-Detail Test



The **FIRST LINE** of your application must say exactly:



**Protect the CEO's Time**



Applications that do not follow this instruction may not be reviewed.



---



## Step 2 — Introduction



In **150 words or less**, tell us:



1. Who you are.

2. Where in the Philippines you are located.

3. How many years of Executive Assistant/VA experience you have.

4. Why you believe you are a strong candidate for this position.



---



## Step 3 — Commercial Cleaning Experience

* Property-services company



If yes, explain:

* Your position

* Length of employment

* Main responsibilities

* Commercial or residential accounts supported

* Experience communicating with clients

* Experience communicating with cleaning crews or field employees



If you have no cleaning-industry experience, state that clearly.



---



## Step 4 — Xero & Stripe Test



Answer each question separately:



1. How many years/months have you used **Xero**?

2. What tasks did you personally perform in Xero?

3. How many years/months have you used **Stripe**?

4. What tasks did you personally perform in Stripe?

5. Have you personally created and sent customer invoices?

6. Have you professionally followed up on overdue invoices?

7. Have you worked with recurring customer payments?



**Do not simply write "Xero — Expert" or "Stripe — Expert."**



Explain what you actually did.



---



## Step 5 — Written Communication Test



Write a short professional
 to a hypothetical podcast host introducing our CEO and asking whether the podcast is currently accepting guest applications.



Keep the
 professional and concise.



---



## Step 6 — Prioritization Test



It is **9:00 AM** and you discover:



1. The CEO has two meetings scheduled for the same time at 11:00 AM.

2. A client is waiting for a proposal promised yesterday.

3. An event organizer needs the CEO's headshot by noon.

4. A potential brand partner
ed requesting a meeting.

5. The CEO asks you to research flights for an event next month.



Tell us:



**What order would you handle these five items and why?**



There is not necessarily one perfect answer.



We want to understand **how you think, prioritize, communicate, and manage risk.**



---



## Step 7 — Work Setup

* Backup internet availability

* Computer specifications

* Backup plan for power outages

* Whether you have a quiet/private workspace

---



## Step 8 — Schedule & Employment Confirmation

---



# FINAL MESSAGE



We are looking for someone who wants to become a **trusted extension of the CEO**, not someone who simply completes assigned tasks.



The right person will:



**Protect the CEO's time.

Communicate professionally.

Stay organized.

Create opportunities.
