Think ahead.

Solve problems.

Follow through.

description:
About Us



Miss Yerba is a fast-growing women's health & wellness supplement brand selling across Europe and the US. We produce high volumes of short-form video content for TikTok, Instagram Reels,
, and YouTube Shorts. Our production system is AI-assisted — meaning we don't need a traditional video editor. We need someone who can follow a clear, repeatable workflow using modern AI tools to produce polished short-form videos at scale.



The Role



You'll be responsible for producing our daily short-form video content using a structured, step-by-step workflow that we've already built out. This is not creative guesswork — we have Loom walkthroughs, prompt documents, templates, and organized Google Drive folders ready for you.



Your daily workflow looks like this:



Receive a short prompt + assets (avatar image, base video)

Paste these into Google Flow to generate the video

Screenshot the old video's on-screen text

Send the screenshot to ChatGPT or Claude to get a rewritten version

Place the new on-screen text into our custom CapCut template

Export the final video and upload it to the correct Google Drive folder



That's it. Clean, repeatable, structured.



What We're Looking For



Experience with CapCut (comfortable using templates, adding text overlays, basic editing)

Comfortable working with AI tools (Google Flow, ChatGPT, Claude — or willing to learn fast)

Highly organized and structured — you follow SOPs, not your gut

Reliable and consistent — we need someone who delivers every day, not "when inspired"

Available 5–7 days per week (flexible on hours, but output must be daily)

Strong attention to detail — correct folders, correct text, correct formatting

Good English communication (you'll receive instructions and docs in English)



Tools You'll Use



Google Flow (AI video generation)

CapCut (editing + templates)

Google Drive (file organization)

ChatGPT / Claude (text rewriting)

Loom (for training walkthroughs)



Hours & Availability



Flexible schedule. What matters is consistent daily output. We'll agree on a weekly video target. Time zone: CET (Netherlands), but you can work on your own schedule as long as deadlines are met.



Salary



To be discussed based on experience and availability.



How to Apply

We have a complete onboarding system with Looms, SOPs, and prompt docs ready — so if you're a fast learner who thrives with structure, this role is built for you.

title: Full-Time QuickBooks Bookkeeper & Invoicing Specialist
description:
Small Colorado trucking business is looking for a highly organized and dependable QuickBooks Online Bookkeeper to take daily ownership of our invoicing and bookkeeping.



This is a hands-on, ongoing position. You will be responsible for creating every customer invoice and keeping our QuickBooks records accurate and current each business day. We need someone who notices missing information, asks questions promptly, and follows every transaction through to completion.



DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES



Invoicing and accounts receivable:



Review completed jobs, work orders, service records, and customer information



Create every customer invoice in QuickBooks Online



Confirm that services, parts, quantities, prices, discounts, taxes, and payment terms are correct



Attach supporting documents when required



Send invoices to customers on time



Correct inaccurate or rejected invoices



Record and apply customer payments accurately



Monitor unpaid and overdue invoices



Send approved payment reminders and follow up on outstanding balances



Maintain accurate customer records



Report missing information, discrepancies, and overdue accounts immediately



Bookkeeping and QuickBooks maintenance:



Categorize daily income and expenses



Enter bills, receipts, credits, refunds, fees, and other transactions



Match downloaded banking transactions to the correct records



Identify duplicates, errors, and uncategorized transactions



Keep the chart of accounts and customer/vendor records organized



Reconcile bank and credit-card accounts



Maintain organized digital receipts and supporting documents



Review QuickBooks daily and resolve outstanding issues



Keep the books current so management can rely on the information



Reporting:



Provide a daily summary of invoices created, invoices sent, payments received, overdue accounts, and unresolved issues



Provide weekly accounts-receivable and cash-flow updates



Prepare monthly Profit and Loss, Balance Sheet, and Accounts Receivable reports



Help prepare clean and complete records for our accountant and tax professional



Complete other related bookkeeping and administrative duties as assigned



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



At least two years of hands-on QuickBooks Online bookkeeping experience



Strong experience creating and managing customer invoices



Experience with accounts receivable, accounts payable, transaction categorization, and reconciliations



Excellent accuracy and attention to detail



Strong written and spoken English



Professional customer communication



Reliable attendance and consistent weekday availability

Reliable computer, high-speed internet, and backup internet or power plan

SCHEDULE

All completed work orders received by the daily cutoff must be invoiced that same business day. The exact schedule and cutoff time will be discussed during the interview.



TO APPLY



Begin your application with the words “Performance Bookkeeper” so we know you read the complete posting.

How many years have you used QuickBooks Online?



What bookkeeping responsibilities did you personally handle?

This position requires honesty, confidentiality, accuracy, and dependable daily communication. Do not contact our customers, vendors, or employees outside the authorized application and work process.

* Maintaining professional grammar and tone.

* Keeping communication concise and easy to understand.

* Using phone calls when a situation requires faster or clearer resolution.

* Using
 for professional or detailed communication when appropriate.

* Maintaining a professional Southern Domestic Diva client experience.



Client-facing communication should be ready to send without requiring management to rewrite every message.



---



# 3. QUOTES & SPEED-TO-LEAD



You will monitor incoming inquiries throughout the workday from:



* JotForm

* Website inquiries

* Other approved lead sources



### Quote Response Standard



Complete inquiries should receive a quote within:



**10–20 minutes during business hours**



**20 minutes is the maximum target response time.**



Responsibilities include:



* Monitoring new inquiries throughout the day.

* Reviewing incoming information quickly.

* Determining whether enough information is available to quote.

* Contacting the client immediately if additional information is needed.

* Preparing quotes using approved company pricing and processes.

* Entering quote information into AutoMaid.

* Updating client information accurately.

* Tracking each opportunity through a clear outcome.



Every lead should eventually be classified as:



* **Booked**

* **Follow-Up Needed**

* **Lost**

* **No Response**



Speed-to-lead is a key performance requirement.



---



# 4. SALES FOLLOW-UP & WEEKLY SALES MEETING



This role is responsible for helping convert qualified leads and one-time customers into booked or recurring business.



Attendance at the **weekly sales meeting is required**.



Responsibilities include:



* Reviewing new leads that have not booked.

* Reviewing open quotes.

* Following up with prospects.

* Reviewing one-time clients for rebooking opportunities.

* Offering recurring service when appropriate.

* Using multiple follow-up channels when appropriate.

* Tracking every follow-up touch in Asana.

* Recording outcomes.

* Creating clear next actions.

* Preparing sales activity before the weekly sales meeting.



Possible follow-up channels include:



* Text message

*

* Phone

* LinkedIn

*



The expectation is **professional persistence**, not one message followed by silence.



---



# SUGGESTED FOLLOW-UP SEQUENCE



### Initial Quote



Send within **10–20 minutes**, with 20 minutes as the maximum target during business hours.



### Follow-Up #1



Within **1 business day** if the prospect has not booked.



### Follow-Up #2



Approximately **3 business days later**.



Use another appropriate communication channel when possible.



### Follow-Up #3



Approximately **7 days after the quote**.



Continue appropriate follow-up until:



* The prospect books.

* The prospect declines.

* The opportunity is lost.

* The prospect becomes unresponsive after the approved follow-up process.

* Management determines follow-up should stop.



### One-Time Clients



After service:



* Confirm satisfaction.

* Ask about their next cleaning.

* Discuss recurring service when appropriate.

* Document the outcome.



---



# 5. CREW COMMUNICATION



Communicate important scheduling and job information to Tennessee crews.



Responsibilities include:



* Schedule changes

* New job information

* Client preferences

* Property instructions

* Service instructions

* Access details

* Parking instructions

* Special requests

* Relevant client updates



### Spanish Communication



Spanish is strongly preferred for crew communication.



Approved translation tools may be used when appropriate.



However, you remain responsible for ensuring every message is:



* Accurate

* Clear

* Professional

* Easy for the crew to understand



You will also:



* Respond to basic scheduling questions from crews.

* Respond to routine job-related questions.

* Escalate operational problems when management involvement is required.



---



# 6. PROFITABILITY & CREW IMPROVEMENT FOLLOW-THROUGH



The **Project Manager** is responsible for reviewing job profitability and identifying when a job or crew falls below the company's established profit target.



The Scheduling & Client Support Coordinator is responsible for communication and follow-through after the issue is identified.



Responsibilities include:



* Communicating with the Project Manager regarding identified profitability issues.

* Understanding what improvement is required.

* Communicating the issue clearly to the applicable crew.

* Explaining expected improvements.

* Discussing practical efficiency or performance improvements.

* Documenting the conversation.

* Tracking agreed follow-up actions.

* Escalating repeated or unresolved issues to the Project Manager.



### Important Boundary



This coordinator does **not independently establish profitability standards or make financial management decisions**.



The Project Manager identifies and owns the profitability issue.



The coordinator helps ensure the required communication and follow-through happen.



---



# 7. UNPAID CLIENTS & FINANCE COMMUNICATION



The **Finance Manager** retains responsibility for financial oversight and account decisions.



This coordinator supports client communication when an unpaid account is identified.



Responsibilities include:



* Communicating with the Finance Manager regarding outstanding balances.

* Contacting clients regarding unpaid balances when directed.

* Sending professional payment reminders.

* Documenting client communication.

* Recording payment-related updates.

* Relaying relevant information back to the Finance Manager.

* Notifying management when an unpaid balance may affect an upcoming service.



### Financial Boundary



This role does **not** manage:



* Accounting

* Bookkeeping

* Payroll

* Financial reporting

* Bill payment

* Bank reconciliation

* Financial policy

* Independent account decisions



---



# 8. CLIENT COMPLAINTS & RETENTION



Help manage service concerns professionally and protect client relationships.



Responsibilities include:



* Receiving client complaints.

* Remaining calm and professional.

* Gathering accurate information.

* Documenting the concern.

* Communicating the issue to the appropriate manager.

* Coordinating approved re-cleans.

* Coordinating approved corrective actions.

* Following up with the client after resolution.

* Helping retain the customer when possible.



The goal is not simply to acknowledge complaints.



The goal is to help move each issue toward a clear resolution.



---



# SYSTEMS & TOOLS



You should be comfortable using or learning:



* **AutoMaid** — scheduling, client information, quotes, and job details

* **Asana** — task management and documentation

* **Homebase** — team and crew communication as assigned

* **Microsoft Outlook** —
 and calendar communication

* **Company text messaging platform** — primary client communication channel

* **JotForm**

* Website lead sources

* Approved AI and translation tools when appropriate



---



# KEY PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



Performance will be measured using clear operational standards.



Expected results include:



* **100% of complete new inquiries quoted within 10–20 minutes during business hours**

* **20 minutes maximum target response time**

* **98%+ scheduling accuracy in AutoMaid**

* **100% of qualified lead follow-up documented in Asana**

* **100% of active quoted opportunities tracked to a clear next step or final outcome**

* Prompt client text responses during business hours

* Consistently professional written English

* Accurate client and property notes

* Proper crew communication

* Weekly sales meeting attendance

* Sales activity and follow-up numbers prepared before meetings

* One-time client rebooking opportunities reviewed consistently

* Profitability-related communication completed when assigned

* Unpaid-client communication completed when assigned

* Client complaints properly documented and escalated

* Approved re-clean and retention follow-up completed



---



# REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



Candidates must have:



* Excellent written English

* Excellent spoken English

* Strong grammar and professional communication

* Strong text-message communication skills

* Strong
 communication skills

* Customer service ability

* Strong organizational skills

* High attention to detail

* Fast response habits

* Ability to manage multiple conversations at the same time

* Ability to follow established processes

* Accurate documentation habits

* Ability to work independently

* Good judgment

* Reliable computer

* Reliable high-speed internet

* Backup internet

* Reasonable backup plan for power interruptions

* Consistent availability during required working hours



---



# STRONGLY PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



Preference will be given to candidates with experience in:



* English and Spanish communication

* Scheduling

* Dispatch

* Customer service

* Client support

* Commercial cleaning

* Residential cleaning

* Vacation rental cleaning

* Janitorial services

* Facility services

* Service-business operations

* Sales follow-up

* Lead conversion

* AutoMaid

* Asana

* Homebase

* Outlook

* JotForm

* Text-based customer support



### Language Priority



Spanish is strongly preferred.



However:



**Excellent English is more important than Spanish fluency.**



A candidate with outstanding English and solid operational skills may be stronger than a bilingual candidate with weak client-facing English.



---



# WORK SCHEDULE



This is a **full-time, 40-hour-per-week position**.



### Monday–Friday



### 8:00 AM–4:00 PM U.S. Central Time



You must be consistently available and actively working during these hours.



**Do not apply if you cannot reliably work this schedule.**



---



# COMPENSATION



### $5 USD Per Hour



### 40 Hours Per Week



This is a full-time remote position.



---



# IMPORTANT ROLE BOUNDARIES



This is a **Scheduling, Operations, and Client Support position for Tennessee operations only.**



## This role DOES NOT include Human Resources responsibilities.



This position does not handle:



* Employee onboarding

* Employee records

* Employee documentation

* Payroll

* HR administration

* Hiring decisions

* Termination decisions

* Formal employee discipline

* Company-wide HR policy



Those responsibilities are handled internally by Southern Domestic Diva.



## This position does not replace the Project Manager.



The Project Manager retains responsibility for:



* Profitability review

* Operational management decisions

* Significant crew-performance issues

* Major operational escalations



## This position does not replace the Finance Manager.



The Finance Manager retains responsibility for:



* Financial oversight

* Account decisions

* Accounting

* Payment policy

* Financial reporting



The coordinator's role is to **communicate, document, follow up, and escalate appropriately**.



---



# THIS POSITION IS NOT FOR EVERYONE



## DO NOT APPLY IF:



* You cannot work **8:00 AM–4:00 PM U.S. Central Time, Monday–Friday**.

* You struggle with professional written English.

* You regularly make spelling or grammar mistakes in client-facing communication.

* You respond slowly to new leads.

* You dislike sales follow-up.

* You are uncomfortable communicating with clients by text.

* You refuse to make phone calls when necessary.

* You need repeated reminders.

* You frequently forget follow-ups.

* You cannot manage multiple conversations.

* You do not document your work.

* You disappear during scheduled work hours.

* You have unreliable internet without backup.

* You are looking for a low-responsibility data-entry job.



This role requires **speed, accuracy, communication, organization, and follow-through**.



---



# HOW TO APPLY



Generic applications may not be reviewed.



## Step 1 — Attention-to-Detail Test



The **FIRST LINE** of your application must say:



**Accurate Schedules. Happy Clients.**



---



## Step 2 — Introduction



In **150 words or less**, tell us:



* Who you are

* Where in the Philippines you are located

* Your scheduling or customer-service experience

* Why you believe you are a strong fit



---



## Step 3 — Language Skills



Rate yourself from **1–10** in:



* Written English

* Spoken English

* Written Spanish

* Spoken Spanish



Then explain where you have used English and Spanish professionally.



---



## Step 4 — Scheduling Experience



Describe your experience with:



* Scheduling

* Dispatch

* Calendar management

* Service appointments

* Cleaning companies

* Field-service businesses

* AutoMaid or similar systems



Explain what you personally managed.



---



## Step 5 — Client Communication Test



Write a professional text response to this client:



**"Hi, my cleaners were supposed to arrive this morning and no one is here yet. I have to leave soon. What's going on?"**



We are evaluating:



* Professionalism

* Tone

* Ownership

* Clarity

* Problem-solving



---



## Step 6 — Sales Follow-Up Test



A prospect received a quote three days ago and has not responded.



Write a short follow-up text designed to move the conversation toward booking without sounding aggressive.



---



## Step 7 — Prioritization Test



It is **9:05 AM** and all of these happen at the same time:



1. A complete new quote request arrives.

2. A client reports that today's crew has not arrived.

3. A crew member needs a gate code for a 9:30 AM job.

4. A prospect from last week asks about available dates.

5. The Project Manager sends a crew-performance issue that needs follow-up today.



Tell us:



**What order would you handle these five items and why?**



We want to understand how you prioritize based on:



* Immediate operational risk

* Client impact

* Revenue opportunity

* Time sensitivity



---



## Step 8 — Work Setup



Provide:



* Primary internet speed

* Backup internet availability

* Computer specifications

* Backup plan for power interruptions

* Whether you have a quiet workspace

* Earliest possible start date



---



## Step 9 — Schedule Confirmation



Copy and complete:



**"I confirm that I am available to work Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM–4:00 PM U.S. Central Time, for 40 hours per week at $5 USD per hour."**



Also disclose whether you currently have another job or client commitments that overlap with these hours.



---



# FINAL MESSAGE



We are looking for someone who understands that strong scheduling is not just putting appointments on a calendar.



The right person will:



**Keep schedules accurate.

Respond quickly.

Communicate clearly.

Support clients.

Support crews.

Follow up on leads.

Document important activity.

Escalate problems correctly.

Close loops.**



If you are organized, responsive, dependable, and serious about delivering excellent client support, we encourage you to apply.

title: Customer Support Experts Needed
description:
We are now hiring Customer Support Experts to assist our customers over the phone.

This is a full-time position only with long-term potential



Customers will call us and ask for assistance with various tasks, such as:



Checking their email accounts

Purchasing items they need

Signing up for services

Logging into or managing their accounts

Checking or signing up for credit score reports

Conducting general online searches



The tasks we handle are all things that can be done online.



PAY & EARNING STRUCTURE



Base rate starts at $4.50 per hour.

Agents usually work 10 hours per day including the paid breaks, and we allow more hours if someone wants to earn more.

During busy times, we also pay time-and-a-half overtime when we need additional coverage.

Good performers can earn a monthly bonus between $60 and $150.

There is a $50 monthly attendance bonus for consistent on-time performance.

Every 6 months, we evaluate performance and agents can receive up to an extra $0.50 per hour added to their rate if they are doing well.



With base hours plus bonuses and performance increases, a strong performer can earn up to around $1,100 per month.



This is the roadmap of our hiring process:



- You will take a quiz that typically takes about an hour to complete.

- If you pass the quiz, you will be invited to take two live mock calls or skill tests. The first one usually takes around 20 minutes, and the second one is longer, typically about an hour.

- Once you pass, you will then proceed with orientation and training.



Please note that our quizzes and skill tests can be challenging for beginners and require sharpness, speed and excellent attention to details. If you believe you possess these skills, feel free to apply.



You need to have fluent English as well as having very good internet connection and a quiet place to work.

Please apply only if you are fully available for a full-time position.

Please do not apply if you are not based in the Philippines.



When You Apply*



Please answer the following questions:



1. How many hours are you available daily, and on which days of the week?

2. How soon are you ready to start?



Lastly, please include a link to a Vocaroo audio recording (minimum 45 seconds) where you briefly introduce yourself. Tell us a bit about your background, relevant experience, and one hobby you genuinely enjoy. This is a voice account and you will be supporting customers, so it's essential that you send a high-quality voice recording.



Thanks,

Alfred

title: Xactimate Estimator — Mitigation + Repair + MICA Insurance Claims Specialist
description:
**OVERVIEW:**

Evolution Restoration & Renovation is a US-based restoration company specializing in insurance-driven projects — mitigation and full reconstruction. We work directly with carriers, TPAs, and adjusters. We are looking for an experienced Xactimate Estimator who understands how to build, justify, and support insurance estimates.



This is not an entry-level role. We are looking for candidates with real, hands-on experience in insurance estimating environments — writing scopes, negotiating with adjusters, and getting estimates approved.



You will receive: photos of the loss, Matterport scans, and a short damage report. From that, you build a complete estimate and support the approval process.



Website: 



**LOCATION:** Remote — Philippines

**SCHEDULE:** Full-Time / US Arizona Business Hours

**TYPE:** Long-Term with Growth Opportunity



---



**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**



- Write mitigation and repair estimates in Xactimate

- Communicate with TPAs and adjusters to reach approved scopes of work

- Prepare and submit supplements to insurance companies

- Create subcontractor scopes of work based on approved estimates

- Support project managers by reviewing estimates and explaining line items

- Write clear, structured estimate notes that justify scope and pricing

- Revise estimates based on adjuster feedback

- Maintain organized, well-documented claim files



---



**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE**



- Xactimate (REQUIRED — both mitigation and repair/rebuild)

- Experience working with insurance carriers, TPAs, and adjusters

- Experience handling supplements, revisions, and scope negotiations

- Ability to build estimates from photos, Matterport scans, and damage reports

- Minimum 120 estimates written

- MICA experience strongly preferred — candidates with hands-on MICA experience will be prioritized

- Strong written English

- Detail-oriented, organized, and reliable



---



**COMPENSATION**



- 2–3 years experience: $600 – $900/month

- 3–5 years experience: $900 – $1,200/month

- 5+ years (advanced): $1,200 – $1,600/month



---



**WHY JOIN US**



- Stable US client

- Long-term role with real growth potential

- Direct exposure to live insurance claims and workflows

- Opportunity to sharpen high-value estimating skills

- Supportive, growing team



---



**SCREENING QUESTIONS**:



1. How many total Xactimate estimates have you written? Give us your best honest number.



2. Please share 3 estimates you have written. These can be redacted for client privacy. We want to see your scope, line items, and notes — not just a summary.



3. Do you have experience using MICA in an insurance estimating workflow? If yes, please describe how you used it and which platforms or carriers it was connected to.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
About Scaledforce

Scaledforce is a Canadian staffing company that helps growing Canadian businesses scale by hiring top-tier remote professionals. We focus on long-term placements, clear KPIs, and strong support so our team members can build stable, fulfilling and rewarding careers.



About the Client

You will be joining a fast-growing B2B software platform built to help home-service and local small businesses streamline operations, win more customers, and grow. From real-time booking pages to automated quoting and modern CRM tools, it gives service companies the systems they need to run smarter and deliver an exceptional customer experience.

The company is scaling its sales team, and this is a real seat on that team — not a call-centre desk. You will work directly with Account Executives, marketing, and leadership, and your feedback will shape messaging, targeting, and go-to-market strategy.



Job Overview

We are looking for a full-time, remote Sales Development Representative to be the first point of contact with prospective customers. You will run outbound outreach, qualify inbound leads, and book high-quality product demos for the Account Executive team.

Your mission is pipeline. You will become deeply expert in how home-service businesses operate — where they lose money, where they lose customers, and where the solution fixes it — and you will be able to explain that in a way an owner immediately recognizes as their own problem.

This is a quota-carrying, individual contributor role with a clear, earned path to Account Executive for the person who performs.



Work Schedule

• Monday to Friday

• Aligned to Eastern Time (North America) business hours

• Philippine Time: approximately 9:00 PM – 6:00 AM PHT



Salary & Incentives

Base Salary: PHP 40,000 – 45,000 per month

Commission: Uncapped commission on qualified meetings and pipeline, paid on top of base

Quarterly Bonuses: Performance-based quarterly bonuses



Key Responsibilities

• Outbound outreach — Run high-volume, high-quality outreach by phone,
, and social channels to identify and engage potential customers

• Lead qualification — Qualify inbound leads and assess fit based on business type, needs, and readiness to adopt the platform

• Value articulation — Clearly explain what MioCommerce does and how it improves day-to-day operations for home-service businesses

• Demo booking — Book high-quality, well-qualified product demos for Account Executives — booked meetings that show up and convert

• CRM discipline — Keep lead data accurate, current, and organized in HubSpot; log every touch

• Hit the number — Meet and exceed monthly KPIs for outreach volume, qualified meetings, and pipeline generated

• Collaboration — Work with marketing and sales to sharpen messaging, targeting, and lead quality — and bring what you hear on calls back to the team

• Product depth — Learn the product deeply enough to educate prospects and spot opportunities others would miss



What We Are Looking For

Required:

• At least 3 years of experience in an SDR or outbound sales role, with B2B SaaS experience

• Native-level written and verbal English communication

• Hands-on proficiency with HubSpot (or a comparable CRM) and Slack

• Persistence and self-motivation — you pick up the phone without being told to

• Comfortable with high-volume outreach, testing new angles, and iterating quickly

• Ability to identify customer pain points and connect them to a solution in plain language

• Coachable and genuinely interested in learning modern sales technique

• Track record of hitting or exceeding quota, with numbers you can talk through

Nice to Have:

• Experience selling to SMBs or home-service businesses (cleaning, HVAC, landscaping, pest control, plumbing, and similar)

• Experience with sales engagement or dialer tools (Outreach, Salesloft, Apollo, Aircall, JustCall)

• Familiarity with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) for research, personalization, and prep

• Experience at an early-stage or fast-growth SaaS company

• Exposure to lead sourcing and list-building (LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, or similar)

Who Thrives in This Role

• You are competitive with yourself — you track your own numbers before anyone asks for them

• You are unbothered by rejection; a no just moves you to the next dial

• You learn fast and retain it — you do not need the same thing explained twice

• You are curious about business. You want to understand why a service company with 12 trucks is losing bookings, not just recite a script

• You communicate clearly and concisely — you summarize, you do not ramble

• You take ownership. When something is in your lane, you run it without being micromanaged

• You want the AE seat, and you are willing to earn it in this one first

This May Not Be the Right Fit If

• You are looking for inbound-only or purely customer-service work

• You are uncomfortable making a high volume of calls to business owners

• You need a fully built playbook handed to you before you can start

• You have never carried a quota



Work-From-Home Requirements

• Laptop or PC with Intel i5 or equivalent

• Internet speed of at least 25 Mbps (upload & download)

• Noise-cancelling headset

• Power backup (UPS, generator, or nearby co-working space)

• Quiet, dedicated home workspace with a desk



Why Join Scaledforce

Benefits & Perks:

• 13th Month Pay

• SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG

• HMO Health Insurance

• Paid Time Off + Sick Leave: 10 PTO days (accrued) + 5 sick days after probation

• Uncapped commission paid on top of base

• Quarterly performance bonuses

• Annual salary increases based on performance

• Netflix subscription reimbursement

Career Growth:

• Clear, defined path from SDR to Account Executive

• Long-term, stable client placement

• Clear KPIs and structured onboarding

• Regular coaching and performance feedback

• Direct influence on messaging, targeting, and go-to-market strategy

• Supportive Canadian work culture



How to Apply

Please
 the following to 

• Updated resume

• Short video (1–2 minutes), recorded in one take and unscripted, covering: (1) the B2B SaaS product you sold and who you sold it to, and (2) your best quarter as an SDR and the numbers behind it



Subject line: SFM SDR – [Your Name]

Only candidates that follow the instructions above will be considered.



Shortlisted candidates will undergo:

• Initial Scaledforce screening (30 min)

• Skills and communication assessment (30 min)

• Final client interview (30 min)

title: Sales Representative / Lead Closer – Tax Software
description:
We are looking for a motivated Sales Representative / Lead Closer to join our team and help us sell our tax software and services to business owners.



We currently generate a large number of leads through
 advertising, so we need someone who is confident on the phone, great at following up, and knows how to turn interested leads into paying customers.



This is not just a customer service position. We are looking for someone who knows how to SELL and CLOSE.



What You'll Be Doing



Your main responsibility will be working with leads generated from our
 ads.



Daily responsibilities may include:



Calling new leads quickly after they come in

Following up with leads by phone, text, and

Learning about the prospect's business and needs

Explaining our tax software and services

Answering questions and handling objections

Following up consistently with leads who are not ready to buy immediately

Scheduling demonstrations or appointments when needed

Closing sales

Keeping detailed notes on every lead

Updating lead stages and opportunities inside our CRM

Following up with older leads to create additional sales opportunities

Maintaining good communication with our team

Who We're Looking For



We want someone who is:



Comfortable speaking with business owners on the phone

Confident and professional

Experienced with sales and closing

Good at asking questions and listening to customers

Persistent with follow-up without being overly aggressive

Comfortable communicating through phone calls and text messages

Organized and able to manage a large number of leads

Self-motivated

Reliable

Able to follow a sales process

Interested in a long-term position with room to grow

Experience That Is a BIG PLUS



You do not have to have all of these, but please let us know if you have experience with:



Tax Industry Experience

Understanding taxes, tax preparation businesses, tax professionals, or the tax industry is a major plus.



Tax Software Experience

If you have previously sold, supported, or used professional tax software, we definitely want to hear about it.



GoHighLevel (GHL)

We currently use GoHighLevel (GHL) to manage our leads and sales process. Previous GHL experience is a big plus.



 Leads

Experience working with inbound leads generated through
/Meta advertising is also valuable.



B2B Sales

Experience selling products or services to business owners is preferred.



Compensation



$4–$7 USD per hour + COMMISSION



Your starting hourly rate will depend on your experience, sales ability, and relevant background.



In addition to your hourly pay, you will have the opportunity to earn commission on sales you close.



We want someone who is motivated by performance and wants the opportunity to make more money as they produce results.



What Success Looks Like



We aren't looking for someone who simply makes calls and checks leads off a list.



We want someone who thinks:



“How can I turn this lead into a customer?”



That means:



Following up when someone doesn't answer

Calling leads more than once

Sending texts

Keeping conversations going

Asking good questions

Understanding why someone hasn't purchased

Handling objections

Building relationships

Asking for the sale

Following up until there is a clear YES or NO

Long-Term Opportunity



We are looking for someone who can become a long-term member of our sales team.



If you perform well, consistently close sales, and help us grow, there may be opportunities for additional hours, increased responsibilities, higher compensation, and advancement within our sales team.



How to Apply



Please answer ALL of the following:



Tell us about yourself and your previous sales experience.

How many years of phone sales experience do you have?

Have you sold products or services to business owners before? If yes, explain.

Do you have any experience with taxes, tax preparation, or tax software? Please explain.

Have you used GoHighLevel (GHL) before? If yes, tell us what you used it for.





IMPORTANT: Start your application with the words “I CAN CLOSE.”



If those words are not at the beginning of your application, we may not review it. This lets us know you took the time to read the entire job posting.



Final Question



Imagine you receive a new
 lead who requested information about our tax software. You call them, but they don't answer.



Tell us exactly what you would do next and how you would follow up with that lead over the next several days.



We're looking for someone who is hungry, dependable, good with people, and knows how to turn opportunities into sales.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

description:
The work: Editing OmeTV footage into short viral clips. You get 30-60 min recorded sessions, you watch them, find the best moments, and cut each moment into two files: a full edit (vertical crop, sound effects timed on the reactions, background music, zooms, captions, clean coloring) and a fast raw cut of the same moment.



The style: High pacing, tight cuts, movement, the viewer must stay locked in from the first second to the last. But balanced, not overdone, a clip stuffed with effects is as bad as a boring one. Perfect rhythm, not chaos. And every clip must tell a story, beginning, punchline, payoff. If you can't make a story out of a video, don't apply.



What you must know: Short-form editing properly: cropping to 9:16 without stretching faces, timing sound effects, word-by-word captions, keeping quality crispy. CapCut is enough if you know what you're doing.



What we give you: All the footage (always more than you can finish) and exact documents on how we want everything.



The pay: Per clip, rate set based on your performance. No hourly, no tracker, no schedule, the more you produce the more you earn. Around $800-1,200 a month. Paid on the 1st and 15th, always on time.



Requirements: Full-time work, not a side gig, if you can only give 2-3 hours a day, don't apply. Fast stable internet and a PC that handles editing smoothly.



Every clip goes through review and only approved work is paid, but don't stress it, we approve everything as long as the quality is there, in practice 90-100% of clips pass. We choose very few people and we keep the ones who deliver.

title: Lead Generation & Appointment Setting VA — U.S. Cleaning Company
description:
About Us



Sanctuary Premier Services is a growing residential and commercial cleaning company serving Maryland, Washington, DC, and the surrounding DMV area.



We’re looking for an experienced Lead Generation & Appointment Setting Virtual Assistant who knows how to FIND opportunities—not just wait for leads to come in.



Our ideal candidate is proactive, organized, confident communicating with U.S.-based prospects, and experienced generating leads for a cleaning company, home-service business, property-service company, or similar local business.



This is NOT primarily an administrative VA position. Your main goal is to help us generate qualified opportunities and turn those opportunities into booked cleaning services.



What You’ll Do



Residential Lead Generation



* Find people actively looking for residential cleaners in our service areas

* Identify opportunities through
 groups and other online/community platforms

* Respond to and follow up with existing leads

* Qualify prospects based on location, home size, service needed, frequency, and timeline

* Direct qualified prospects to our online booking system

* Follow up with prospects who received information but haven’t booked



Commercial Lead Generation



* Research property managers, realtors, Airbnb/short-term rental operators, offices, medical practices, churches, apartment communities, and other commercial prospects

* Identify decision-makers and accurate contact information

* Conduct cold outreach via
, phone, LinkedIn, and other approved channels

* Follow up consistently

* Schedule qualified calls/walkthroughs with ownership



Lead Management



* Maintain an organized lead tracker/CRM

* Document every contact attempt and follow-up

* Track leads through stages:

    New ? Contacted ? Qualified ? Quote/Appointment ? Follow-Up ? Booked/Lost

* Provide a weekly KPI report showing outreach, responses, qualified leads, appointments, bookings, and results



Who We’re Looking For



You MUST have:



* Previous lead-generation and/or appointment-setting experience

* Excellent written AND spoken English

* Experience conducting cold outreach

* Strong follow-up skills

* Experience working with a CRM or lead-tracking system

* Reliable high-speed internet

* A reliable computer and quiet environment for calls

* Ability to work independently without being constantly supervised



Strongly preferred:



* Previous experience with a U.S. cleaning company

* Home-services lead generation experience

* Commercial cleaning prospecting experience

* Experience communicating with property managers/realtors

* Cold-calling experience

* Google Workspace experience

* 
/community lead generation

* LinkedIn prospecting

* Familiarity with BookingKoala or similar booking software



What Success Looks Like



We’re NOT measuring success by how many names you copy into a spreadsheet.



We care about:



* Qualified leads generated

* Conversations started

* Appointments/walkthroughs booked

* Follow-ups completed

* Residential bookings

* Recurring clients acquired

* Commercial opportunities created

* Revenue generated from your pipeline



Quality matters more than meaningless activity.



Compensation



Starting Pay: $6–$8 USD/hour depending on experience



10–15 hours/week initially



There will be opportunities for increased hours and performance-based bonuses as the company grows and you demonstrate results.



This position may grow into a larger sales/lead-management role for the right person.



HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY



Please begin your application with the exact phrase:



“Sanctuary Gives Time Back.”



Applications that do not begin with this phrase will not be considered.



Please include:



1. Your resume.

2. A 60–90 second video or voice introduction. Tell us about yourself and your lead-generation experience.

3. Tell us specifically whether you’ve worked for a cleaning company, home-service business, property-management company, or similar U.S. business.

4. What lead-generation channels have you personally used?

5. Approximately how many qualified leads or appointments did you generate in your most successful previous role?

6. What CRM systems have you used?

7. Are you comfortable making outbound phone calls to U.S. prospects?

8. Tell us about one lead that required multiple follow-ups before converting.

9. What is your desired hourly rate?

10. How many hours per week are you currently available?



IMPORTANT: Do not send us a generic AI-generated cover letter. We’re much more interested in your actual experience, communication skills, and results.



We’re looking for someone who wants to grow WITH the company—not simply complete tasks.



If you’re proactive, persistent, professional, and genuinely good at finding opportunities, we’d love to hear from you.
